The Opportunity


Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) enables businesses to deliver the right experience at the right time to their customers. The Profile Stores layer is one of the key AEP services built as a multi-cloud multi-tenant service to support 1000s of customers, providing the ability to manage a high volume data pipeline and storage layer for real-time customer profiles.

Customer profiles are built on complex data models spanning both record structures supporting upserts at scale as well as timeseries analytics event like data that is ingested at very high volumes.  With the need to support to support 1000s of customers ingesting and storing PBs of data, resiliency, data correctness, scalability and efficiency are paramount.  This is a great opportunity for engineers to solve extremely interesting challenges of scale and build core services that are used by all Adobe Digital Experience solutions. As part of building these services, you will work with an exceptionally talented and collaborative team, tackle complex data challenges and build highly performant services on various open-source technologies.

***This role is senior in scope and is best suited for candidates with 15+ years of industry background.


What you'll Do

  • Collaborate with a team of engineers & product managers in building high-performance data ingestion pipelines and data store to serve the use cases of Segmentation and Activation. 
  • Own responsibility for design and implementation of key components of ingesting and maintaining petabyte of Profile data
  • Develop systems to support high volume data ingestion pipelines handling both streaming and batch processing.
  • Leverage popular file and table formats to design storage models to support the required ingestion volumes and data access patterns.
  • Explore tradeoffs across different formats and schema layouts driven by workload and application characteristics
  • Deploy production services and iteratively improve them based on customer feedback
  • Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines 
  • Participate in architecture, design & code reviews  

What you need to succeed

  • M.S. in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experiences required 
  • Experience with Distributed processing systems like Apache Spark, Hadoop Stack, or Apache Kafka;
  • Experience with Data Lake cloud storages like Azure Data Lake Storage or AWS (Amazon Web Services) S3
  • Understanding of file formats like Apache Parquet and table formats such as Databricks Delta, Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi is preferred.
  • Understanding of NoSQL databaseslike Apache HBase, Cassandra, Mongo, or Azure Cosmos DB is a plus;
  • Practical experience in building resilient data pipelines at scale is preferred
  • Strong programming skills with extensive experience in Java or Scala  
  • Leadership skills to collaborate and drive cross-team efforts 
  • Excellent communication skills  
  • Adaptable to evolving priorities, accepting challenges outside one's comfort zone,
    learning new technologies, and delivering viable solutions within defined time
    boundaries.

description:
Adobe Firefly’s Generative AI Services team is seeking a Principal Service Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our GenAI Services domain. In this high-impact role, you will lead a team of talented engineers in building scalable, high-performance generative AI systems—powering features across Adobe products such as Firefly, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock, Premiere, and our suite of GenAI Enterprise solutions. You will design and develop APIs and systems that integrate both Adobe’s proprietary and third-party generative models. As a hands-on technical leader, you will champion technical excellence and operational rigor while productizing and scaling a rapidly growing portfolio of GenAI services. You will address Adobe’s most complex engineering challenges, define technical direction, and mentor a growing organization of ML and services engineers. Job Responsibilities Lead the development and scaling of core GenAI services and APIs that integrate diverse generative models into Adobe’s flagship products. Design and architect inference infrastructure for enterprise-scale model customization, serving, and ecosystem integration. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding engineers through architecture, design, implementation, and best practices. Evaluate and incorporate emerging MLOps technologies to improve engineering velocity, scalability, and performance. Drive cross-functional alignment by partnering with Product Managers, TPMs, and engineering leaders to define and deliver the roadmap. Lead design reviews and establish technical standards to ensure high reliability, maintainability, and scalability across systems. Design and lead the development of DevOps processes and tooling necessary for scaling infrastructure and services. Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization. Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a strong ability to drive alignment in matrixed environments. Deep experience in model serving, orchestration, and GPU resource management in large-scale deployments. Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, distributed systems, and MLOps platforms. full_job_description_raw:
Adobe Firefly’s Generative AI Services team is seeking a Principal Service Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our GenAI Services domain. In this high-impact role, you will lead a team of talented engineers in building scalable, high-performance generative AI systems—powering features across Adobe products such as Firefly, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock, Premiere, and our suite of GenAI Enterprise solutions.

You will design and develop APIs and systems that integrate both Adobe’s proprietary and third-party generative models. As a hands-on technical leader, you will champion technical excellence and operational rigor while productizing and scaling a rapidly growing portfolio of GenAI services. You will address Adobe’s most complex engineering challenges, define technical direction, and mentor a growing organization of ML and services engineers.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and scaling of core GenAI services and APIs that integrate diverse generative models into Adobe’s flagship products.
  • Design and architect inference infrastructure for enterprise-scale model customization, serving, and ecosystem integration.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding engineers through architecture, design, implementation, and best practices.
  • Evaluate and incorporate emerging MLOps technologies to improve engineering velocity, scalability, and performance.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment by partnering with Product Managers, TPMs, and engineering leaders to define and deliver the roadmap.
  • Lead design reviews and establish technical standards to ensure high reliability, maintainability, and scalability across systems.
  • Design and lead the development of DevOps processes and tooling necessary for scaling infrastructure and services.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related field—or equivalent industry experience.
  • 10+ years of experience building and operating production-scale systems.
  • 3+ years of experience leading large-scale, GPU-intensive GenAI workloads (training, inference, and/or optimization).
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams on complex, high-stakes engineering initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a strong ability to drive alignment in matrixed environments.
  • Deep experience in model serving, orchestration, and GPU resource management in large-scale deployments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, distributed systems, and MLOps platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of generative model architectures, including diffusion models, transformers, and GANs

full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

    What you'll Do

    RAG System Design

    • Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)
    • Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

    Data Processing & Ingestion

    • Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources
    • Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

    Retrieval Optimization

    • Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms
    • Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

    Knowledge Enhancement

    • Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation
    • Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

    Reasoning Support

    • Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)
    • Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

    Performance Monitoring

    • Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate
    • Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

    What you need to succeed

    • 4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval
    • Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems
    • Strong ML and Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)
    • Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design
    • Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

description:

Our AI team is building a production-grade platform for autonomous AI agents — not a wrapper around an LLM API, but a full agent runtime with sub-second orchestration, tool and skill layers spanning thousands of endpoints, long-term memory, sandboxed execution, and a multi-tenant Agent-Ops stack, all runtime-swappable across providers . We're hiring Senior ML Engineers to own major components end-to-end. You'll work at the intersection of applied ML and systems engineering, and your decisions will shape a system that serves Fortune 500 marketing teams. Multiple roles, one team: The team is growing fast to match the scale of what we’re building — we’re actively hiring multiple Senior ML Engineers across the focus areas described below. We’ll match your strengths to the right domain during the interview process. Own major components of the platform — the agent runtime, tool execution layer, memory systems, sandboxed execution, or control plane — and ship production-ready code against real constraints: sub-second orchestration latency, cost-aware model routing, and high-throughput inference pipelines. Design ML workflows at enterprise scale. Build the systems for model customization, serving, and lifecycle management that let the platform adapt to diverse customer workloads. Innovate, don't just build. You'll have room to exp lore new approaches to agent reason ing, tool orchestration, memory, or evaluation — and carry the best ideas from experiment to production. Architecture through production operations — deployment, monitoring, observability, and incident response. No throwing code over the wall. Strong software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python and/or Java, experience designing APIs and microservices, and comfort owning production systems end-to-end (deployment, monitoring, incident response). Deep hands-on experience with at least one modern deep learning framework ( PyTorch , TensorFlow, JAX). Production experience with LLMs: prompt/context engineering, working with LLM APIs, fine-tuning, or building LLM-powered applications. Senior Machine Learning Engineer 

Agent Platform  —  Adobe Experience Platform 

 
THE OPPORTUNITY 

Build the Agent Platform That Powers Enterprise AI 

Adobe Experience Platform powers personalized experiences for the world's largest brands. Our AI team is building a production-grade platform for autonomous AI agents — not a wrapper around an LLM API, but a full agent runtime with sub-second orchestration, tool and skill layers spanning thousands of endpoints, long-term memory, sandboxed execution, and a multi-tenant Agent-Ops stack, all runtime-swappable across providers. 

 
We're hiring Senior ML Engineers to own major components end-to-end. You'll work at the intersection of applied ML and systems engineering, and your decisions will shape a system that serves Fortune 500 marketing teams. 

 

Multiple roles, one team: The team is growing fast to match the scale of what we’re building — we’re actively hiring multiple Senior ML Engineers across the focus areas described below. We’ll match your strengths to the right domain during the interview process. 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Your Impact 

You'll spend most of your time building platform infrastructure, with regular exposure to customer needs that shapes what you build. 

  • Build core agent infrastructure. Own major components of the platform — the agent runtime, tool execution layer, memory systems, sandboxed execution, or control plane — and ship production-ready code against real constraints: sub-second orchestration latency, cost-aware model routing, and high-throughput inference pipelines. 

  • Design ML workflows at enterprise scale. Build the systems for model customization, serving, and lifecycle management that let the platform adapt to diverse customer workloads. 

  • Innovate, don't just build. You'll have room to explore new approaches to agent reasoning, tool orchestration, memory, or evaluation — and carry the best ideas from experiment to production. We value engineers who push the platform forward with original thinking, not just execute on a spec. 

  • Close the loop with customers. Join regular customer engagements to see how your systems perform in real deployments, then feed those insights back into the platform roadmap. This isn't a customer-facing role, but your work is directly shaped by the people who use it. 

  • Own what you ship. Architecture through production operations — deployment, monitoring, observability, and incident response. No throwing code over the wall. 

Example Focus Areas 

Most engineers go deep in one or two areas while collaborating across the broader platform: 

  • Agent runtime and orchestration 

  • Tool execution infrastructure 

  • Retrieval, memory, and context systems 

  • Evaluation, observability, and agent quality 

  • Sandboxed execution and security 

  • Fine-tuning, serving, and model lifecycle infrastructure 

 

WHAT YOU BRING 

Core Requirements 

  • Ph.D. or M.S. in Computer Science or related field required. 

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying production ML systems, with demonstrated work on models and AI-powered applications that serve real users at scale. 

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python and/or Java, experience designing APIs and microservices, and comfort owning production systems end-to-end (deployment, monitoring, incident response). 

  • Deep hands-on experience with at least one modern deep learning framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX). 

  • Production experience with LLMs: prompt/context engineering, working with LLM APIs, fine-tuning, or building LLM-powered applications. 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and data infrastructure (Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, or similar). 

  • Self-motivated with strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical decisions in a collaborative, multi-functional environment.  

What Sets You Apart 

You don't need all of these — depth in one or two is what matters. We'll match you to the domain where your experience has the most impact. 

  • Agent or LLM infrastructure depth. You've built agent loops, tool-use orchestration, RAG pipelines, long-term memory systems, or fine-tuning/serving infrastructure — not as a prototype, but in production systems handling real traffic. 

  • Platform-scale systems thinking. You've designed catalog systems, plugin architectures, or intent routing that work across hundreds or thousands of endpoints, and you've dealt with the messy reality of overlap resolution, versioning, and cost-aware routing at that scale. 

  • ML-Ops or Agent-Ops experience. You've built eval frameworks, execution tracing, drift detection, guardrails, or HITL intervention systems — the operational backbone that makes autonomous AI trustworthy in production. 
    Builder who innovates. You don't just implement — you've prototyped novel approaches, run experiments, and improved systems in ways that weren't on the original roadmap. Publications or open-source contributions are a plus, not a requirement. 

  • Multiplier instincts. You've mentored engineers, shaped a team's technical roadmap, or built internal tools and practices that made the people around you more effective. 

 

 

 
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR TEAM 

Explore our research, blog posts, and product work: 

  • Team page: https://business.adobe.com/resources/adobe-experience-platform-ai.html 

  • Blog: “Show, Don’t Tell: Multimodal Answers with AI Assistant” 

  • Blog: “Raising the Bar for AI Assistant in Adobe Experience Platform”

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry is Adobe’s enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer’s IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment, marketing, and consumer retail, and is expanding rapidly into adjacent verticals.

We are especially looking for candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-level pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role has a direct impact on the quality of Adobe's image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences — innovating across the full training stack, collaborating across data, modeling, and product, and shipping your work to customers worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.
  • Develop, implement, and rigorously evaluate advanced techniques for conditional generation and editing — with emphasis on improving instruction compliance, controllability, and visual quality in pre-trained models.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications within Adobe products.
  • Develop and maintain robust evaluation pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, robustness, and safety metrics.
  • Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern ML frameworks.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, with 8+ years industry experience.
  • Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training with a focus on image and video generation and editing.
  • Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other state-of-the-art generative architectures.
  • Strong coding and prototyping skills in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with product teams on technology transfers.
  • Strong publication record in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related fields.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience on large-scale generative model training
  • Experience on synthetic data generation
  • Experience of working with large-scale datasets
  • Experience of working with product teams on technology transfers

The Opportunity 

The Corporate Strategy team works closely with Adobe’s top executives and our three business units (the Creative Cloud, Document Cloud and Experience Cloud) to ensure that the company stays on its fast growth trajectory. The team has played an active role in some of Adobe’s boldest and most strategic decisions, such as its well-publicized transition to cloud, and its expansion into a leadership position in Digital Marketing. 

Today, Adobe is at the forefront of digital experiences worldwide – be it by giving creatives everything they need to design amazing new content, or by enabling global enterprises in their digital transformation and the creation of experience businesses. This strategy has translated into exceptional financial performance and stock price appreciation even within the Tech sector. 

What you'll do 

As a Corporate Strategy Manager, you will join a highly entrepreneurial team, including alumni from management consulting firms and experts in digital media and marketing. You will be responsible for managing project teams to hack Adobe’s long-term growth. You might also lead independent initiatives. This position provides unparalleled senior executive exposure and is often the path to unique operational and general management roles throughout the company. 
 

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world by numerous “best places to work” awards. description:
Passionate about bringing clarity to complex work and helping teams do their best? We’re looking for a senior Strategy & Operations Lead excited to develop how Adobe's global Corporate Accounting and Operations runs. You will work closely with the Chief Accounting Officer’s chief of staff and leadership team to turn ideas into action. You’ll help guide CAO planning, lead culture changes, and keep the organization running efficiently and confidently. If you enjoy connecting people, simplifying chaos, and building momentum across teams, this role gives you the space to make a real impact. What You’ll Do Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CAO and her direct staff. Support decision-making by bringing clear insights, structure, and honest feedback. Lead strategic organizational build efforts by evaluating team structures, defining clear roles, and working with leadership to improve alignment and long‑term efficiency. Drive or ensure successful planning and execution of key initiatives across the CAO organization and beyond, turning long-term goals into actionable plans. Help strengthen team culture, collaboration, and inclusion across the organization. Build relationships within the Finance organization and key partner groups across Adobe. Lead all aspects of daily operations for the CAO organization. This includes definition, planning, and execution, including but not limited to annual budget planning, operational reviews, staff meetings, executive presentations, people-manager sessions, ad hoc meetings, and events. you will partner closely with key team members. Our Team


Join the Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Insights and Analytics team and be at the forefront of transforming how businesses derive insights from customer data. We are pioneering the migration of legacy reporting and dashboards to Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), demonstrating an agentic approach that empowers users to generate analytics and dashboards through natural language. This is your chance to influence the future of enterprise analytics by enabling dynamic, ad-hoc reporting powered by natural language to SQL translation.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in building scalable, intelligent systems that democratize access to data for business users. You’ll work at the intersection of data science, analytics, and innovative AI, solving complex challenges in data modeling, reporting, and dashboarding. Our team is passionate about innovation, collaboration, and delivering impactful solutions that drive business outcomes.

If you’re excited by the prospect of shaping the next generation of analytics platforms, working with advanced technologies, and making a tangible impact on how organizations understand and act on their data, this is the team for you. Join us and help redefine what’s possible in enterprise analytics.

What you'll Do

  • Build technical specifications, prototypes and presentations to communicate your ideas

  • Design, build, improve and maintain highly performant and highly scalable services and data processing pipelines

  • Work in a small, collaborative, highly productive, and high output team environment

  • Champion standard methodologies and process improvements within the team

  • Learn new technologies and technical solutions

What you need to succeed

  • 3+ years of software development experience at major technology companies and/or software startups building SaaS products and Agents

  • Real passion for solving complex customer problems using data insights, data science and analytics

  • General understanding of data structures, algorithms and distributed computing concepts 

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability to evolving priorities, and the ability to work autonomously. 

  • Proficiency in Python, Spark, SQL, etc and Apache Airflow, Databricks, Snowflake, DAX and ETL 

  • Experience in visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Adobe Analytics

  • A total of 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics and data science, machine learning/statistics. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability to evolving priorities, and the ability to work autonomously. 

  • Proficient understanding of  Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, A/B Testing, Customer Segmentation

  • Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability to evolving priorities, and the ability to work autonomously.

The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking an experienced Director Product Manager to join Adobe Commerce product management team in San Jose. In this role, you will be leading a team of product managers, defining the long-term vision and strategy for Commerce Storefront, and drive capabilities to enable Agentic conversion across all emerging channels. Strong leadership skills will be required to drive consensus on requirements, deliver high quality outcomes, and maintain a fast pace of execution.

Success will be measured by near-term enterprise customer success, existing install base retention, and the ability to drive a differentiated vision into product reality for the long-term in a manner that drives near-term market momentum.


What you'll Do

·       Lead a team of product managers to define and champion product vision and strategy for Agentic conversion on e-commerce channels including storefront, LLM interfaces, marketplaces, social channels and more.

·       Work collaboratively with the rest of the Digital Experience and Digital Media product teams to ensure we bring innovation from the rest of Adobe, to Adobe Commerce.

·       Execute on the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements by working closely with customers, partners, internal product teams, engineering, and senior management.

·       Research customer and market needs, conduct competitive analysis

·       Define prioritized feature requirements along with an overall product roadmap. Measure and assess the efficacy of the product roadmap for customer delight and business success

·       Introduce capabilities in the product and partner with GTM teams to take an early-stage product and drive adoption at global scale.

·       Support deals and deliver product presentations and demonstrations that highlight product value

·       Mentor, manage, and develop your team.

·       BS in Engineering or equivalent experience. MBA is preferred.

·       Proven track record of defining product requirements and delivering successful products. Overall 10+ years of experience in product management with a minimum of 3 years of experience in managing a team of product managers is highly desirable.

·       Deep technical expertise in front-end technologies, e-commerce storefront, e-commerce stack, content personalization, and large complex, cloud-based systems for enterprise and mid-sized organizations.

·       Ability to connect business and user design requirements to concrete product requirements

·       Experience in agile software development practices within a large team environment desirable.

·       Strong verbal and written communication skills; strong presentation skills; ability to work across teams with geographically remote team members.

·       Demonstrated proficiencies in making data-driven recommendations and drive decisions. A growth mindset that drives the individual and team growth

description:
The Opportunity Experience League is Adobe’s enterprise learning and enablement platform , powering documentation, communities, events, and support experiences across a global audience. Increasingly, this content is not only consumed by humans, but also by AI systems that power knowledge agents and agentic workflows . Our team’s charter is evolving from building a single product surface to delivering GenAI‑first Knowledge Services —reliable, scalable platform capabilities that expose Experience League content as trusted, structured, and AI‑ready knowledge for internal and external clients. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (P40) who will help design and build these knowledge management and GenAI services , enabling product teams to create high‑quality, agentic product knowledge experiences without relying on ad‑hoc ingestion or scraping approaches . What You’ll Do Design and build backend services and APIs that expose Experience League content as a managed knowledge platform for downstream consumers such as product knowledge agents and AI Assistant. Replace ad‑hoc content ingestion approaches with scalable, governed knowledge access patterns suitable for agentic workflows. Build and operate knowledge management services , including metadata, taxonomy, and structured representations (such as knowledge graphs ), to improve retrieval quality for AI agents and assistants. Build services that support agentic workflows , including content retrieval, enrichment, versioning, feedback loops, and quality signals used by AI agents. Evolve the content publishing pipeline to make Experience League content AI‑ready by design , supporting structured data, tagging, and faster availability for GenAI consumers. Take ownership of ambiguous, cross‑cutting problem spaces in knowledge and GenAI platforms, shaping solutions from early design through production adoption. Raise the operational bar for shared GenAI and knowledge services through automation, monitoring, and incident learning . Improve the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of systems that transform authored content into consumable knowledge assets. Apply CDN expertise to ensure globally distributed, low‑latency access to knowledge content for both human and machine consumers. Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes , applying cloud‑native patterns for resilience, observability, and safe deployment. Influence adoption of shared knowledge and GenAI services by working closely with product, content, and platform teams to define clear integration patterns and success metrics . What You Need to Succeed 6+ years of professional software engineering experience , including hands‑on experience delivering GenAI‑powered services used by other teams , with exposure to agent‑based or retrieval‑augmented (RAG‑style) workflows . Senior‑level experience building and operating large‑scale backend or platform services , with strong ownership of reliability and performance. Practical understanding of GenAI production concerns , including evaluation, quality, observability, safety, and cost trade‑offs. Strong hands‑on expertise with backend services and API design . Production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and MongoDB Atlas , including schema design, indexing, and performance tuning. Ability to work across teams and influence platform adoption through clear communication and technical leadership. Nice to Have Experience building knowledge management systems or content platforms used by both humans and AI. Experience integrating with AEM / EDS or large‑scale content authoring systems. Experience with CDN‑based optimization strategies for globally distributed content delivery. Familiarity with shared GenAI service models , such as service catalogs, onboarding patterns, or governance frameworks. Impact You will help transform Experience League from a content destination into a foundational knowledge platform , powering agentic product knowledge experiences across Adobe. Your work will reduce duplicated ingestion efforts, raise the quality and reliability of AI‑powered knowledge, and accelerate how teams build and ship GenAI experiences. The Opportunity
Experience League is Adobe’s enterprise learning and enablement platform, powering documentation, communities, events, and support experiences across a global audience. Increasingly, this content is not only consumed by humans, but also by AI systems that power knowledge agents and agentic workflows.
Our team’s charter is evolving from building a single product surface to delivering GenAI‑first Knowledge Services—reliable, scalable platform capabilities that expose Experience League content as trusted, structured, and AI‑ready knowledge for internal and external clients.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (P40) who will help design and build these knowledge management and GenAI services, enabling product teams to create high‑quality, agentic product knowledge experiences without relying on ad‑hoc ingestion or scraping approaches.

What You’ll Do
  • Design and build backend services and APIs that expose Experience League content as a managed knowledge platform for downstream consumers such as product knowledge agents and AI Assistant.
  • Replace ad‑hoc content ingestion approaches with scalable, governed knowledge access patterns suitable for agentic workflows.
  • Build and operate knowledge management services, including metadata, taxonomy, and structured representations (such as knowledge graphs), to improve retrieval quality for AI agents and assistants.
  • Build services that support agentic workflows, including content retrieval, enrichment, versioning, feedback loops, and quality signals used by AI agents.
  • Evolve the content publishing pipeline to make Experience League content AI‑ready by design, supporting structured data, tagging, and faster availability for GenAI consumers.
  • Take ownership of ambiguous, cross‑cutting problem spaces in knowledge and GenAI platforms, shaping solutions from early design through production adoption.
  • Raise the operational bar for shared GenAI and knowledge services through automation, monitoring, and incident learning.
  • Improve the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of systems that transform authored content into consumable knowledge assets.
  • Apply CDN expertise to ensure globally distributed, low‑latency access to knowledge content for both human and machine consumers.
  • Build and operate containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes, applying cloud‑native patterns for resilience, observability, and safe deployment.
  • Influence adoption of shared knowledge and GenAI services by working closely with product, content, and platform teams to define clear integration patterns and success metrics.

What You Need to Succeed
  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands‑on experience delivering GenAI‑powered services used by other teams, with exposure to agent‑based or retrieval‑augmented (RAG‑style) workflows.
  • Senior‑level experience building and operating large‑scale backend or platform services, with strong ownership of reliability and performance.
  • Practical understanding of GenAI production concerns, including evaluation, quality, observability, safety, and cost trade‑offs.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise with backend services and API design.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and MongoDB Atlas, including schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
  • Ability to work across teams and influence platform adoption through clear communication and technical leadership.

Nice to Have
  • Experience building knowledge management systems or content platforms used by both humans and AI.
  • Experience integrating with AEM / EDS or large‑scale content authoring systems.
  • Experience with CDN‑based optimization strategies for globally distributed content delivery.
  • Familiarity with shared GenAI service models, such as service catalogs, onboarding patterns, or governance frameworks.

Impact
You will help transform Experience League from a content destination into a foundational knowledge platform, powering agentic product knowledge experiences across Adobe. Your work will reduce duplicated ingestion efforts, raise the quality and reliability of AI‑powered knowledge, and accelerate how teams build and ship GenAI experiences.

Principal Scientist: Firefly Enterprise India 


The Opportunity 

Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use. 

Our charter spans two areas: 

  • Audio/Video Solutions: The media-processing backbone for enterprise-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume. 
  • Extensibility: Enterprise agentic workflows and plug-ins that surface Firefly's enterprise capabilities directly inside Figma and other Adobe creative applications. 

We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast-growing team; a player-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high. 

Impact You'll Make 

  • Set the long-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas. 
  • Make enterprise-scale reliability and resiliency a first-class property of everything the team ships. 
  • Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity. 
  • Grow a scaling team of software and machine-learning engineers through hands-on work and mentorship, i.e., lifting the technical bar by example. 
  • Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own the architecture for enterprise-scale audio/video media-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume. 
  • Architect the extensibility platform: agentic enterprise workflows and plug-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps. 
  • Stay hands-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to. 
  • Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work.  
  • Play an instrumental role in hiring: interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high.  
  • Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions. 
  • Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow-through. 
  • Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software. 

What You'll Bring 

  • 15+ years building large-scale distributed software systems. 
  • Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency. 
  • Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud-native platforms. 
  • Experience with at least one of the team's two domains, and the ability to ramp on the other:  
  • Media processing: audio/video pipelines, transcoding, streaming, or large-scale media workflows. 
  • Extensibility: SDKs, plug-in architectures, integration frameworks, or agentic systems. 
  • A track record of mentoring both software engineers and machine-learning engineers and raising the technical bar across a team. 
  • Comfort working directly with customers and field/sales teams to translate problems into solutions. 
  • Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field. 
  • Excellent communication and the ability to make complex architecture legible to engineers, product leaders, and executives. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience employing AI capabilities for both customer-facing value and internal product development. 
  • Familiarity with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, or agentic systems. 
  • Experience building integrations or plug-ins for Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, or comparable creative ecosystems. 
  • Depth in enterprise-scale media processing, namely, codecs, streaming infrastructure, or GPU-accelerated media pipelines. 
  • Familiarity with enterprise identity, security, governance, and compliance frameworks. 
  • Contributions to open-source software or widely adopted developer platforms.

The Opportunity

Develop with an Emphasis on Behavior Change and Growth

  • Develop solutions for growth that extend past learning, centering on behavior change, application, and long-term impact

Facilitate High Impact Experiences

  • Facilitate conversations that challenge thinking, build capability, and drive action
  • Build environments that encourage reflection, discussion, and practical application

  • Define and implement measurement strategies that go beyond happiness to track behavior change and business impact
  • Work alongside data analysis and reporting teams to analyze trends and generate practical insights

This is not a traditional Talent Development role. You will serve as a program leader, advisor, and catalyst for change, using data and insight to drive decisions and deliver measurable business impact. Your work will directly build how leaders perform and how the business succeeds.

You will join a collaborative, distributed team crafting how leadership development is delivered at scale. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex business challenges and drive measurable change within the organization

  • Experience managing complex, global initiatives throughout the entire change process, from assessment through implementation and outcome evaluation

As a key member of the Creativity & Productivity Enterprise Product Marketing team, you will shape the commercialization strategy and execution that drive global growth and sales performance for Adobe’s Enterprise solutions. Your deep expertise in pricing, packaging and portfolio planning of SaaS offerings in Enterprise sales, driving transformation toward consumption and or outcome-based monetization models - combined with a track record of leading large‑scale, high‑impact commercialization initiatives - will enable you to deliver meaningful outcomes across channels.

In this role, you will partner closely with the broader Product Marketing, Sales, Finance, Pricing, and Operations to lead complex cross‑functional programs that enhance customer experiences, accelerate new customer acquisition, and strengthen long‑term retention.  You will also explore long-term commercialization models for Adobe. 

Reporting to the head of Enterprise GTM, this role will lead the development and execution of Enterprise commercialization strategies across Adobe’s growing Enterprise portfolio. You will leverage data, customer insights, and cross functional partnerships to shape strategic priorities, inform executive decision making and operationalize GTM commercialization strategies.  

As a people leader, you will lead and develop a small, high impact team, setting direction, coaching talent, and ensuring delivery against strategic Enterprise GTM priorities. 

 

Success in this role requires operating effectively in a large, complex data environment and synthesizing sophisticated business and customer analyses into clear recommendations, scalable programs, and measurable outcomes. 

We are especially looking for a leader with a strong management consulting foundation and exposure to Generative AI driven business transformation, who can bring structured problem solving, executive-level storytelling, and forward-looking AI perspectives into our GTM strategy.

  • Own the Enterprise commercialization strategy across the creative professional, business professional, and workflow and automation product groups.  Ensure offer strategies are complementary and create long-term customer value.   

  • Partner with cross-matrix teams including Product Marketing, Business Model Strategy, Sales, Pricing, Operations and Product teams to develop and implement commercialization strategies and create offers that resonate with our customers.

  • Identify and prioritize business growth opportunities (e.g. country, route-to-market, distribution channel, vertical, product) and develop programs to deliver against these opportunities (test, implement). Drive cross-functional collaborations to achieve the same goal at country level. 

  • Preempt and problem-solve operational issues; lead and integrate cross-functional efforts.

  • BS/BA preferred OR 12+ years of experience in management consulting OR equivalent practical experience. MBA preferred.  

  • 6+ years of people management experience. 

  • Strong preference of experience at top tier consulting firms (e.g., strategy or management consulting) where you advised enterprise clients on growth strategy, digital transformation, or AI-led transformation initiatives 

  • Customer-first orientation, with deep global experience working across various customer segments 

  • Proven ability to design and operationalize SaaS, consumption-based and token-based monetization strategies to optimize customer experience and unlock growth.  

  • Genuine desire to have your impact measured in real-world metrics that correlate to quarterly and annual sales success 

  • Demonstrated leadership success in dynamic environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities 

  • Strong experience leading direct, and cross-functional multidisciplinary teams to launch high-impact business initiatives 

  • Ability to rapidly assess a problem, define options, evaluate and implement to address critical business issues 

  • Demonstrated excellence in conceptual thinking and analytical problem-solving 

  • The desire and ability to take a stand and advocate a course of action, presenting supporting facts and data to back up your position 

  • Extraordinary communication skills, both verbal and written, at all levels 

  • A solid sense of self, balanced with the drive to put team first 

  • Global cultural awareness and experience with global teams 

  • Experience with Generative AI business models, pricing strategies and tools is a plus

The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic and execution-focused Senior Global Total Rewards Operations & Project Manager to partner with the Total Rewards function! This role bridges planning and implementation, ensuring strong alignment, prioritization, and delivery of key initiatives.  This leader is responsible for leading a team that supports delivering seamless employee experience through operational excellence, emphasizing process rigor, data integrity, and effective system management. They will oversee core operations while driving consistency, efficiency, and continuous improvement across systems, vendors, and processes. 

The role also leads a high-performing operations/PMO team, balancing day-to-day execution with enterprise-wide, must-win initiatives. Success requires strong cross-functional collaboration, operational rigor, and the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and measurable results. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead strategic operations and planning for the compensation and benefits area   

  • Coordinate development and management of the Operations and PMO group, ensuring strong operational excellence prioritization, and execution rigor  

  • Drive execution of must-win initiatives, large-scale programs, and annual cycles (e.g., compensation planning, benefits cycles, compliance initiatives)  

  • Ensure team delivers on seamless day-to-day operations, finding opportunities to streamline, scale, and improve processes  

  • Expertise in deciphering operational issues or inefficiencies, with a focus on finding effective ways to ensure accurate resolution of problems  

  • Experience scaling operations across the world, understanding where to demonstrate automation and having an “AI first” approach to improve productivity across the broader Total Rewards team. 

  • Drive strategic oversight of vendor partnerships, aligning service delivery and operational processes with business objectives while ensuring consistent, high-quality outcomes 

  • Implement governance, reporting, and tracking mechanisms to measure success and drive accountability  

  • Partner across Total Rewards Leaders, EX and business teams to ensure Total Rewards programs are effectively delivered and aligned to company goals  

 

Qualifications 

  • 7-10 years of experience in Total Rewards, including knowledge of Compensation, Benefits, Global Mobility, HR Operations, Program Management, or related fields, possessing extensive expertise in crafting and implementing employee rewards programs.  

  • Strong track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and complex programs at scale  

  • Experience managing and developing high-performing teams, including PMO and/or operations functions

Adobe Experience Cloud enables enterprises to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale.   • Drive and evolve end-to-end growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and expansion for an Experience Cloud product.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using data, research and experimentation.
  • Develop and prioritize a growth roadmap tied to clear business impact.

  • Design, launch, and analyze a high-velocity experimentation program across critical user journeys.
  • Drive rapid test-and-learn cycles that ensure rigorous experiment design by establishing clear hypotheses, calculating statistical power, and implementing appropriate guardrails.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to build robust instrumentation for accurate measurement and monitoring. Oversee careful rollout strategies—including phased launches, A/B testing, and control groups—to minimize risk and improve actionable insights.

Technology-Based Growth Initiatives

  • Identify, prioritize, and ship product experiences powered by advanced technology that improve conversion and retention—e.g., personalization, predictive mentorship, and intelligent onboarding.
  • Use AI to speed up experiment ideation, hypothesis generation, copy/variant drafting, and analysis—while maintaining statistical rigor and human review.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to co-develop and implement growth initiatives, navigating trade-offs and driving alignment across teams
  • Proven ability to influence product roadmaps and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment without direct authority

  • Engineering to implement experimentation infrastructure
  • Design & UX Research to optimize onboarding and feature discovery
  • Marketing to align product growth levers with acquisition strategies
  • Finance & Data Science to quantify business impact

  • Demonstrated ability to translate data and customer insight into shipped product experiences with measurable impact.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize insights into clear narratives that drive action.

Most Importantly

You value outcomes over activity, learning over certainty, and are deeply customer obsessed. You believe Product-Led Growth is an operating model, not a feature, and you thrive in environments where experimentation, insight, and collaboration drive impact.

The opportunity Adobe's EPG (Emerging Products Group), also known as the Nextcam team, is seeking Computer Scientists with graduate training or equivalent experience in computer vision, modern AI, or computational photography, as well as Software Development Engineers with expertise in AI models, to join our team in San Jose, California.. This is a relatively new team, led by VP and Fellow Marc Levoy, that is exploring next-generation product opportunities centered around the concept of a camera app empowered by AI, computer vision, and computational photography. The team also develops technologies and features for Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, and other imaging products, with the opportunity for broad impact. As examples of what we work on, the team recently launched an AI-based feature for removing window reflections from photographs; as described in this blog. Earlier in 2024 we launched an AI model that automatically adjusts the tone and color of photographs, as described in this blog . Finally, in June 2025 we launched Project Indigo, an experimental camera app for iPhone that combines computational photography and AI, and that deliberately explores the boundaries of what is possible in a mobile camera. The app offers full manual controls, a more natural ("SLR-like") look, and the highest image quality that computational photography can provide - in both JPEG and raw formats. It also introduces new photographic experiences not available in other camera apps. The app, which is available for free on the App Store, went viral after launch, garnering millions of downloads and earning broad positive coverage in the tech press. The opportunity

Adobe's EPG (Emerging Products Group), also known as the Nextcam team, is seeking Computer Scientists with graduate training or equivalent experience in computer vision, modern AI, or computational photography, as well as Software Development Engineers with expertise in AI models, to join our team in San Jose, California..
 

This is a relatively new team, led by VP and Fellow Marc Levoy, that is exploring next-generation product opportunities centered around the concept of a camera app empowered by AI, computer vision, and computational photography.  The team also develops technologies and features for Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, and other imaging products, with the opportunity for broad impact.  As examples of what we work on, the team recently launched an AI-based feature for removing window reflections from photographs; as described in this blog.  Earlier in 2024 we launched an AI model that automatically adjusts the tone and color of photographs, as described in this blog.

Finally, in June 2025 we launched Project Indigo, an experimental camera app for iPhone that combines computational photography and AI, and that deliberately explores the boundaries of what is possible in a mobile camera. The app offers full manual controls, a more natural ("SLR-like") look, and the highest image quality that computational photography can provide - in both JPEG and raw formats.  It also introduces new photographic experiences not available in other camera apps.  The app, which is available for free on the App Store, went viral after launch, garnering millions of downloads and earning broad positive coverage in the tech press.  Here is a blog about the app.

If you are passionate about photography and AI, and if you enjoy full-stack challenges – from research to development to productization, leading to broad product impact that puts magical new imaging features in the hands of millions of users, this is your opportunity to work with a great team who is changing the photography industry.

What you’ll do
 

  • Our team works like a startup inside Adobe, making this a unique “best of both worlds” opportunity.  If you’d love the flexibility and personal impact of joining an exciting startup but also dream of having the deep resources and global launch stage that only an industry leader like Adobe can offer, this is where you belong.

  • Depending on your skill set, you can have a strong input on the direction of products, researching and developing new computational photography algorithms, and deploying them in Indigo, Lightroom, Photoshop, and other products.

  • Alternatively, you can work with researchers to develop and tune AI-heavy features for photography and video, including translating image processing code from Python into C++ for integration into Indigo, Camera Raw, or other codebases, or into CoreML, ONNX etc. for deployment on MacOS, Windows, iOS, Android devices.

What you need to succeed
 

  • M.S., or PhD degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Experience with computer vision, computational photography, and/or modern AI applied to these fields.

  • An interest in applying your skills to problems in photography, videography and imaging defined broadly.

  • A plus would be experience in photography and videography, including having a portfolio of your own work.

  • Strong programming skills (including C/C++ and Python).

  • Experience with AI tools (e.g. PyTorch, CoreML, LiteRT, ONNX).

  • A plus would be knowledge of the iOS or Android platforms and mobile app development environments.

  • Another plus would be experience in programming on GPUs or other hardware accelerators.

  • Enthusiasm for working with AI coding agents while maintaining high-quality.

Manager, Demand Intelligence & Strategic Consumption

Procurement Operations

About the Role

We’re inviting applications for a Manager of Demand Intelligence and Strategic Consumption to be part of our Procurement team. In this role, you will manage a group of analysts responsible for developing, tracking, and reporting supplier consumption and forecasted demand within our key spending categories. Your work will directly influence sourcing tactics, support contract discussions, and bolster our ability to manage vendor performance with clarity and confidence.

This is a high-visibility role where data intersects with decision-making. You will collaborate closely with Procurement Category Managers to deliver usage intelligence and forecasting insights. You will develop and sustain the analytical foundation that enables effective category management.

We believe that strong vendor analytics is a strategic advantage. We’re investing in this team to improve how we understand and manage supplier relationships across the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts, setting clear expectations and helping each team member grow their skills in data analysis, reporting, and communication with collaborators
  • Develop and uphold reporting systems that monitor supplier usage, spending trends, and consumption patterns across our key vendor relationships
  • Develop and refine usage forecasting models that give Procurement Category Managers forward-looking access to demand and cost trajectories
  • Partner with Category Managers, Finance, and business collaborators to ensure usage data and forecasts are accurate, timely, and actionable
  • Develop dashboards and executive-ready reports that transform complex data into understandable insights for leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Find opportunities to improve data quality, streamline reporting processes, and introduce automation where it adds new value
  • Partner with IT and data engineering departments to refine data pipelines and secure consistent access to supplier and usage data
  • Support quarterly business reviews and vendor performance discussions with data-driven analysis and recommendations

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in procurement analytics, spend analytics, vendor management, finance, or a related analytical field
  • Over 2 years of experience heading or managing a group, with a clear concentration on cultivating individuals and encouraging effective teamwork
  • Strong quantitative skills, including experience with data analysis, forecasting, and working with large datasets
  • Proficiency in analytics and reporting tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms
  • Ability to convert complex data into clear narratives and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working cross-functionally with procurement, finance, or operations teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deliver consistent results
  • A collaborative approach and comfort working as a close partner to category management without owning that function directly

Nice to Have

  • Experience with enterprise procurement or ERP systems such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or Oracle
  • Background in SaaS, cloud, software, telecom, or technology-related spend categories
  • Familiarity with data visualization guidelines and storytelling with data
  • Experience with statistical forecasting methods or predictive analytics

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We prioritize building a team where all members have the chance to evolve, contribute, and undertake meaningful work. You will have the opportunity to influence how we manage vendor analytics from the ground up, and your insights will directly affect procurement strategy throughout the organization.

Global Operating Model & Governance

Data-Informed Decision Making & Strategic Business Partnership Provide strategic finance leadership, supporting the C&P marketing organization (Business Professionals & Consumers and Creators & Creative Professionals teams). Serve as a proactive thought partner to marketing leadership, shifting discussions from reporting results to understanding drivers, implications, and actions. Guide cross-functional alignment of investment priorities and strategic decisions across Product Marketing, Go-to-Market, GMO, and Finance leadership teams. Deliver recurring business reviews and executive reporting that translate financial and marketing trends into clear business implications and recommended actions. 2. Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization Proactively identify diminishing returns, underperforming investments, and budget reallocation opportunities to improve marketing value and investment efficiency. Partner closely with Product Marketing and Growth Marketing Insights (GMI) teams to evaluate performance trends and optimize marketing investments across the funnel. Build and maintain an executive-level Marketing Return on Investment scorecard, providing leadership with ongoing insight into program performance and spend efficiency. 3. Budget Management & Financial Planning Own end-to-end financial management of variable marketing budget (>$1B annually), lead quarterly forecast cycles, risk and opportunity assessments, and scenario planning. Establish investment guardrails, approval workflows, and budget shifts that balance financial control with the agility modern marketing demands. 4. Leadership & Team Development Lead and develop a high-performing finance team, focused analytical rigor, business partnership, and continuous improvement. Represent marketing finance in cross-functional leadership forums, including the Finance Leadership Team, GMO and C&P marketing leadership meetings. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Required 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with a strong background in topline product/go-to-market finance and/or marketing finance role within a consumer-facing business. Demonstrated expertise evaluating marketing efficiency, including experience with multi-channel investment analysis, attribution methodologies, and/or media mix modeling. Proven track record leading new financial capabilities, processes, and ways of working within marketing finance and/or FP&A environments. Advanced financial modeling skills; proficiency in Excel and planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, SAP). Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI). description:
Position Summary The Director, Enterprise Marketing Finance is a senior strategic finance leader embedded within Adobe’s Enterprise Marketing organization, serving as the primary finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team. This role is at the intersection of data-driven decision making and go-to-market strategy for Adobe’s largest customer segment—Fortune 500 and mid-market enterprise accounts. Combining rigorous financial stewardship with deep marketing effectiveness expertise, this role owns the Enterprise Marketing budget, leads investment prioritization, and builds the frameworks that connect marketing spend to pipeline, revenue, and customer lifetime value. This is a true business partner role—you won’t just track spend; you’ll shape strategy, challenge assumptions, and directly influence how Adobe reaches and engages enterprise customers at scale. Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Partnership & Data-Informed Decision Making Serve as the dedicated finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her senior leadership team, providing strategic financial guidance across all Enterprise Marketing functions including field marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), events, and digital programs. Act as a proactive thought partner to marketing leadership, shifting discussions from reporting results to understanding performance drivers, implications, and forward-looking actions. Evaluate performance across acquisition, pipeline generation, conversion, retention, and engagement initiatives to inform investment prioritization and resource allocation decisions. Build executive-ready analyses and presentations that translate complex financial and marketing data into clear narratives and confident, data-backed recommendations for senior partners. Lead and contribute to quarterly business reviews and executive reporting, surfacing key trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team. Position Summary

The Director, Enterprise Marketing Finance is a senior strategic finance leader embedded within Adobe’s Enterprise Marketing organization, serving as the primary finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team. This role is at the intersection of data-driven decision making and go-to-market strategy for Adobe’s largest customer segment—Fortune 500 and mid-market enterprise accounts.

Combining rigorous financial stewardship with deep marketing effectiveness expertise, this role owns the Enterprise Marketing budget, leads investment prioritization, and builds the frameworks that connect marketing spend to pipeline, revenue, and customer lifetime value. This is a true business partner role—you won’t just track spend; you’ll shape strategy, challenge assumptions, and directly influence how Adobe reaches and engages enterprise customers at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership & Data-Informed Decision Making

  • Serve as the dedicated finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her senior leadership team, providing strategic financial guidance across all Enterprise Marketing functions including field marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), events, and digital programs.
  • Act as a proactive thought partner to marketing leadership, shifting discussions from reporting results to understanding performance drivers, implications, and forward-looking actions.
  • Evaluate performance across acquisition, pipeline generation, conversion, retention, and engagement initiatives to inform investment prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
  • Build executive-ready analyses and presentations that translate complex financial and marketing data into clear narratives and confident, data-backed recommendations for senior partners.
  • Lead and contribute to quarterly business reviews and executive reporting, surfacing key trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team.
  • Guide cross-functional alignment on investment priorities across Enterprise Marketing, Sales Finance, Product Marketing, and Finance leadership teams.

2. Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization

  • Build and maintain sophisticated Return On Investment (ROI) measurement frameworks and attribution models that connect marketing investments to pipeline generation, revenue outcomes, and customer lifetime value.
  • Proactively identify diminishing returns, underperforming programs, and budget reallocation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency across the enterprise funnel (CAC, LTV, funnel economics).
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales Finance teams to ensure consistent, integrated reporting across the customer journey.
  • Build and maintain an executive-level Marketing ROI scorecard providing ongoing visibility into program performance and spend efficiency for Enterprise Marketing leadership.
  • Drive operational improvements and automation in planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows to increase speed of insight generation.

3. Budget Management & Financial Planning

  • Own end-to-end financial management of the Enterprise Marketing budget, including annual planning, quarterly forecasting, risk and opportunity assessments, and scenario planning.
  • Build a defensible, strategically aligned annual budget in close partnership with the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team.
  • Establish investment guardrails, approval workflows, and re-forecast protocols that balance financial rigor with the agility that modern enterprise marketing demands.
  • Translate Enterprise Marketing strategies into financial models and forecasts, identifying optimization opportunities throughout the planning cycle.

4. Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a strong marketing finance team, fostering analytical rigor, business insight, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Mentor junior finance team members, building capabilities in marketing analytics, financial modeling, and executive communication.
  • Represent Enterprise Marketing Finance in cross-functional leadership forums, including with the FP&A Leadership, Enterprise Marketing leadership meetings, and Sales Finance reviews.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 5 years in marketing finance, FP&A, or commercial finance roles within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology companies.
  • Demonstrated expertise in marketing analytics including multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modeling, CAC/LTV analysis, funnel economics, and multi-channel investment analysis.
  • Proven track record as a strategic finance business partner to senior marketing or commercial leadership, influencing decisions through data-driven storytelling.
  • Advanced financial modeling and forecasting capabilities; proficiency in Excel and planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, SAP).
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce).
  • Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while knowing when to collaborate and call out appropriately.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related quantitative field.

Preferred

  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B marketing organizations and familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) investment frameworks.
  • Track record of leading financial capability-building and process transformation within marketing finance or FP&A environments.

Strengths You'll Need

  • Strategic Influence: Builds credibility through high-quality insights and trusted business partnership with senior marketing leadership.
  • Analytical Courage: Willing to challenge marketing investment decisions when supported by data; comfortable presenting difficult findings to executive audiences.
  • Cross-functional Partnership: Builds authentic, trust-based relationships across marketing, sales, analytics, and technology teams.
  • Executive Communication: Translates complex financial and performance data into concise, compelling recommendations for senior partners.
  • Bias Toward Action: Strategic approach balanced with attention to detail and a drive to move quickly from insight to decision.
  • Continuous Improvement: Consistently seeks more efficient, scalable, and predictive approaches to planning, measurement, and investment optimization.

Help define and scope a technology architecture based on the customer’s needs. Script & record compelling technical demo videos that bring the product to life. Influence product roadmaps, validating requirements with customers, partners and internal stakeholders. Gather technical product feedback from sales, customer success and professional services organizations. Serve as a technical expert on emerging technologies in Adobe Firefly solutions, Creative Cloud, and corresponding Digital Experience APIs and technologies. Ideate and code (or vibe code) creative enterprise products and workflow prototypes using knowledge of creative production, Adobe APIs, external APIs, and customer needs. Work across internal engineering and research teams to imagine and build prototypes using existing and new available technologies. Use other emerging technologies and synthesize technical trends and their impact to Adobe. Present product demos to senior leadership at Adobe and with customers, and represent Adobe at customer briefings/events. Support and manage multiple pre-sales customer engagements, in support of the M&E division and the broader Sales organization. What you will need to succeed Deep, hands-on experience of Media and Entertainment workflows, either as an editor, compositor, VFX leader, motion graphics designer, creator, or similar. 5-10 years hands on, practitioner experience with Creative Cloud (or similar) applications in the creation of static, vector, 3D, and/or video content. Deep technical and customer knowledge across creative, document, digital experience, generative AI, and workflow/low-code spaces. As an advantage, technical developer skills: JavaScript / Node.JS (server-side, front end), API tools (Postman, App Builder), HTML/CSS, React (Spectrum or similar), Python a plus, Low-code connectors a plus (PowerAutomate, Zapier, n8n, or similar) Analytical and strategic problem solving, adept at using data to advise decisions.
