full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity    

Adobe is a market leader in creative & marketing software. We are looking for a Creative Technologist to join our expanding team in the Media and Entertainment business group.

    

Reporting to the Director of Growth, a successful candidate will have an extensive background in Media and Entertainment workflows, with 5-10 years of hands-on production experience. You will have strong practical knowledge of Adobe’s core Creative Cloud products, a working knowledge of Adobe’s Marketing Cloud stack, and a keen awareness of 3rd party production tools. You will be passionately customer orientated, share a deep interest in new technologies (e.g., generative AI, creative workflows) and ideally have an ability to write code, or demonstrate mature ‘vibe coding’ skills. Above all you must have a keen eye for aesthetics, have a deep understanding of media pipelines and workflow and be able to translate customer ideas into beautiful creative assets, at short notice. Your job is to hear a customer’s problem and quickly demonstrate a credible, impact focused, creative solution. You should also have a commercial mindset, centered around genuine business and customer solutions, not science experiments. Our focus is delighting the customer, while growing Adobe’s M&E business.

You’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the world’s largest and most innovative brands on challenging, cutting-edge, unsolved content and AI challenges. 

  

What you’ll do  

  • Lead discovery workshops to identify customer use cases that unlock business value. 
  • Work with internal and customer stakeholders to craft a point of view that aligns Adobe’s solutions to the customer’s business and creative needs. 
  • Build working prototypes and walkthroughs.   
  • Help define and scope a technology architecture based on the customer’s needs. 
  • Script & record compelling technical demo videos that bring the product to life.   
  • Influence product roadmaps, validating requirements with customers, partners and internal stakeholders. Gather technical product feedback from sales, customer success and professional services organizations.  
  • Serve as a technical expert on emerging technologies in Adobe Firefly solutions, Creative Cloud, and corresponding Digital Experience APIs and technologies.
  • Ideate and code (or vibe code) creative enterprise products and workflow prototypes using knowledge of creative production, Adobe APIs, external APIs, and customer needs.
  • Work across internal engineering and research teams to imagine and build prototypes using existing and new available technologies.  
  • Use other emerging technologies and synthesize technical trends and their impact to Adobe.
  • Present product demos to senior leadership at Adobe and with customers, and represent Adobe at customer briefings/events.   
  • Support and manage multiple pre-sales customer engagements, in support of the M&E division and the broader Sales organization.

What you will need to succeed  

  • Deep, hands-on experience of Media and Entertainment workflows, either as an editor, compositor, VFX leader, motion graphics designer, creator, or similar.
  • 5-10 years hands on, practitioner experience with Creative Cloud (or similar) applications in the creation of static, vector, 3D, and/or video content. 
  • Deep technical and customer knowledge across creative, document, digital experience, generative AI, and workflow/low-code spaces.
  • As an advantage, technical developer skills: JavaScript / Node.JS (server-side, front end), API tools (Postman, App Builder), HTML/CSS, React (Spectrum or similar), Python a plus, Low-code connectors a plus (PowerAutomate, Zapier, n8n, or similar)  
  • Analytical and strategic problem solving, adept at using data to advise decisions.   
  • Build the future mindset & around the corner thinking  
  • Experience in a technical pre-sales, technical consulting, developer / architect or creative environment a plus 
  • Experience across creative, document and marketing workflows (image editing, video, audio, 3D, analytics, work management, pdf)  
  • Technical curiosity and a growth mindset evidenced by continuous learning and development. 
  • Ability to working autonomously, track-record of delivering on-time  
  • Work-well across functions and engineering teams  
  • Exceptional executive and customer communication skills, capable of conveying sophisticated technical and product ideas.  
  • Strong executive presence and confidence presenting and engaging large stakeholder groups both virtually and in-person 
  • Ability to storyboard, produce, and edit your own demos using Pr, Ps, AEM, Workfront, Frame, Express etc.  
  • Flexibility to travel across the continental US and internationally.
  • Extreme owner mentality; founder-style work ethic  
  • Great teammate, no ego on our team, always ready to help, and have FUN!

full_job_description_raw:
Our Company

At Adobe, we change the world through digital experiences — empowering everyone from emerging artists to global brands to create exceptional content and experiences. As the leader in creative, document, and experience technology, we drive transformation for more than 85% of the Fortune 2000, standing at the intersection of creativity, marketing, and AI.

The Opportunity

Every global brand is now a media company. The question is whether they have the infrastructure, the intelligence, and the craft to operate like one.

Join a fast-paced, 0-to-1 intrapreneurial team within Adobe Firefly Foundry, working directly with enterprise customers to scope and identify deep-tuning AI services. You will collaborate closely with Adobe's platform, security, engineering, product, and program management organizations.

A successful candidate brings genuine creative fluency, full-stack engineering depth, and experience with agency & media workflows. you translate complex customer problems into working solutions — often before the customer knows what they need You will have a builder's instinct for GenAI prototypes. You bring insight and clarity to unclear paths.

What You'll Do

Act like a product manager for the customer. Understand what they need, think about how to improve the product, and bring that perspective back inside consistently.

Immerse yourself fully in client workflows. Step into the role of the designer, the marketer, the filmmaker and produce the outputs. Don't just evaluate — use the tools deeply enough to hit real friction, anticipate needs, surface edge cases, and find the errors.

Prototype quickly. Code quickly to drive alignment internally and with customers, then harden experiences with quality engineering practices for Adobe's client platforms.

Participate and guide discovery workshops. Identify high-value use cases, define and scope technical architectures, and translate customer needs into credible, impact-focused solutions.

Create compelling technical demos. Ideate next-generation creative workflows using Adobe APIs, Firefly Services, Creative Cloud, and AI capabilities — then script, produce, and deliver the demos yourself. Represent Adobe as required at industry events, advisory boards, and executive forums.

Partner with internal engineering and research teams. Imagine and build with existing and emerging technologies, including generative AI models, LLMs, and modern web infrastructure.

Influence Adobe's product roadmap. Bring real market signal back inside from customers, partners, and the field.

What You Need to Succeed

7+ years of professional experience building and deploying web applications or interactive experiences, preferably in the creative tools domain.

Deep familiarity with enterprise creative production workflows across M&E, brand, and agency environments — including image, video, audio, motion, and experiential content pipelines.

Full-stack development proficiency: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, HTML, CSS on the front end; Python, Java, Go, or C++ on the back end. API tooling, low-code connectors, and AWS or Azure deployments a plus.

Hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud applications and the ability to produce and edit your own demos using Premiere Pro, Photoshop, AEM, Workfront, Frame.io, and Express.

Exposure to generative AI models, text-to-image systems, and LLMs. Familiarity with WASM, WebGPU, or canvas rendering a bonus.

Analytical and strategic problem solver with strong executive presence and the communication skills to make complex technical ideas land in a boardroom.

Customer-obsessed, detail-oriented, and biased toward action. You solve complex problems independently and drive tangible results in a team-oriented culture.

High EQ, low ego, extreme ownership mentality, and genuine curiosity about what comes next.

Flexibility to travel across the continental US and internationally.

BS or higher in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on AI Agent Engineer to develop, build, and maintain intelligent agents that drive automation and business impact across the enterprise. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of agent development — from design to versioning, orchestration, and continuous learning.

You’ll contribute directly to scaling our AI strategy by engineering reusable components, optimizing agent workflows, and ensuring real-world performance in production environments.

What you'll Do

  • A core aspect of this role involves building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly enhance engineering efficiency, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization. 
  • Create reusable agent templates and modular components to accelerate deployment across business units
  • Productionize AI models from prototypes to production-ready systems.
  • Develop autonomous agents and skills for tasks like code generation and tool calling.
  • Optimize model performance, reduce latency, and improve reliability.
  • Implement prompt engineering strategies, memory handling, resource management and tool-calling integrations.

What you need to succeed

  • 3–5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and backend development
  • Prior exposure to LLM APIs or AI-powered services in production
  • Experience with AI tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases.
  • Ability to measure and improve model solve rates and accuracy.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals (Python, REST)
  • Experience with event streaming (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis, or similar) and data pipelines (Spark, Databricks, or comparable).
  • Familiarity with production operations: Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), REST APIs, Python, and containerization (Docker, K8s)

description:
The Opportunity Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates. You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem. What You'll Do S/4HANA Product Management Ownership Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting. Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams. Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility. • Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams. • Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering. Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership • Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals. • Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams. • Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments. • Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives. • Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers. Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap • Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements. • Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close. • Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows. • Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap. AI Feature Delivery & Innovation • Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines. • Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement. • Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform. • Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows. What you need to succeed • 8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations. • Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics). • Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting. • Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production. • Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models. • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes. • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development. • Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data. • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems. • Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent. • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training. Leadership & Soft Skills • Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences. • Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment. • Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy. • The Opportunity 

    Adobe is seeking a Senior IT Product & Delivery Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our SAP S/4HANA Core Finance platform. This is a high-impact, AI-intensive leadership role at the intersection of enterprise finance technology and innovative artificial intelligence. You will drive the end-to-end product lifecycle for General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, FICA, Treasury, and adjacent finance systems—while embedding AI and machine learning capabilities to transform how Adobe's finance organization operates.

    You will collaborate with partners from the finance sector, data scientists, engineering teams, and C-suite customers to deliver intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and self-healing finance workflows. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA. It also demands an entrepreneurial approach to apply the latest advances in generative AI, agentic workflows, and large language models (LLMs) within a world-class finance ecosystem.

    What You'll Do

  • S/4HANA Product Management Ownership
  • Serve as the primary product owner for S/4HANA Finance components including the General Ledger (Universal Journal), Payables and Receivables, FICA with Contract Accounts and Collections/Dispute Management, Treasury & Cash Management, Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, Fixed Assets, and Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting.
  • Drive configuration, extension build, and integration architecture decisions in collaboration with solution architects and SAP Basis teams.
  • Manage integration touchpoints with Kyriba, Blackline, Databricks, GEP, and custom microservices—ensuring data integrity and real-time financial visibility.

  • • Change agent — proven track record driving organizational adoption of exciting technologies, including managing change management workstreams.

    • Collaborative builder — skilled at cultivating trusted relationships with finance business owners, SAP, cloud vendors, and internal engineering.

    Collaborator Engagement & Delivery Leadership

    • Partner closely with the Director of Global Accounting and Treasury leadership to align technology investments with finance transformation goals.

    • Write detailed product requirements, AI model cards, functional specs, and user stories consumed by engineering and design teams.

    • Drive agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews—while maintaining a clear line-of-sight from AI experiments to production deployments.

    • Build executive-ready arguments quantifying return on investment, time-to-value, and risk for AI-enabled initiatives.

    • Coordinate a cross-functional pod of engineers, QA specialists, finance SMEs, and data engineers.

    Product Strategy & Technology-Informed Roadmap

    • Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for S/4HANA’s central finance module, prioritizing AI-first capabilities alongside foundational ERP improvements.

    • Define and champion an AI integration strategy spanning generative AI copilots, intelligent document processing, anomaly detection, and predictive close.

    • Find opportunities to embed SAP Business AI, Joule, and third-party LLMs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) into core finance workflows.

    • Conduct competitive analysis and stay current on SAP release cycles, AI advancements, and FinTech trends to continuously sharpen the roadmap.

    AI Feature Delivery & Innovation

    • Lead delivery of AI-powered capabilities including automated GL account coding and journal entry validation, intelligent AP/AR matching and dispute resolution, natural language querying of financial data via LLM-powered interfaces, predictive cash flow forecasting and working capital optimization, real-time anomaly detection and fraud prevention using ML pipelines.

    • Partner with Adobe's AI/ML engineering teams and data scientists to design model training datasets, evaluate model performance, and define feedback loops for continuous improvement.

    • Collaborate with SAP and cloud hyper scalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to leverage embedded AI services within the S/4HANA digital platform.

    • Define responsible AI guardrails, bias mitigation frameworks, and explainable standards for all AI models embedded in finance workflows.

    What you need to succeed

    • 8+ years of experience in enterprise finance IT, with at least 7 years of hands on SAP S/4HANA or ECC Finance implementations.

    • Demonstrable experience delivering AI/ML-powered features within ERP or finance platforms (e.g., intelligent automation, NLP interfaces, predictive analytics).

    • Expert-level knowledge of S/4HANA Finance modules: GL (Universal Journal), AP, AR, FICA, RAR, Treasury, Asset Accounting.

    • Proven product management or IT delivery leadership track record—driving complex, multi-stakeholder programs from concept to production.

    • Strong grasp of GAAP, IFRS 15, ASC 606, and subscription business financial models.

    • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company with subscription revenue models and solid understanding of SAP Order to Cash processes.

    • Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA analytics (Databricks, SAP Analytics Cloud), procurement (Ariba or GEP or Coupa), and cloud data platforms.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Build, or SAP Extension Suite for custom AI development.

    • Familiarity with timely engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) applied to enterprise data.

    • Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, responsible AI principles, and GDPR/CCPA compliance for finance data managed by automated systems.

    • Hands-on familiarity with at least one AI/ML toolchain: Azure OpenAI Service, Google’s Vertex AI platform, AWS SageMaker, SAP AI Core, or equivalent.

    • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification or SAP Activate methodology training.

    Leadership & Soft Skills

    • Visionary communicator — able to translate AI/ML concepts and technical architecture to Senior Leadership, Controller, and Board-level audiences.

    • Strategic operator — comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and accelerating decisions in a matrixed environment.

    • Talent multiplier — experience mentoring finance technologists and encouraging a culture of continuous learning and AI literacy.

Elite full-stack engineer. Elite creative-tool expert. Elite public speaker who commands Fortune 100 boardrooms. 

Read this before you apply. This role requires all of the following — at the same time, in the same person, at the hardest scale in the organization. Not three out of four.

  • You ship production code every week — real, full-stack systems that run in front of real customers. Not scripts. Not prototypes that die after the demo. 

  • You have deep, professional-grade mastery of at least one of: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Cinema 4D or Substance 3D — or an equivalent tool in your craft. Not familiarity. Mastery. 

  • You can walk into a room of CMOs and CTOs from a Fortune 100 brand — the account with the impossible timeline, the fractured stack, the deal that has to prove out the whole motion — run a live demo unscripted, and walk out with the room won. 

  • You’ve set a technical or creative direction that changed how an org works — a real “before-me / after-me,” not a one-off win. 

This bar has to be met on day one, not grown into. If you’re most of the way there, that’s genuinely great — just come back once the track record is real, not aspirational. 

What you’ll do 

This is director-scope work delivered without direct reports: you set the technical and creative direction other engineers follow, through influence, not headcount. You take the engagements no one else can land — the impossible-timeline Fortune 100 account, the fractured stack, the strategic account where the whole motion has to prove itself. You go in first, and the bench follows. 

The only metric that matters here: did the customer get real value, and did they come back for more. That’s the entire job — everything else is noise. 

What you need 

  • 12+ years shipping real software, full-stack, with a track record of adoption at the hardest scale — not one win, a pattern across accounts 

  • Deep hands-on mastery of a professional creative tool (see above) — a portfolio proving it 

  • Hands-on experience building multi-step automated workflows/pipelines (ComfyUI, n8n, or similar) 

  • A named “before-me/after-me” change you drove that others in a practice still point to 

  • A pattern of turning the most resistant rooms and most fractured stacks into repeat, at-scale adoption — named accounts, named outcomes 

  • Hard requirement: public portfolio or verifiable shipped work showing both the engineering and the creative side, personally done by you. No portfolio, no review. At this level we also weight a public technical/creative footprint heavily — talks, published work, case studies, or an equivalent trail of things you’ve set direction on. 

Strong pluses (not required, we’ll help you ramp) 

  • Experience with Adobe Firefly Services, Firefly Creative Production / Workflow Builder, or Adobe Brand Intelligence 

  • Domain depth in Healthcare & Life Sciences, Financial Services, or Media & Entertainment — especially MLR (medical/legal/regulatory) compliance-review experience 

  • DevOps fluency

This is a multi-faceted executive role with end-to-end accountability for how Firefly Foundry’s models are productionized, served, and operated for our enterprise customers — and for the engineering organization that delivers that capability.

You will define and implement the technical strategy that turns Firefly Foundry from a managed service for early-design partners into a platform capable of serving hundreds of enterprise customers concurrently — each with their own IP, tenancy boundaries, and SLAs — powering everything from franchise extensions and new IP development to modern GenAI workflows at production scale. Specifically, you will: 

  • Set the engineering operating model for productionizing custom generative models across image, video, and 3D — including the architectural patterns that simplify pipeline construction and let us absorb a heterogeneous mix of internal and external models without linear engineering cost. 
  • Own the unit economics of Firefly Foundry inference. Cost-to-serve, GPU utilization, and gross margin on the managed service are your numbers. 
  • Define the tenancy and data-isolation architecture that lets us honor enterprise IP contracts under audit. 
  • Drive the self-serve roadmap that broadens Firefly Foundry’s reach and value beyond hands-on engagements. 
  • Represent Adobe engineering in C-suite and senior technical conversations with studios, brands, and global enterprises — including VPs of Production, CTOs, and Chief Digital Officers.

  • Applied Science — to ensure inference quality matches the training environment, and to make prioritization calls on emerging techniques for multimedia  
  • Firefly Foundry Studio — to translate ambitious creative visions into reliable, high-performance ML systems that transform how content is conceived, produced, and delivered, and into concrete roadmaps with clear milestones and success metrics.

  • AI Platform, and adjacent Adobe orgs — to negotiate shared infrastructure, accelerator capacity, and serving primitives at platform scale. 
  • Strategic partners — including GPU vendors and hyperscalers, where capacity planning, roadmap alignment, and partnership economics are part of your remit.

Build and lead the engineering organization 

  • Lead a multi-team engineering organization of ML engineers and engineering managers; recruit, hire, develop, and retain senior technical and leadership talent, and build a culture of engineering rigor and delivery discipline. 
  • Hiring at scale is a material part of this role — Firefly Foundry is growing rapidly, and sustaining scaling momentum depends on it. You will integrate top technical and leadership talent into the organization at the pace the business demands.

Define and own the technical strategy 

  • Own the multi-year architecture for training and inference at scale: pipeline construction, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, model lifecycle management, and accelerator utilization (CUDA, NCCL, and the wider GPU stack). 
  • Set the strategy for fast model deployment, parallel pipeline operation at scale, tenancy/data isolation, and self-serve capability buildout. 
  • Make the build-vs-buy and prioritization calls on emerging GenAI techniques in partnership with Applied Science, based on material improvements in capability, cost, or speed. 

Own production reliability and economics 

  • Hold the line on production SLAs for orchestrated and deployed model services. 
  • Own analytics and observability across every model pipeline — quality, latency, cost, and utilization. 
  • Drive cost-to-serve down on a multi-year curve while expanding capability. 

Drive customer and partner outcomes 

  • Represent engineering in technical customer engagements with enterprise customers — translating creative and business requirements into ML roadmaps, milestones, and success metrics. 
  • Co-design scalable, cost-efficient serving for real-time on-set use cases and high-volume social content generation, in partnership with infrastructure and platform teams. 
  • Steward the GPU vendor and hyperscaler relationships that underwrite Firefly Foundry’s serving capacity. 

What you bring 

Leadership scope 

  • 10+ years in applied machine learning and ML systems, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations — with prior experience leading managers of managers. 
  • Demonstrated success shipping generative AI products in production at enterprise scale. 
  • Proven ability to operate as a peer to VP-level partners across product, science, infrastructure, and field organizations, and to represent engineering credibly in front of senior customer and partner executives. 
  • Track record of building engineering benches, defining career frameworks for emerging roles, and developing leaders who themselves become directors. 

Technical judgment 

  • Deep understanding of the modern generative model landscape (diffusion, transformers, VAEs, latent video models, control/adapters, or similar) — enough to make architecture, investment, and prioritization calls with confidence, in close partnership with Applied Science. 
  • Strong intuition for the economics and engineering reality of large-scale inference: accelerator stacks, model optimization and quantization, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and cost. 
  • Experience designing and operating ML systems end-to-end — data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — at production scale. 
  • Familiarity with high-resolution media pipelines (4K+ video, high bit-depth) or adjacent bandwidth- and latency-sensitive domains is a meaningful plus. 

Communication and judgment 

  • Executive presence and communication skills — able to brief executives, customers, and partners credibly, and to work directly with creative, production, and business collaborators to turn ambiguous problems into clear technical plans. 
  • Sound judgment under ambiguity — comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and revising as new information arrives. 

Education 

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and leading advanced ML systems.

The Opportunity 

Firefly Foundry is Adobe’s enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer’s IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment, marketing, and consumer retail, and is expanding rapidly into adjacent verticals. 

We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build the pipelines and services that turn Firefly Foundry’s models into reliable, enterprise-grade products. You will compose heterogeneous model pipelines including finetuned LLMs, image and video generation models, 3D mesh reconstruction, up-samplers, NSFW and safety checkers, and IP guardrail models — deploy them as services, scale those services to enterprise traffic, and design them to meet target latency and throughput budgets, all while ensuring served quality matches the training and reference environment. Across this work you will integrate and operate multiple, distinct generative model architectures, in a mix that evolves quickly. 

This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving environment, with direct, measurable impact on the latency, cost, and quality of everything Firefly Foundry ships. Depending on your focus area, you may own externalizable data pipelines for self-serve fine-tuning, optimized VLM deployments for media intelligence and querying, or the platform that lets the team deploy new pipelines rapidly with full observability. 

What you will do 

  • Own the full serving lifecycle for heterogeneous model pipelines — packaging, versioned rollout, canary/rollback, and autoscaling — from research checkpoint to enterprise endpoint. 
  • Deploy these pipelines as services and scale them to enterprise traffic, meeting target latency and throughput budgets. 
  • Ensure served quality matches the training and reference environment — closing train/serve gaps across precision, preprocessing, and model versions. 
  • Engineer for enterprise from the ground up: tenancy boundaries, data isolation, and the controls that let us honor customer IP contracts under audit. 
  • Build the platform underneath it all — rapid pipeline deployment, observability, monitoring, and alerting. 
  • Define and enforce quality gates in the deployment pipeline – automated eval, regression detection, and drift monitoring that block bad model versions from reaching production.  
  • Own GPU capacity and cost – utilization, batching efficiency, and right-sizing acceleration fleets against latency SLAs.  
  • Run production ML operationally – on-call, incident response, an dpostmortems for availability and latency regressions  

Depending on your focus area, you may also: 

  • Build externalizable data pipelines that power self-serve fine-tuning flows for enterprise customers. 
  • Stand up optimized VLM deployments for media intelligence and content querying. 

Who you will partner with 

  • Applied Science — to take research models into reliable, high-throughput serving and to keep served quality faithful to the training environment. 
  • ML Engineering leadership and AI Platform — on shared infrastructure, accelerator capacity, and serving primitives at platform scale. 
  • Firefly Foundry Studio — to translate creative production workflows into performant, dependable ML services. 

What you bring 

  • 5+ years in machine learning engineering, with significant ownership of production ML or inference services at scale. 
  • Strong Python and deep-learning engineering skills (PyTorch), with hands-on experience deploying and scaling model-backed services. 
  • Experience composing multi-model pipelines and serving them behind APIs — orchestration, batching, autoscaling, and version management. 
  • A track record building the observability, monitoring, and alerting that production services rely on to hit latency and throughput targets. 
  • Comfort working across multiple, distinct generative model architectures (LLMs and VLMs, diffusion and transformer models, 3D/mesh) — enough to integrate, optimize, and reason about output quality, in partnership with Applied Science. 
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems and data isolation in an enterprise or regulated context. 
  • Fluency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD for ML, and a major cloud (AWS or Azure). 
  • GPU inference optimization for latency and cost — quantization, batching, and serving runtimes; custom CUDA a plus. 
  • Strong, data-driven problem-solving and excellent communication in cross-functional teams. 

Education 

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience building and operating production ML systems.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join the Adobe Home Surfaces team. You will help with the mission of building delightful, personalized experiences to help customers discover and manage Adobe apps.

In this high impact role, you’ll help define a strategy and roadmap for the App Catalog on Home. This will improve the workflows of millions of our members. Our hardworking team of designers, developers, and product managers work closely together to create coherent and meaningful experiences.

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to recognize root causes of business and system challenges and convert them into actionable solutions

  • Experience managing products through full lifecycle (discovery → definition → delivery → release → optimization)
  • Strong focus on detail with the capability to handle dependencies, risks, and delivery schedules
  • Ability to balance run-the-business priorities with central initiatives

About the Role 

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to join the new Project Graph services team at Adobe.   

 

Project Graph is a new creative system that lets you combine first and third-party AI models, Adobe tools, and custom interactive components inside a visual, designer-friendly node graph editor. Connect a library of tactile, interactive components that bring creative control of AI back to your fingertips. Transform ideas into powerful workflows and modular tools that run anywhere, from the web to Adobe apps like Photoshop. And if you’d rather focus on creating than building, you can tap into a growing ecosystem of community-built tools without ever opening the editor. 

 

The services team focuses on developing HTTP APIs for two primary uses: (1) managing Graph plugins, their versioning, publishing, access control and search, (2) async compute platform for running Graphs on the cloud. 

 

In this backend-focused role, you will play a key role in developing HTTP APIs, working closely with cluster orchestrators like Kubernetes, and building on top of AWS cloud infrastructure. 

 

What you'll do:  

  • Collaboratively write scalable, resilient HTTP APIs for Project Graph 

  • Contribute to an async job scheduling system built on top of Kubernetes and Postgres 

  • Design and implement cloud infrastructure to meet reliability, performance and cost goals 
      

What you need to succeed:  

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science. 

  • 5-10 years of backend software development experience. 

  • Strong hands-on experience in any server-side language; we use Node.js/Typescript. 

  • Expertise with Kubernetes. 

  • Experience with Postgres, Redis, or other data stores. 

  • Experience with Terraform and AWS. 

  • Experience with bash and CI/CD tools, like CircleCI. 

  • Expertise in HTTP API security 

  • An interest in and ability to learn new technologies. 

  • Ability to tackle problems in a sustainable way, always striving to improve our processes and learn. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; can effectively articulate complex ideas and influence others through well-reasoned explanations.

Senior Director, M&A Integration (Corporate Development)

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Corporate Development Integration (CDI) team consists of a small but mighty group of professionals responsible for pre-merger operational diligence, integration strategy and post-merger integration planning and execution. We are seeking an Executive Senior Director of M&A Integration to play a central role in translating acquisitions into business impact. You will work at the center of Adobe’s most strategic transactions—partnering with senior leaders to shape how deals are implemented and how value is realized. You will lead Adobe’s M&A Integration function within Corporate Development, reporting to the VP of Corporate Development.

We’re looking for an experienced executive leader who excels in partnering cross-functionally and influencing in a complex, fast-paced environment. This leader is strategically and operationally focused; has strong commercial and strategic judgment and can lead multiple integration efforts simultaneously while ensuring acquisition targets meet/exceed deal value drivers.

This executive appointment will be responsible for crafting and driving integration strategy and execution across Adobe’s acquisitions—working in close partnership with Corporate Development, business unit and functional leaders. Success in this role depends on deep operational experience, strong executive credibility, and execution leadership.

The Senior Director of M&A Integration will provide trusted counsel to deal teams and senior leaders, ensuring acquisitions are well-executed and aligned to their strategic intent. He/she/they will lead a high-performing team of integration leads, developing and growing this team by acting as a mentor and player/coach.

What you will do

Team and Function Leadership

  • Lead and scale the integration function by managing independent deal leads, coaching high-performing teams, evolving playbooks and tools, and bringing external standards to improve consistency, speed, and value capture

  • Manage relationships with third parties for surge capacity and expertise

Strategy and Diligence

  • Act as a senior advisor on complex, high-impact transactions and influence how integrations are planned and executed

  • Set integration strategy across the deal lifecycle by aligning deal thesis, value drivers, and execution priorities

  • Shape integration hypotheses during diligence, assess risks and trade-offs, and inform deal structuring and decision-making

  • Create clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving situations by defining integration approach, sequencing, priorities, and key decisions

Execution and Value Realization

  • Translate deal intent into executable integration plans with clear ownership, milestones, governance, and success metrics

  • Drive value realization by identifying risks early, mitigating issues proactively, and establishing operating cadences that enable timely decisions

  • Lead multiple concurrent integrations across deal types and stages while maintaining focus on strategic and financial outcomes

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Influence without direct authority by aligning stakeholders, resolving trade-offs, and driving high-quality decisions at key inflection points

  • Orchestrate cross-functional integration across Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, HR, Legal, and IT, removing dependencies and accelerating execution

  • Establish governance, decision forums, and executive transparency into progress, risks, and trade-offs to support speed and accountability

What You Need to Succeed

  • 15+ years leading M&A integration, consulting, or enterprise transformation across complex deal types

  • Proven leadership of complex integrations in global, matrixed, product-led organizations

  • Strategic operator who converts strategy into execution, creates clarity in ambiguity, and delivers results in high-stakes environments

  • Track record influencing senior leaders and aligning cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market

  • Proven people leader who builds, develops, and inspires high-performing multidisciplinary teams

  • A combination of confidence with humility and a growth mindset to be open to learning in a constantly evolving environment

  • Executive communicator with the presence and credibility to build trust quickly across senior leaders and partners

  • Leads complex programs across multiple workstreams, establishes strong operating rhythms, and delivers against operational and program goals

  • Exercises strong judgment, drives timely decisions, and navigates competing priorities with a bias for action

  • Strong command of M&A tools and data rooms, with high standards for performance, accountability, and impact

  • Knowledgeable, preferably well versed, in AI and application of AI in M&A, with a passion for continuous learning

Role overview As our footprint on YouTube grows from supporting cutdowns into YouTube-first content, episodic shows, originals, and discovery-optimized content, we need a strategist fully dedicated to the platform. This person owns how we show up on YouTube end to end: channel strategy, content programming, creative direction, rollout, and audience growth. They are the in-house authority on what works on YouTube and they translate that into briefs, plans, and decisions the rest of the social team can complete. What you’ll own YouTube channel strategy. Define the channel’s positioning, content pillars, and programming model across long-form, Shorts, and live. Build the strategy for YouTube-first content, recurring installments, presentations, and original works. Creative strategy input. Partner alongside creative strategists to compose briefs so that concepts are built for YouTube from the beginning, not adapted after the fact. Translate platform mechanics (packaging, hooks, retention, pacing) into creative direction. Creative briefing. Brief creatives on YouTube-specific creative: thumbnails, titles, intros, episode structure, series formatting, and the differences between extended videos, short clips, and live broadcasts. Rollout and launch planning. Develop rollout strategies for new series, shows, and originals: programming cadence, sequencing, cross-platform support, and launch moments. Audience growth and engagement. Develop engagement and community strategies that grow subscribers, returning viewers, and watch time. Define how we use comments, community posts, premieres, and live. Discovery and optimization. Own YouTube search and suggested strategy. Manage packaging optimization, playlist organization, and channel layout. Structure content to be discoverable and citable through AI and answer engines (LLM-optimized content). What you’ll do day to day Develop and maintain the YouTube content and programming calendar. Write YouTube strategy docs and feed requirements into creative strategist briefs. Brief and review creative for platform fit before it ships. Develop rollout plans for launches and recurring programming. Analyze channel and video performance and turn findings into recommendations. Partner with the social planner on scheduling and the creative team on execution. Stay ahead of YouTube format, algorithm, and monetization shifts and advise the team accordingly. What you bring 5+ years in YouTube, video, or content strategy, with a track record of growing channels or launching series and outstanding creative work. Deep YouTube proficiency: algorithm and discovery mechanics, packaging (titles and thumbnails), retention and average view duration, Shorts vs long-form vs live, playlists, and channel architecture. Strong analytics skills. Comfortable in YouTube Studio and reading retention curves and traffic source data to drive decisions. Experience briefing creative teams and partnering with creative strategists. You can translate platform insight into clear creative direction. Understanding of episodic and original content programming, including cadence, season structure, and host or talent collaboration. Working knowledge of search and discovery optimization, including structuring content for AI and answer-engine visibility. full_job_description_raw:
Role overview

As our footprint on YouTube grows from supporting cutdowns into YouTube-first content, episodic shows, originals, and discovery-optimized content, we need a strategist fully dedicated to the platform. This person owns how we show up on YouTube end to end: channel strategy, content programming, creative direction, rollout, and audience growth. They are the in-house authority on what works on YouTube and they translate that into briefs, plans, and decisions the rest of the social team can complete.

What you’ll own

YouTube channel strategy. Define the channel’s positioning, content pillars, and programming model across long-form, Shorts, and live. Build the strategy for YouTube-first content, recurring installments, presentations, and original works. Creative strategy input. Partner alongside creative strategists to compose briefs so that concepts are built for YouTube from the beginning, not adapted after the fact. Translate platform mechanics (packaging, hooks, retention, pacing) into creative direction. Creative briefing. Brief creatives on YouTube-specific creative: thumbnails, titles, intros, episode structure, series formatting, and the differences between extended videos, short clips, and live broadcasts. Rollout and launch planning. Develop rollout strategies for new series, shows, and originals: programming cadence, sequencing, cross-platform support, and launch moments. Audience growth and engagement. Develop engagement and community strategies that grow subscribers, returning viewers, and watch time. Define how we use comments, community posts, premieres, and live. Discovery and optimization. Own YouTube search and suggested strategy. Manage packaging optimization, playlist organization, and channel layout. Structure content to be discoverable and citable through AI and answer engines (LLM-optimized content).

What you’ll do day to day

  • Develop and maintain the YouTube content and programming calendar.

  • Write YouTube strategy docs and feed requirements into creative strategist briefs.

  • Brief and review creative for platform fit before it ships.

  • Develop rollout plans for launches and recurring programming.

  • Analyze channel and video performance and turn findings into recommendations.

  • Partner with the social planner on scheduling and the creative team on execution.

  • Stay ahead of YouTube format, algorithm, and monetization shifts and advise the team accordingly.

What you bring

5+ years in YouTube, video, or content strategy, with a track record of growing channels or launching series and outstanding creative work. Deep YouTube proficiency: algorithm and discovery mechanics, packaging (titles and thumbnails), retention and average view duration, Shorts vs long-form vs live, playlists, and channel architecture. Strong analytics skills. Comfortable in YouTube Studio and reading retention curves and traffic source data to drive decisions. Experience briefing creative teams and partnering with creative strategists. You can translate platform insight into clear creative direction. Understanding of episodic and original content programming, including cadence, season structure, and host or talent collaboration. Working knowledge of search and discovery optimization, including structuring content for AI and answer-engine visibility.

We're seeking an experienced M&A Finance Integration Lead to support the Chief Accounting Officer (CAO) organization across the full M&A deal lifecycle. This impactful role translates deal objectives, diligence findings, Go-To-Market (GTM) and product strategy, and Finance priorities into a clear integration approach. It also defines a roadmap and choices needed to enable successful execution. This skilled professional will lead cross-functional planning across Pricing Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, Order Management, Product Delivery, Revenue, and broader Finance/CAO partners. They'll add structure in ambiguous deal environments, connect cross-functional dependencies, and enable executive decision-making to drive M&A integration priorities. This role can be based in our San Jose, CA or Lehi, UT office locations and will work a hybrid schedule (3 in office days per week). In this role, you will Lead and manage end to end execution of new M&A transactions, from pre-close integration planning to post-merger integration execution for all Finance workstreams including defining the order-to-cash process integration strategy, roadmap, sequencing, and operating model decisions required to support deal priorities and value realization. Facilitate working sessions and executive forums to clarify tradeoffs, resolve open questions, and drive timely decisions. Partner with cross-functional teams like GTM, Product, Legal and IT to align scope, dependencies, risks, timelines, and decision owners. Maintain coordinated work plans, RAID logs, decision trackers, and executive-ready readouts that build transparency and drive accountability. Capture lessons learned and improve Finance and Q2C integration playbooks, templates, and operating rhythms for future acquisitions. Develop and maintain integration-related key performance indicators to measure the efficiency of transaction-value drivers. Work hand in hand with Senior Leaders, business and functional leaders to ensure alignment across the operating model, integration approach and organizational structure for each deal to drive execution and efficiencies. Drive integration plans, coordinate cross-functional teams, run regular integration meetings and drive proactive issue resolution. Build trusted and strong working relationships with all partners. What You Need To Succeed Experienced professional with 10 + years of relevant experience, demonstrated success in Global M&A and large-scale integrations, proven ability to lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams. Strong Finance competence across Finance workstreams (e.g. Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Global Source to Pay, Payroll, Q2C and Equity). Strong Q2C acumen including how commercial, operational, legal, product, systems and revenue decisions connect across the end-to-end lifecycle. Manage critical Q2C handoffs across pricing/SKU setup, deal approvals, contracting, order management, provisioning, invoicing, billing, and revenue recognition. Ability to create structure in ambiguity, synthesize complex inputs, and turn broad strategic goals into executable plans and executive-level content. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Hands-on program leadership style with strong ownership of planning, dependency management, critical issues, communication, and outcome tracking. Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment, while proactively addressing and resolving challenges arising from uncertainty. Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization. Senior TPRM Consultant (Partner Engagements) Location: 1540 Broadway, New York, NY 10036 Department: Corporate Controllership – Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Reports to: Director of Third-Party Risk Governance & Awareness Position Summary: The Senior TPRM Consultant is responsible for supporting the development and management of the TPRM Program framework, specifically for the sales partner ecosystem (e.g., solution partners, system integrators, resellers and distributors). This role sits at the intersection of risk management, sales, legal, and sales operations — and requires someone who can independently drive risk conversations forward , not simply administer a process. Success in this role depends on your ability to lead — setting the agenda, holding partners and internal stakeholders accountable to timelines, and driving issues to closure. The role supports the design, maintenance, and enforcement of TPRM policy, standards, and governance. In close partnership with risk domain leads and cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps advance program maturity, support regulatory alignment, and strengthen third-party risk practices across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities: Manage the TPRM governance committees, including preparing materials and strategizing focused agendas that drive risk identification, mitigation, and oversight. Set the TPRM governance framework by defining roles and responsibilities to ensure appropriate oversight of third-party engagements and manage associated risks; and enhancing risk treatment / risk acceptance processes. Determine and establish program metrics, including key performance and risk indicators (KPIs/KRIs) to enable effective oversight of the TPRM program. Maintain TPRM policies, procedures, and governance documentation to reflect regulatory changes and evolving industry standards. Lead the management and oversight of third-party risk management control requirements and framework. Support the development of board and senior management materials that clearly communicate TPRM objectives, priorities, and program health using metrics and thresholds. Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of Adobe’s TPRM governance framework to strengthen risk management across all third-party relationships. Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Sales, Sales Ops, Compliance, Procurement, Security) to ensure consistent application of TPRM policies and risk requirements. Collaborate with the TPRM Training & Awareness Manager to design and deliver training and awareness materials that reinforce policy compliance and third-party lifecycle management. Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of TPRM tools, technology, and workflows (e.g., GRC platforms). Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field. 5–7 years of experience in third-party risk management, governance, compliance, or related oversight roles with at minimum, 2 years of experience driving and managing projects or programs. Strong understanding of third-party risk management and risk management fundamentals. Familiarity with regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., FCPA / UK Bribery Act, GDPR, NIST RMF, ISO 27001) and third-party risk management tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex risk data and synthesize into clear, actionable insights. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Solid understanding of related risk domains: regulatory, channel, fraud, information security, business continuity, data privacy, financial risk, and concentration risk. Preferred Qualifications: Professional certifications (e.g., CTPRP, CRISC, CISA, PMP). Prior experience in TPRM 2nd line function team and/or from one of the Big4. Experience with sales partner and fourth-party/subcontractor risks. Senior TPRM Consultant (Partner Engagements)

Location: 1540 Broadway, New York, NY 10036
Department: Corporate Controllership – Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)
Reports to: Director of Third-Party Risk Governance & Awareness

Position Summary:

The Senior TPRM Consultant is responsible for supporting the development and management of the TPRM Program framework, specifically for the sales partner ecosystem (e.g., solution partners, system integrators, resellers and distributors). This role sits at the intersection of risk management, sales, legal, and sales operations — and requires someone who can independently drive risk conversations forward, not simply administer a process. Success in this role depends on your ability to lead — setting the agenda, holding partners and internal stakeholders accountable to timelines, and driving issues to closure.

The role supports the design, maintenance, and enforcement of TPRM policy, standards, and governance. In close partnership with risk domain leads and cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps advance program maturity, support regulatory alignment, and strengthen third-party risk practices across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the TPRM governance committees, including preparing materials and strategizing focused agendas that drive risk identification, mitigation, and oversight.
  • Set the TPRM governance framework by defining roles and responsibilities to ensure appropriate oversight of third-party engagements and manage associated risks; and enhancing risk treatment / risk acceptance processes.
  • Determine and establish program metrics, including key performance and risk indicators (KPIs/KRIs) to enable effective oversight of the TPRM program.
  • Maintain TPRM policies, procedures, and governance documentation to reflect regulatory changes and evolving industry standards.
  • Lead the management and oversight of third-party risk management control requirements and framework.
  • Support the development of board and senior management materials that clearly communicate TPRM objectives, priorities, and program health using metrics and thresholds.
  • Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of Adobe’s TPRM governance framework to strengthen risk management across all third-party relationships.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Sales, Sales Ops, Compliance, Procurement, Security) to ensure consistent application of TPRM policies and risk requirements.
  • Collaborate with the TPRM Training & Awareness Manager to design and deliver training and awareness materials that reinforce policy compliance and third-party lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of TPRM tools, technology, and workflows (e.g., GRC platforms).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in third-party risk management, governance, compliance, or related oversight roles with at minimum, 2 years of experience driving and managing projects or programs.
  • Strong understanding of third-party risk management and risk management fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., FCPA / UK Bribery Act, GDPR, NIST RMF, ISO 27001) and third-party risk management tools.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex risk data and synthesize into clear, actionable insights.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Solid understanding of related risk domains: regulatory, channel, fraud, information security, business continuity, data privacy, financial risk, and concentration risk.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications (e.g., CTPRP, CRISC, CISA, PMP).
  • Prior experience in TPRM 2nd line function team and/or from one of the Big4.
  • Experience with sales partner and fourth-party/subcontractor risks.

The Opportunity 
Our iOS mobile team is part of the Adobe Video organization, where we build video creation and editing experiences for storytellers across desktop, mobile, and web. We move fast, care deeply about craft—and we’re hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to help lead that work on iOS! 

We want someone who will help define both what we build and how we build it. That includes establishing modern engineering practices and embracing AI‑assisted development to improve quality and speed. We’re looking for a manager who empowers their team to ship great iOS experiences while encouraging use of AI tools to move fast. 
 

We think you’ll thrive here if you bring people leadership and technical fluency. You communicate clearly across disciplines. And you enjoy working through trade‑offs with engineers and product partners to deliver the best outcome for customers. 

What You’ll Do 

You’ll lead, grow, and support a talented team of senior iOS engineers. Together, we build creative, user‑facing features—from early product and interaction design through execution and production quality. You’ll set technical and quality standards for the iOS organization. That means ensuring architectural coherence, maintainability, and performance across the codebase. 

We also need someone who can coach engineers on effective use of AI‑assisted development tools and agentic workflows. You’ll help the team accelerate responsibly while maintaining rigorous standards for code quality, correctness, and security. 

You’ll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape product strategy. We want a collaborator who brings a clear technical and UX perspective—not just resourcing or delivery plans. You’ll guide the team in making thoughtful scope and priority decisions, balancing user impact, velocity, and long‑term technical health. 

We believe great products come from safe‑to‑experiment cultures. You’ll create that environment: validating assumptions early, learning from real user feedback, and treating each release as a chance to improve. You’ll develop talent through regular feedback, mentorship, and career growth conversations. And you’ll represent our iOS team in org‑level planning, advocating for investment, technical excellence, and a user‑centered approach! 

What We’re Looking For 

  • 5+ years of experience shipping Apple applications, with significant time delivering complex, production‑scale iOS products. 

  • Experience managing and growing teams of senior engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. 

  • Technical fluency in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and the iOS SDK. You can review, guide, and influence architectural decisions even when not coding daily. 

  • Product instincts and UX sensibility—familiarity with Apple Human Interface Guidelines, a keen eye for interaction quality, and a feel for why details matter to users. 

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces. You help teams move from unclear problem statements to crisp execution plans. 

  • Experience using AI‑assisted development tools at a team level—setting expectations, workflows, and guardrails for AI‑generated output. 

  • A clear, compelling communicator who translates between technical, product, and design perspectives. 

  • An understanding of mobile video editing workflows—or the curiosity and drive to develop that understanding quickly. 

Even Better If You Have 

A track record of influencing product direction, technical strategy, or design outcomes beyond your immediate team. Experience evolving engineering processes on growing teams (quality, reliability, release management). Experience building creative tools, video production software, or editing workflows. Hands‑on experience using video editing applications, with an appreciation for creative users’ needs. Familiarity with modern AI‑enabled developer tooling and practices. 

Why Adobe Video? 

We offer a small-team environment with big ownership — you'll work at the intersection of world-class creative software and AI-augmented engineering. We invest in our people with industry-leading benefits, including comprehensive health coverage, generous equity, flexible time off, and access to Adobe's full suite of creative tools. We believe diverse perspectives make our products better, and we're committed to building a team where everyone can do the best work of their careers. 

Are you ready to shape tools used by millions of creators worldwide? We'd love to hear from you

Content Operations Lead, AI Studio

Job Description

The Opportunity

Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.

This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.

What You’ll Do

Drive Programs and Unblock the Team

  • Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
  • Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
  • Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
  • Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

Own Data, Workflow, and Tooling

  • Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
  • Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
  • Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
  • Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

Support Creative Quality and Output

  • Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
  • Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
  • Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.

Be the Team’s Connective Tissue

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
  • Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
  • Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
  • Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
  • A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
  • Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
  • A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.
  • Experience in digital marketing, advertising production, or campaign operations is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and timelines are rarely forgiving.

full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a technically strong, AI-augmented QE/SDET who can build and scale quality engineering for a rendering-heavy web application. The ideal candidate brings strong QA judgment, understands product risk, and knows how to use AI tooling to accelerate test creation, debugging, triage, documentation, and coverage analysis without sacrificing test reliability. This role focuses on scalable automation, UI testing, visual regression, CI/CD execution, and debugging across React UI, canvas/WebGL/WebGPU surfaces, C++/native rendering layers, cloud-based test artifacts, visual baseline storage, and GPU-enabled test environments.

Core Testing

 

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated UI test suites using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, with Playwright preferred, including scalable architecture such as Page Object Models, fixtures, reusable helpers, and clear locator strategies
  • Strong QA mindset with risk-based prioritization, including the ability to identify high-risk rendering paths, async flows, cross-browser surfaces, edge cases, user-impact areas, and gaps between manual coverage and automation coverage
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar systems to plan, generate, refactor, debug, and validate test code while keeping the output maintainable, trustworthy, and aligned with repo-specific patterns
  • Experience guiding AI output with clear prompts, repo context, coding standards, reusable test patterns, and review loops rather than relying on one-off generated code.
  • Strong judgment around test signal quality, including the ability to identify flaky tests, weak assertions, noisy coverage, and AI-generated tests that do not validate meaningful product behavior
  • Strong experience with visual regression testing for both standard DOM UI and rendering-heavy surfaces such as canvas, WebGL, or WebGPU, including baseline management and diff review using tools such as Playwright, Percy, Chromatic, or Storybook to catch unintended rendering changes
  • Experience with test tiering strategies such as smoke, integration, regression, and nightly suites, with the ability to balance coverage, runtime, and PR feedback speed
  • Ability to write component-level tests using React Testing Library or Jest
  • Knowledge of agentic testing workflows using tools such as Playwright MCP, custom AI agents, subagents, or similar automation-assistive workflows is a plus

Rendering & Frontend-Specific

 

  • Understanding of React component lifecycle, state management, and how rendering changes affect the UI
  • Experience testing across browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) and screen sizes for cross-browser/responsive rendering issues
  • Experience testing canvas/WebGL/WebGPU applications where DOM selectors may not apply, including coordinate-based interactions, timing-sensitive behavior, screenshot validation, state-based validation, and internal state checks
  • Familiarity with measuring rendering performance for interactive UI or canvas-based experiences, such as frame rate, frame timing, memory growth, or responsiveness
  • Familiarity with CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, or other styling systems to identify layout and style regressions

Debugging & Tooling

 

  • Proficient with browser DevTools for inspecting DOM, layout shifts, paint/render performance, and console errors
  • Experience using Lighthouse or Web Vitals to assess rendering performance, including LCP, CLS, and INP/FID
  • Ability to reproduce and isolate rendering bugs tied to async data loading, animations, or conditional rendering
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate log analysis, failure summaries, triage, debugging hypotheses, and root-cause investigation while still validating findings through code, artifacts, and reproducible evidence

C++ & Native Layer Testing

 

  • Experience writing and running C++ unit and integration tests using frameworks like Google Test (gtest) or Catch2
  • Ability to test and validate C++ modules or native bindings that interface with the web frontend (e.g., via WebAssembly or Node.js native addons)
  • Familiarity with memory management concepts (leaks, dangling pointers, undefined behavior) and tools like Valgrind, AddressSanitizer, or clang-tidy to catch low-level defects
  • Experience debugging C++ code using GDB, LLDB, or Visual Studio debugger to trace issues that surface in the rendered UI
  • Understanding of how C++ backend or rendering engine code (e.g., a native graphics or layout engine) contributes to frontend output, and how to isolate failures across the stack

Collaboration & Process

 

  • Comfortable reading and reviewing React component code to identify testability gaps or risky rendering logic
  • Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar systems, including visual, functional, and native tests on PRs before merge and scheduled runs against different environments
  • Familiarity with artifact storage and visual baseline storage using cloud services such as AWS S3, as well as specialized CI environments such as GPU-enabled runners, is a plus
  • Ability to triage bugs across the C++/web boundary and communicate findings clearly to both frontend and systems engineers
  • Works closely with developers, designers, PMs, and QA team members to prioritize coverage based on product risk and user impact
