Title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer  

Employee Role: Individual Contributor  

The Opportunity   

Adobe’s Database Reliability Engineering (DBRE) team enables product teams to build and operate services at scale through reliable, secure, and highly automated database platforms. We combine platform engineering, automation, and outstanding operational performance to reduce complexity and accelerate developer efficiency. We are seeking an experienced DBRE to help define the future of Adobe’s data platform ecosystem.  

What you'll Do   

  • Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Adobe’s database platforms, enabling highly available and resilient services on a global scale.  

  • Drive the evolution of database architecture and platform strategy through collaboration with engineering teams, cloud providers, and database technology partners.  

  • Build self-service and automated platform capabilities that simplify the deployment, provisioning, and operation of database infrastructure.  

  • Establish best-in-class observability through monitoring, tracing, logging, and actionable insights that improve service reliability and outstanding operational performance.  

  • Serve as a technical leader during production events, driving rapid mitigation, deep root cause analysis, and long-term resiliency improvements through automation and self-healing systems.  

  • Provide operational stewardship for business-critical database services through participation in a cross-regional follow-the-sun support model.  

What you need to succeed   

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.  

  • 7+ years operating highly available, critical database platforms at scale.   

  • Strong hands-on experience with two or more of: MongoDB, Cassandra, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Percona XtraDB Cluster, or MariaDB Galera Cluster.  

  • Experience operating database platforms on AWS and/or Azure.  

  • Hands-on experience with managed database services such as Amazon RDS, Keyspaces, DynamoDB, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and MongoDB Atlas.  

  • Proven experience leading database modernization and migration initiatives.  

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively employ AI-assisted development tools while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, reliability, and operational excellence.  

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools such as Terraform, Chef, or Ansible.  

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, including scaling, replication, consistency models, fault tolerance, and multi-region deployments.  

  • Expertise in database performance engineering, capacity planning, query tuning, index optimization, and storage performance.  

  • Strong data modeling, schema design, and data architecture skills.  

  • Experience with containerized and cloud-native platforms, including Kubernetes and Docker.  

  • Strong Linux systems and networking fundamentals.  

  • Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation and operational tooling.

About Frame.io
Frame.io is changing the future of how videos are made by helping over 1 million creative professionals seamlessly collaborate from all over the world.
Our mission is to power the world's video creation. We pour our soul into the Frame.io product to delight customers and make it easier for them to realize that mission.
About the role
As the product leaders of Frame.io, it is our job to ship the right product to the high standards we expect of ourselves, and to track its success after launch. We understand that a product isn't finished when it goes out the door.
We're looking for a product manager with relevant experience to join us. You'll be focused on Frame.io's core identity framework and the integration into Adobe's identity systems.
What you'll do

  • Define and improve identity-related user experiences, including authentication, account linking, migration flows, and admin-facing workflows
  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, Product, Sales, Legal, Security, Customer Support, Marketing and Leadership to rapidly identify and validate product opportunities
  • Break down product opportunities into clear, concrete units of work that can be used to support delivery
  • Specify the appropriate sequence and relative priority of product opportunities
  • Lead project management with your squad and external customers to ensure smooth product launch
  • Bring to bear data, strategic insight and context to influence team members and build consensus for key decisions
  • Positively contribute to Product Team culture and support peers or more junior Product Managers where appropriate

What you need to succeed

  • 2+ years of formal Product Management experience with identity, SaaS user management, authentication, permissions, provisioning, admin, or migration workflows. Knowledge of B2B authentication and SSO flows are desired but not required.
  • Experience in large scale data migrations within or across products, preferably involving identity data
  • You understand that identity product decisions carry security, privacy, compliance, and customer-trust implications, and you know when to bring Legal, Security, and enterprise stakeholders into the decision process.
  • You've taken an idea from its initial brief to design to development to QA to release. You're at ease project managing a product through this process and how to ensure that release dates are met
  • You are capable of making sound decisions with incomplete/ imperfect data, have experience assessing tradeoffs, thoughtfully prioritize, and move quickly on decisions
  • You communicate well. You explore your ideas through concise and thoughtful writing. You understand that half of the job is making sure the organization knows what your team is working on and how it will affect them
  • You're customer empathetic. You constantly look for ways to build customer understanding, whether through customer interviews or jumping into the support queue to solve real customer problems
  • You’re technically fluent. You can work with engineers to understand how identity data is modeled, how it flows through our systems, and where product decisions create technical tradeoffs, while leaving implementation details to engineering
  • You're a data-informed problem solver. You build hypotheses, test them with qualitative and quantitative evidence, and use tools like Amplitude, SQL, and Looker to understand whether a product decision achieved its intended outcome.

The Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) is Adobe's centralized fraud prevention and risk-decisioning platform, protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time decisions that minimize impact on the customer experience. As a Senior Software Engineer focused on Data Science and Platform Engineering, you'll build the ML models that detect and mitigate risk, fraud, and abuse, and also work on building the low-latency platform that serves them at scale across Adobe's most sensitive, highest-volume surfaces. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own the ML lifecycle end-to-end — data engineering, offline model development, and real-time inference — building the models that detect and stop fraud and abuse across our surfaces. • Turn behavioral, device, and transaction signals into features that sharpen detection. • Track precision, recall, false positives, and business impact, and experiment with new approaches (including LLMs and agentic AI) to catch more while reviewers do less. • Own the platform that serves those models in production, from APIs and SDKs to feature stores and the integration points that make onboarding new surfaces turnkey. Keep it fast, reliable, and scalable as usage grows. • Partner with fraud investigators, Trust & Safety, and platform teams to turn new fraud patterns into new defenses, fast. Experience working on risk mitigation is a plus. The Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) is Adobe's centralized fraud prevention and risk-decisioning platform, protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time decisions that minimize impact on the customer experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on Data Science and Platform Engineering, you'll build the ML models that detect and mitigate risk, fraud, and abuse, and also work on building the low-latency platform that serves them at scale across Adobe's most sensitive, highest-volume surfaces.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the ML lifecycle end-to-end — data engineering, offline model development, and real-time inference — building the models that detect and stop fraud and abuse across our surfaces.

• Turn behavioral, device, and transaction signals into features that sharpen detection.

• Track precision, recall, false positives, and business impact, and experiment with new approaches (including LLMs and agentic AI) to catch more while reviewers do less.

• Strong platform engineering skills: APIs, distributed services, and data pipelines built for scale and low latency.

• Curiosity to understand how abuse actually plays out in a workflow, not just how it looks in aggregate metrics — new patterns often show up in the field before they show up in the data.

title: Senior Software Engineer

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Pr incipal ML Engineer to architect and scale the multimodal data processing pipelines and infrastructure behind Adobe Firefly’s multimodal foundation models (image, video, audio). In this role, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and applied ML building distributed, GPU-accelerated systems that turn billions of raw assets into training-ready data at scale. Your wor k will directly determine how fast and how well Adobe models can learn directly impacted by the throughput and reliability of our data pipelines , and the quality of data that reaches training. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence across data, infrastructure, and modeling teams. ABOUT THE ROLE 

We’re looking for a Principal ML Engineer to architect and scale the multimodal data processing pipelines and infrastructure behind Adobe Firefly’s multimodal foundation models (image, video, audio). In this role, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and applied ML building distributed, GPU-accelerated systems that turn billions of raw assets into training-ready data at scale. 

Your work will directly determine how fast and how well Adobe models can learn directly impacted by the throughput and reliability of our data pipelines, and the quality of data that reaches training. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence across data, infrastructure, and modeling teams. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

OPTIMIZE DATA PROCESSING PIPELINES AT SCALE 

  • Architect and optimize large-scale distributed pipelines that process billions of images, video, and audio assets through ML workflows into training-ready data 

  • Scale up inference throughput across the pipeline (batching, parallelism, hardware utilization) to turn raw collected data into training data faster and more cheaply 

  • Identify and eliminate bottlenecks across ingestion, processing, and delivery, from storage and I/O to compute scheduling 

ARCHITECT SCALABLE DATA INFRASTRUCTURE 

  • Design systems that reliably store, index, and serve billions of data points, each requiring substantial processing spanning large-scale databases, distributed storage, and high-throughput compute 

  • Apply deep expertise in distributed systems and frameworks such as Ray (or equivalent) to orchestrate large-scale, GPU/CPU-heavy data workloads 

  • Own architecture decisions including database and storage choices, job scheduling, GPU cluster utilization that let the platform scale alongside data and model growth 

DRIVE DATA CURATION FOR MODEL TRAINING 

  • Bring a strong ML background, especially inference optimization for VLMs and LLMs and data curation for training 

  • Partner closely with modeling teams to understand what data improves training outcomes, and translate that into pipeline and curation requirements 

  • Operate as a hands-on technical leader who bridges data engineering and applied ML 

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED 

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or distributed systems, including work at large scale (billions of records or assets) 

  • Strong software engineering background, with hands-on expertise in distributed systems and frameworks such as Ray, Spark, or equivalent large-scale data processing frameworks 

  • Proficiency in Python, plus strong experience in a systems-level language (C++, Rust, Go, or Java) with strong debugging skills across distributed and ML-centric runtime environments. 

  • Deep knowledge of databases and storage systems at scale such as data lakes, indexing, and retrieval across billions of data points 

  • Strong ML background, particularly expertise in optimizing GPU inference pipelines for VLMs, LLMs, or other large models (batching, quantization, serving, throughput/latency tradeoffs) 

  • Experience with data curation for model training: understanding what makes data valuable for training generative or multimodal models, not just how to move it efficiently 

  • Comfort operating across the full stack, from low-level systems and GPU optimization to higher-level data strategy and curation decisions 

  • Ability to communicate clearly and partner effectively across data, infrastructure, and modeling teams 

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an iOS Engineer with strong programming fundamentals and keen attention to detail to help shape our flagship mobile

application. In this role, you’ll play a key part in designing, building, and maintaining user-facing features. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to create seamless experiences and contribute across our mobile tech stack.

• Develop and maintain iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C/C++, and various iOS frameworks, integrating with

RESTful APIs.

• Design and implement large user-facing features while contributing to overall software architecture.

• Lead code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.

• Work with collaborators to define the product roadmap and assess new platform technologies.

• Recommend improvements to app architecture, testing processes, and service integrations.

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code to ensure long-term stability and scalability.

Programming Skills: Proficient in Swift and Objective-C, with experience in SwiftUI. Familiarity with C++ or a desire to learn.

• Agility: Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, taking on multiple roles with autonomy and ownership.

• Source Control: Experienced in team-based development using modern source control systems like Git/GitHub.

• APIs: Skilled in integrating REST and/or GraphQL for efficient network communication.

• Debugging: Proficient in using developer tools like Instruments to diagnose memory and performance issues.

• Fundamentals: Strong grasp of architectural patterns (MVC, MVVM), design patterns, and object-oriented programming.

Develop and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs for document generation, template/asset management, job submission, and status/result retrieval—including auth, entitlements and usage metering, rate limiting, and versioning. Work with InDesign Server internals, scripting (UXP/ExtendScript), and plugin interfaces to build and troubleshoot automated rendering, pagination, and content-mapping workflows. Build reliable async job orchestration: queuing, polling, retries, partial-failure handling, and clear progress/status UX for long-running render jobs. Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing, code reviews, CI/CD hygiene, pragmatic tech-debt management. Mentor junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language/runtime (Node.js, Java, or similar), with solid component-based UI development and HTML/CSS. Comfort across the stack: from UI implementation to service design, data models, and deployment/infrastructure basics. Strong CS fundamentals, practical software design skills, and the ability to reason about performance and scale. Excellent communication; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones. Fluency using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery. Nice to have Experience with Adobe InDesign Server, InDesign scripting (UXP/ExtendScript), or plugin development (C++), or other document/layout automation platforms. Familiarity with print, packaging, or publishing workflows (templates, prepress, PDF/X, color management). Experience with containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes), job queues, and horizontally scaled render/worker fleets across regions.   • Adobe is seeking a Cash Manager to join our Treasury Operations team. In this role, you will support global cash management end-to-end, with an emphasis on North American cash operations, ensuring efficient liquidity execution, robust cash controls, and continuous optimization of our treasury processes. You will play a key role in safeguarding Adobe’s cash assets, strengthening our global banking infrastructure, and driving strategic improvements across Treasury. This role offers the opportunity to lead operational excellence while partnering with senior stakeholders and external banking partners to support Adobe’s global growth.

What you'll Do

  • Serve as primary owner of North American cash positioning and short-term investments; support regional treasury leads on global liquidity initiatives
  • Own the roadmap for treasury process transformation, from identifying manual/inefficient workflows through designing and implementing automated solutions in the TMS/ERP systems to improve efficiency and control
  • Manage and enhance cash forecasting processes, providing insights on cash flow trends and liquidity needs
  • Lead execution and oversight of same-day wires, ACH, and cross-border payments, ensuring proper controls and timely settlement
  • Oversee monthly restricted currency settlements and short-term funding, collaborating closely with Treasury, Accounting, and Tax
  • Drive cash reconciliations, month-end close activities, and treasury-related accounting entries to ensure accuracy and compliance
  • Act as the primary contact for global banking partners, managing relationships, resolving issues and negotiating service improvements.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to strengthen end-to-end cash processes and ensure compliance with treasury policies
  • Support internal and external audits, control testing, and regulatory reporting requirements

What you need to succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of professional experience in Corporate Treasury
  • Proven track record of leading process re-engineering or automation projects in a treasury or finance function (e.g., TMS implementation, workflow automation, straight-through processing improvements)
  • Strong knowledge of cash management, intercompany funding and dividends, foreign exchange operations, and treasury accounting
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Adobe Acrobat; experience with Treasury Management Systems (Kyriba and SAP preferred)
  • Highly organized with strong process rigor, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities

Strong communication and relationship management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders

It requires working at the crossroads of strategy, data, and hands-on work, with real sway over global advertising for a Fortune 500 company.

Lead and develop the team that converts marketing strategy into media plans for Adobe's Global audience segments (Business Professionals, Creative Professionals, and Creators).   • Take responsibility for the framework guiding this new team’s interaction with regional marketing leaders. Establish clear ways to handle critical issues, decision rights, and expectations. Schedule formal reviews every 3–6 months to ensure the approach is effective.
  • Collaborate with Adobe's media-buying team in India
  • Drive smarter audience targeting and data-sharing across regions and campaigns, and manage partnerships with ad platforms (to unlock better rates, credits, and support)
  • In partnership with Ops, set standards for how campaigns are tagged, organized, and quality-checked before they become available

Scope & Direct Reports

  • Director-level leader directly managing a global team of (6) Channel Planners
  • Americas-based, with monthly international trave to stay connected with in-market regional Channel Planners and local Media Strategy teams
  • Peers include the heads of regional marketing strategy groups and the leader of the India-based buying team
  • Works closely with (but doesn't directly manage) the buy desk, analytics, strategy, and engineering partners
  • Define how Adobe plans and accomplishes advertising campaigns for years to come, starting with paid social and growing from there
  • Balance consistent global standards with the reality that every region has different pricing, language, and regulatory needs

First 90-Day Deliverables:

  • Hire and build out the core team
  • Arrange routine meetings with regional marketing leaders, the new planning team, and the India-based buying team
  • Audit how campaigns currently get planned, tagged, and quality-checked
  • Stand up the playbook and process for how the planning team hands work to the buying team when there is a blocking issue

What you need to succeed

  • 10+ years in digital advertising/media, with 5+ years leading media buying or campaign execution teams
  • Proven track record building new teams or functions from scratch
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of digital ad platforms and the technology used to target audiences and measure campaigns
  • Experience standardizing how a media team operates across multiple regions or markets
  • Excellent skill at influencing collaborators and managing change — this role will need agreement from multiple regional leaders
  • Self-starter, comfortable both setting direction and rolling up their sleeves

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience working with Adobe's marketing and advertising tools specifically
  • Experience managing overseas or offshore execution teams
  • Experience across both business (B2B) and consumer advertising
  • Background connecting the planning side of advertising to the execution/buying side

description:
We build the agentic AI platform that Adobe teams use to get real work done — OneAI , our unified intelligence layer, along with the reusable skills, agents, and dashboards that run on top of it. You'll design and ship autonomous agents that connect to enterprise data (Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Slack, SharePoint) and turn natural-language questions into trustworthy, cited answers. This is a hands-on engineering role with room to grow. You'll own components end to end — from prototype to production — and see them adopted across business units. If you enjoy making AI systems that are genuinely reliable, well-governed, and fast, you'll fit in well here. What you'll do Build and productionize reusable agentic components — skills, orchestration workflows, and tool-calling integrations — that plug into OneAI's intelligence layer (Neo4j + pgvector + Databricks + Claude). Take AI models and agents from prototype to production, and keep them healthy once they're live. Improve how agents reason: prompt design, memory and context management, retrieval quality, and multi-step tool use. Tune for latency, reliability, and cost so the platform holds up as more teams rely on it. Partner with product managers and data engineers to shape what we build, and share what you learn with the team. Help raise the bar on evaluation — measure solve rates and accuracy, and use what you find to make the agents better. What you'll bring Around 3+ years building AI/ML or backend systems, including some experience running LLM-powered services in production. Strong fundamentals in Python and REST APIs. Familiarity with modern AI tooling — frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and vector databases. A habit of measuring quality and iterating, rather than shipping and hoping. Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes). Nice to have Experience with event streaming (Kafka, Flink, or Kinesis) and data pipelines (Spark or Databricks). Exposure to production operations — CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Interest in AI governance, safety, or evaluation. description:
The Challenge The Adobe Creative Community CCM organization is seeking an outstanding Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support innovation through machine learning, autonomous AI workflows, and cloud-native infrastructure. Adobe Stock gives designers and businesses access to hundreds of millions of curated, royalty-free assets that integrate directly with Adobe's desktop, mobile, and web apps, as well as Behance's creative community and Content's advanced services. Our infrastructure spans multiple cloud platforms and is orchestrated by cloud-native, containerized systems as we build the framework for Adobe's next wave of AI-powered products. The team blends startup energy with the resources of a large software company. What you'll do This is a role for engineers who want it all — design work, ML systems, and operational ownership. On-call and incident response come with the territory, but they're the proving ground, not the job. Design, build, and operate large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems, and the IaC, CI/CD, and automation tooling behind them Own patch, vulnerability, and golden-image lifecycle management across the fleet — triage, remediate, automate Contribute to multi-quarter initiatives: compute rationalization, cloud re-platforming, ML platform migration Build and operate ML inference infrastructure — model serving, GPU workloads, language model gateway and routing — contributing to a broader systems portfolio Help set infrastructure standards and security guardrails for agentic AI, and build the agent tooling we used to run our own operations Partner across software, ML, and platform teams to bake reliability in from the start Share on-call and fix challenges wherever problems show up — web services, databases, pipelines, ML systems What you need to succeed You're a self-starter — passionate, motivated, and comfortable working remotely. Some SDE background helps, but a willingness to build that skill matters more. It is important that you understand how software and systems come together and operate internet-hosted applications. You should also know your way around the infrastructure toolchain, including provisioning, config management, patch/image management, and container orchestration. full_job_description_raw:
The Challenge

The Adobe Creative Community CCM organization is seeking an outstanding Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support innovation through machine learning, autonomous AI workflows, and cloud-native infrastructure. Adobe Stock gives designers and businesses access to hundreds of millions of curated, royalty-free assets that integrate directly with Adobe's desktop, mobile, and web apps, as well as Behance's creative community and Content's advanced services. Our infrastructure spans multiple cloud platforms and is orchestrated by cloud-native, containerized systems as we build the framework for Adobe's next wave of AI-powered products. The team blends startup energy with the resources of a large software company.

What you'll do

This is a role for engineers who want it all — design work, ML systems, and operational ownership. On-call and incident response come with the territory, but they're the proving ground, not the job.

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems, and the IaC, CI/CD, and automation tooling behind them
  • Own patch, vulnerability, and golden-image lifecycle management across the fleet — triage, remediate, automate
  • Contribute to multi-quarter initiatives: compute rationalization, cloud re-platforming, ML platform migration
  • Build and operate ML inference infrastructure — model serving, GPU workloads, language model gateway and routing — contributing to a broader systems portfolio
  • Help set infrastructure standards and security guardrails for agentic AI, and build the agent tooling we used to run our own operations
  • Partner across software, ML, and platform teams to bake reliability in from the start
  • Share on-call and fix challenges wherever problems show up — web services, databases, pipelines, ML systems

What you need to succeed

You're a self-starter — passionate, motivated, and comfortable working remotely. Some SDE background helps, but a willingness to build that skill matters more. It is important that you understand how software and systems come together and operate internet-hosted applications. You should also know your way around the infrastructure toolchain, including provisioning, config management, patch/image management, and container orchestration. You don't need to possess the qualifications of an ML engineer, but you should understand ML capabilities and how inference pipelines and model-serving systems work.

Requirements

Must have:

  • BSc in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a practical setting
  • Python, plus familiarity with PHP, Node.js, or Ruby
  • Familiarity with deploying/operating ML inference pipelines (SageMaker, OpenAI, Bedrock, or equivalent) in production
  • Experience operating cloud-native compute over broad, scalable infrastructures — EC2 Auto Scaling Groups and Kubernetes in AWS; Azure/GCP a plus.
  • Experience with vulnerability/patch management and AMI/golden-image lifecycle automation at fleet scale
  • Strong debugging skills on distributed systems
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotation

Nice to have:

  • Production ML operations experience at any scale
  • GPU-backed compute and cost/performance tuning experience
  • Exposure to agentic AI workflows — LangGraph or similar, LLM gateway/routing across providers
  • Relational database operations experience (upgrades, IAM auth, performance tuning)

Technologies we use

  • Cloud & Orchestration: AWS (primary), Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Lambda
  • Edge & Security: Fastly, Datadome, WAF
  • ML/AI: SageMaker, Bedrock, vLLM, LangGraph, LangSmith, LLM gateway, MCP
  • Data & Caching: Aurora PostgreSQL, Memcached
  • IaC & Automation: Terraform, Terragrunt, Atlantis, Chef, Ansible, SSM, Docker
  • Languages: Python, PHP, bash, Ruby
  • CI/CD: Jenkins, Argo CD
  • Observability: New Relic, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus

About the Role 

Join the Adobe Builder eXperience (ABX) group, a part of Adobe Unified Platform, where you will help re-develop the way we ship software at Adobe. ABX is a new pillar within the Adobe Unified Platform focused on rethinking the end-to-end lifecycle of how we build and ship products — the tools, the platforms, and the agentic technologies that make all 15,000+ builders at Adobe more effective. You will own a diverse and highly technical portfolio of programs, working directly with engineering leadership to define and deliver the next generation of developer and builder tooling, with AI and agentic systems at the core of the approach. 

What You'll Do 

  • Drive the roadmap and portfolio strategy for ABX, translating a broad, evolving mandate into a clear, sequenced set of programs 

  • Align program strategy, operating model, and execution approach for a newly forming organization, establishing the structures that will scale as ABX grows 

  • Partner with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to understand builder needs and pain points across the software lifecycle, and translate them into platform requirements 

  • Evaluate and apply the latest AI and agentic offerings to build platforms and workflows that make builders across Adobe faster and more effective 

  • Run governance and prioritization for the organization like resourcing calls, trade-off decisions, and program reviews across a multi-team portfolio 

  • Partner deeply on technical direction alongside engineering, providing credible, hands-on input rather than coordination-only oversight 

  • Anticipate risks and dependencies across systems and teams, and drive mitigation strategies at scale 

  • Communicate and align stakeholders across Adobe, including executive-level updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs 

  • Define and own the metrics for success with your partners, establishing the north star and supporting benchmarks  

  • Build and codify repeatable program management practices and governance models that other parts of AUP can reuse 

  • Mentor and guide other program managers as ABX scales within AUP 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) 

  • 8+ years of technical program management experience, including direct experience shipping AI/ML or GenAI-powered technologies 

  • Proven zero-to-one product and program experience — comfortable building structure and process where little exists today 

  • Strong track record of ownership, driving programs from ambiguity through to measurable outcomes 

  • Systems thinking, with a solid understanding of how modern technology stacks and developer platforms fit together 

  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to distill technical complexity into clear narratives for leadership 

  • Bias toward action and a demonstrated ability to influence without authority across org layers

description:
The Opportunity Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As the Director of Engineering, Agentic Product, you will lead the technical execution of Adobe's Agentic Product: the AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together into a coherent, high-quality product for creators used by hundreds of millions of people every day. You'll partner directly with Product leadership to define, build, and ship agentic experiences that meaningfully change how creators work. You'll be responsible for the end-to-end product quality of the agent: its capabilities, its behaviors, and the experience it delivers across surfaces. This is a focused, product-minded engineering leadership role — you are accountable for what the agent does and how well it works, not for the underlying platform or ecosystem packaging. This is a rare opportunity to build a new, AI-native engineering team and practices that will define Adobe's most visible AI product. The right person brings experience leading engineering teams that ship high-quality, user-facing AI experiences, a strong point of view on what "great" looks like for creative AI, and the ability to raise the bar in a space that is moving fast. Senior Director-level may be considered for those with the right experience and technical depth. What you'll do Lead the engineering execution of Adobe's Agentic Product — collaborating to define what the agent does, driving the quality of its outputs, and ensuring it ships on a predictable cadence across surfaces. Grow and lead the engineering team building Agentic Product capabilities, driving technical strategy, team health, and execution velocity. Partner closely with the Agentic Product Management leads to define technical scope, sequence delivery, and translate product strategy into executable engineering plans. Lead the design and delivery of agent capabilities spanning in-app creative workflows, multi-step task execution, and context-aware assistance across Adobe's surfaces. Establish and maintain the quality bar for agent behavior — what good looks like, how it's measured, and how the team systematically improves it over time. Partner across Adobe's platform and infrastructure teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built with appropriate evals, guardrails, data protection, and the reliability expected of a product at Adobe's scale. Build and maintain fluency across the emerging agentic standards and model capabilities ecosystem and ensure Adobe's Agentic Product engineering practices evolve with the space. What you'll need to succeed A track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams to ship complex, high-quality user-facing AI products at scale. Deep experience with AI/ML product engineering, including working knowledge of LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and the capabilities and limitations of current generative models in creative contexts. Hands-on technical expertise: you can engage deeply in architecture decisions, review designs with a substantive point of view, and recognize good and brittle agent behavior at the implementation level — not just the product level. You remain close to the code and the craft. Strong cross-functional leadership instincts with a history of effective partnership with Product, Design, and platform engineering teams. Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the technology, the competitive dynamics, and the user expectations are all rapidly evolving. Experience with the quality, reliability, and trust requirements that come with shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience. Demonstrated ability to lead change management and drive continuous innovation in engineering processes and practices — helping teams adopt new ways of working, internalize new tooling, and stay ahead of a rapidly shifting technical landscape without losing execution focus. Experience working with LLM providers or contributing to AI product strategy is strongly preferred. What you'll do 

  • Lead fraud policy, strategy, and prevention initiatives as a member of Adobe's Global Consumer Trust organization.

Job Description

Role Description
The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.

  • 4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing three or more of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:

    • Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

    • Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage

    • Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager

    • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder

    • Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM

    • Adobe Target or Recommendations

    • Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)

    • Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion

    • GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)

  • Strong leadership abilities (an example being proactively convert complex business requirements into technical "solutions") which aligns all delivery team activities to documented customer Business Objectives.

  • Experience producing project scope definitions, delivery estimations, resource allocation and project timelines based on product licensing purchase and implementation requirements.

  • Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.

  • Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams.

  • Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.

  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.

Skills that Set You Apart

  • One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications (AEM, AJO, Analytics/CJA, RTCDP, Target or Workfront)

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing journey including Ad Tech (CDP/DMPs, DSPs, etc.), Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Content Management or automation, CRM, Media Execution, and Reporting/Insights.

  • Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications.

The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.

  • 4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing three or more of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:

    • Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

    • Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage

    • Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager

    • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder

    • Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM

    • Adobe Target or Recommendations

    • Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)

    • Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion

    • GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)

  • Strong leadership abilities (an example being proactively convert complex business requirements into technical "solutions") which aligns all delivery team activities to documented customer Business Objectives.

  • Experience producing project scope definitions, delivery estimations, resource allocation and project timelines based on product licensing purchase and implementation requirements.

  • Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.

  • Demonstrable hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.

  • Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams.

  • Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.

  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.

Skills that Set You Apart

  • One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications (AEM, AJO, Analytics/CJA, RTCDP, Target or Workfront)

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing journey including Ad Tech (CDP/DMPs, DSPs, etc.), Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Content Management or automation, CRM, Media Execution, and Reporting/Insights.

  • Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications.

  • Proficiency in employing Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions to optimize daily workflows or hands-on experience with building AI agents.


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

This role will partner with Adobe’s Account Directors (ADs) to help grow the existing business through identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities. This role requires solution selling capabilities, experience selling value to customers, strong business and selling instincts, and direct, in-person consultation with customers. The Firefly Product Specialist is responsible for guiding and navigating through an enterprise organization to ensure a successful sales cycle, start to finish. As a Firefly Product Specialist, you will play a crucial role in pushing the boundaries of digital creativity and empowering artists and designers to create awe-inspiring content. Responsibilities: 1. Sales Field Alignment – Work with Adobe Account Directors (ADs) across the Creativity and Productivity (C&P) and Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) to support Multi-Product Enterprise Solutions, Strategic Firefly-only Solutions or as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for general Firefly sales engagements. 2. Firefly SME – Be the Firefly and GenAI expert for your territory to create scale and sales effectiveness across all opportunities where creative GenAI capabilities are required – working centrally with product, engineering, operations and marketing to execute. 3. Account Planning – Develop targeted account strategies and tactical penetration plans. 4. Relationship Management – Develop and maintain relationships at the “C-Suite” and “VP” levels within targeted accounts. Relationships will be with both IT and Business segments of the enterprise. 5. Build & Develop Pipeline – Identify cross-sell opportunities through targeted whitespace analysis, partner with pre-sales to drive maturity and sales stage progression in preparation for in-quarter execution. 6. Deliver Product Presentations – Understand customer needs and solution fit by delivering effective product demonstrations, use cases, positioning differentiated value/vision, and sales pitches. 7. Build Business Cases – Build strong Creative GenAI business cases that focus on compelling differentiated value proposition, thought leadership and return on investment cost/benefit analysis. 8. Coordinate Resource Expertise – Own coordination of pre-sales, product and commercial expertise in the sales cycle while project managing key deliverables to an established timeline. 9. Close Sales – Build proposals, negotiate contract pricing & contractual agreement to close sale. Qualifications: 1. Minimum 7+ years proven track record of enterprise-level, technical solution direct sales expertise within a more sophisticated sales model is required. 10+ years of experience highly preferred. 2. Proven experience consulting and selling digital transformation and enterprise solutions to “C-Suite” executives and overachieving on quotas is required. 3. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 4. Experience working with Adobe Creative Cloud products (i.e., Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects) or Adobe Experience Cloud products (i.e., AEM, AEP) is a plus. 5. Knowledge of generative AI technologies, including deep learning, neural networks, and generative models is a plus. 6. Solid understanding of creative workflows and the design process, with the ability to identify opportunities for integrating generative AI techniques. 7. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop innovative solutions to complex challenges. 8. Ability to travel upwards of 50%. 9. Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience. If you are passionate about the intersection of AI and creativity, and you thrive in a dynamic and innovative environment, we encourage you to apply. description:
The Opportunity Adobe's data platform is a vertical data intelligence stack: raw signals are governed and routed at ingestion, enriched and catalogued into curated enterprise definitions, and ultimately transformed into retrieval-ready, agent-optimized knowledge assets. The knowledge tier sits at the top of that stack. Curated definitions become trustworthy, retrieval-ready knowledge. AI agents, self-service analytics, and enterprise decision systems consume this knowledge every day. As Senior Product Manager for this layer, you own its execution throughout the entire process. This includes how knowledge assets are modeled, published, maintained, and delivered to consuming agents via retrieval and integration interfaces. You'll turn a multi-quarter roadmap into shipped capabilities, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and peer platform PMs. This is a builder's role at the sharp end of Adobe's agent-ready data strategy. What you'll own Own the product roadmap — develop and drive a 6–12 month roadmap for knowledge-asset modeling, retrieval APIs, agent-integration interfaces, and embedding/RAG pipelines, prioritizing and re-prioritizing against shifting platform needs. Lead delivery from inception to launch — provide project leadership and day-to-day management spanning engineering and build, making thoughtful quality / customer-value / time-to-market tradeoffs and mitigating risk. Own knowledge freshness and lifecycle — define how curated definitions are ingested, versioned, deprecated, and kept current, so consuming agents never retrieve stale or orphaned knowledge. Deliver the trust signals for the knowledge layer —freshness, lineage, and quality—so knowledge assets can be safely consumed by agents, while contributing these signals to the platform-wide agent readiness score. Build human-in-the-loop correction workflows at the knowledge layer — define what triggers human review of a knowledge asset, and how corrections propagate to downstream consumers. Write clear engineering PRDs — translate platform requirements into prioritized features, crisp specifications, and concrete performance measures and safety thresholds. Partner across the platform team — align with peer PMs owning metadata, event telemetry, and cross-cutting governance so retrieval and embedding surfaces are built on governed, trustworthy foundations. Prototype to think — use vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to stand up quick, testable prototypes that reduce risk in build choices ahead of engineering dedication. What you require to succeed Track record: 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning a data platform, data infrastructure, or enterprise data product end to end — not just contributing to one. AI knowledge-stack fluency: Working knowledge of knowledge-graph concepts, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, MCP servers, and agent skills, plus a working understanding of how agents and models consume data and what makes an asset "agent-ready." The Opportunity

Adobe's data platform is a vertical data intelligence stack: raw signals are governed and routed at ingestion, enriched and catalogued into curated enterprise definitions, and ultimately transformed into retrieval-ready, agent-optimized knowledge assets. The knowledge tier sits at the top of that stack. Curated definitions become trustworthy, retrieval-ready knowledge. AI agents, self-service analytics, and enterprise decision systems consume this knowledge every day.

As Senior Product Manager for this layer, you own its execution throughout the entire process. This includes how knowledge assets are modeled, published, maintained, and delivered to consuming agents via retrieval and integration interfaces. You'll turn a multi-quarter roadmap into shipped capabilities, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and peer platform PMs. This is a builder's role at the sharp end of Adobe's agent-ready data strategy.


What you'll own

  • Own the product roadmap — develop and drive a 6–12 month roadmap for knowledge-asset modeling, retrieval APIs, agent-integration interfaces, and embedding/RAG pipelines, prioritizing and re-prioritizing against shifting platform needs.
  • Lead delivery from inception to launch — provide project leadership and day-to-day management spanning engineering and build, making thoughtful quality / customer-value / time-to-market tradeoffs and mitigating risk.
  • Own knowledge freshness and lifecycle — define how curated definitions are ingested, versioned, deprecated, and kept current, so consuming agents never retrieve stale or orphaned knowledge.
  • Deliver the trust signals for the knowledge layer—freshness, lineage, and quality—so knowledge assets can be safely consumed by agents, while contributing these signals to the platform-wide agent readiness score.
  • Build human-in-the-loop correction workflows at the knowledge layer — define what triggers human review of a knowledge asset, and how corrections propagate to downstream consumers.
  • Write clear engineering PRDs — translate platform requirements into prioritized features, crisp specifications, and concrete performance measures and safety thresholds.
  • Partner across the platform team — align with peer PMs owning metadata, event telemetry, and cross-cutting governance so retrieval and embedding surfaces are built on governed, trustworthy foundations.
  • Prototype to think — use vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to stand up quick, testable prototypes that reduce risk in build choices ahead of engineering dedication.


What you require to succeed

  • Track record: 7+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning a data platform, data infrastructure, or enterprise data product end to end — not just contributing to one.
  • AI knowledge-stack fluency: Working knowledge of knowledge-graph concepts, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, MCP servers, and agent skills, plus a working understanding of how agents and models consume data and what makes an asset "agent-ready."
  • Quality workflows: Experience with human-in-the-loop quality and correction workflows in production data systems.
  • Specification skill: Ability to write engineering PRDs that translate complex technical systems into clear user problems, prioritized features, and measurable success metrics and guardrails.
  • Rapid prototyping: Ability to design and build quick prototypes through vibe-coding (Claude Code preferred) to de-risk decisions before engineering invests.
  • Systems thinking and business judgment: able to reason about the platform as a causal chain rather than independent features, and to articulate how a decision drives adoption, retention, and downstream platform value.
  • Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to drive cross-functional delivery across engineering and program through influence rather than authority, with comfort operating at ambiguous (roadmap) and precise (specification) altitudes simultaneously.

Everyone wants to understand how generative AI is really being used. You'll build the models that get us there: anomaly detection, Return of Investment prediction, prompt classification — turning raw signal into insight nobody else has. AI that actually knows the customer. We're building an administration assistant that adapts to who it's talking to. You'll train the persona and personalisation models that make it feel genuinely intelligent — real ML, not prompt-tuning around someone else's LLM. Systems that learn from themselves. You'll design closed-loop models that take outcomes from live initiatives and feed them back to make the next round smarter. You'll have the autonomy of a founder, the backing of an established team, and the reach of Adobe — where the work you ship touches hundreds of millions of people. If you want to be the ML engineer who shaped how a team builds, this is that seat. Key Responsibilities Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences. Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning. description: The Challenge Search, Discovery, and Content AI (SDC) is a cornerstone of Adobe's ecosystem, enabling creative professionals and everyday users to access, discover, and work with a wide array of digital assets and creative content — including images, videos, documents, vector graphics, brushes, colors, and more. Users need quick access to what they've built, what has been shared with them, and what's available across marketplaces like Adobe Stock. With increasing demand for intuitive search, contextual discovery, and seamless content interactions across Adobe products like Firefly, Acrobat, Lightroom, Express and Adobe Stock, SDC is evolving into a Generative AI powerhouse. At the heart of this work is the Content Processing Framework (CPF), a unified Agentic platform for efficient, reliable, and scalable content processing — both ML and non-ML — across all Adobe content. It is the backbone of Intelligent Content Processing within Adobe offerings, supporting hundreds of applied researchers, millions of end customers, and billions of content pieces that power our customers' entire digital journey. This team develops innovative solutions for Intent understanding, personalized recommendations, and action orchestration to transform how users interact with Content. Working with extensive datasets and pioneering technologies, you will help redefine the discovery experience and drive user success. We match the pace, innovation, and excitement typical of new enterprises, backed by the resources and infrastructure of Adobe. If working at the intersection of machine learning, generative AI, and real-time systems excites you, we'd love to have you join us. Responsibilities As a Machine Learning Engineer on the SDC team, you will develop and optimize machine learning models and algorithms for search, recommendation, and content understanding across diverse content types. You will build and deploy scalable generative AI solutions. These will enable intelligent content discovery and contextual recommendations within Adobe products. This includes Firefly, the Creative Cloud suite, Document Cloud, and Marketing Cloud. Your work will involve extensive data handling, data ingestion, search indexing, analytics, and distributed computing — building platforms that index billions of images, documents, and other assets in real-time. You will apply analytics and machine learning to improve ranking and recommendations within the search workflow, maintain and enhance the search engine, and develop new features using technologies such as Elastic Search, REST web services, SQS/Kafka, Hadoop, and deep learning. Working alongside multi-functional groups, you will integrate ML models into production systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and user impact. Your role will involve researching, crafting, and implementing groundbreaking techniques in language comprehension, computer vision, and multimodal learning for content and asset discovery. You will contribute to the end-to-end ML pipeline — including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring — while pushing the boundaries of computational efficiency to meet the needs of real-time, large-scale applications. Partnering with product teams, you will identify customer needs and translate them into innovative solutions that prioritize usability and performance. Additionally, you will mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and multi-functional collaborators, driving excellence and innovation within the team. What You'll Need to Succeed - Bachelor's or equivalent experience; advanced degree such as a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. - 6–9 years of industry experience building and deploying machine learning systems at scale. - Experience engineering SaaS-based software. - Proficiency in programming languages such as Python (for ML/AI) and Java (good to have for production-grade systems). - Strong expertise in machine learning frameworks and tools (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). - Solid understanding of mathematics and ML fundamentals: linear algebra, statistics, optimization, and numerical methods. - Experience with deep learning techniques for computer vision (e.g., CNNs, transformers), natural language understanding (e.g., BERT, GPT), or multimodal AI. - Consistent track record of delivering ML solutions to production environments, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability. - Practical experience processing data at a large scale. - Experience with AWS resources. - Experience with search engine technology. - Knowledge of large-scale distributed systems and frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes, Spark, Hadoop). - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to innovate new solutions for complex challenges. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work efficiently in a fast-paced, multi-functional environment. Nice-to-Haves - Experience with generative AI (e.g., Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, Midjourney) and its application in content creation or discovery. - Experience with Elastic Search/Solr and building indexing pipelines. - Knowledge of computational geometry, 3D modeling, or animation pipelines. - Familiarity with real-time recommendation systems or search indexing. - Publications in peer-reviewed journals or conferences in relevant fields. - Experience with Web services and REST. - Experience with RDBMS and NoSQL databases. Why Join Us? - Join a dynamic, innovative group crafting the future of AI-powered creative tools. - Work on impactful, large-scale projects that touch millions of users daily. - Enjoy the benefits and resources of a leading global company with the agility of a startup environment. The Opportunity Firefly Foundry is Adobe's enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer's IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces and products, including Firefly, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock, and Premiere. We are hiring a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our GenAI Services area. This is not a model-training or research role — it is the senior-most hands-on engineering authority over how our generative models are architected, optimized , and served at enterprise scale. You will set the inference architecture and technical standards that a growing organization of engineers builds against, co-develop and optimize the inference code that makes those systems fast and cost-efficient, and architect the APIs and product backend that let Adobe's first-party and third-party models reach both internal applications and external plugin integrations. Where the Director owns the multi-year technical strategy, headcount, and company roadmap for the org, you own the architecture, technical depth, and hands-on execution that make that strategy real — spanning multiple engineering teams without owning their people management. What this role owns The technical architecture for composing, optimizing , and serving heterogeneous generative model pipelines — LLMs, diffusion and transformer-based image/video models, RAG and retrieval systems, multi-turn agentic flows, and 3D/mesh pipelines — across the GenAI Services area. The optimization strategy for inference performance: latency, throughput, and cost-to-serve across model families and GPU fleets. The system design standards for pipeline composition, multi-tenant serving, and the product backend/API and plugin surface that integrates first-party and third-party generative models into Adobe's flagship products. full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity 

Firefly Foundry is Adobe's enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer's IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces and products, including Firefly, Photoshop, Illustrator, Express, Stock, and Premiere. 

We are hiring a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our GenAI Services area. This is not a model-training or research role — it is the senior-most hands-on engineering authority over how our generative models are architected, optimized, and served at enterprise scale. You will set the inference architecture and technical standards that a growing organization of engineers builds against, co-develop and optimize the inference code that makes those systems fast and cost-efficient, and architect the APIs and product backend that let Adobe's first-party and third-party models reach both internal applications and external plugin integrations. Where the Director owns the multi-year technical strategy, headcount, and company roadmap for the org, you own the architecture, technical depth, and hands-on execution that make that strategy real — spanning multiple engineering teams without owning their people management. 

What this role owns 

  • The technical architecture for composing, optimizing, and serving heterogeneous generative model pipelines — LLMs, diffusion and transformer-based image/video models, RAG and retrieval systems, multi-turn agentic flows, and 3D/mesh pipelines — across the GenAI Services area. 

  • The optimization strategy for inference performance: latency, throughput, and cost-to-serve across model families and GPU fleets. 

  • The system design standards for pipeline composition, multi-tenant serving, and the product backend/API and plugin surface that integrates first-party and third-party generative models into Adobe's flagship products. 

  • Technical direction across multiple engineering teams as the principal authority on architecture and design — a cross-team scope, distinct from the Director's org-wide roadmap and management ownership. 

Who you will partner with 

  • Applied Science — to translate research models and emerging techniques into production-grade inference architecture. 

  • Director, ML Engineering and ML Engineering leadership — to align technical architecture with organizational strategy and priorities. 

  • Product Managers and TPMs — to define and deliver against the roadmap for GenAI services and APIs. 

  • Firefly Foundry Studio and AI Platform — to translate creative production workflows into performant services and to align on shared infrastructure and serving primitives. 

What you will do 

  • Lead the development of core GenAI services and APIs that integrate a wide range of first-party and third-party generative models into Adobe's flagship products. 

  • Architect ML serving workflows for enterprise-scale model customization, deployment, and ecosystem integration — including externalizable, self-serve fine-tuning flows. 

  • Co-develop and optimize GPU-accelerated inference pipelines — prioritizing latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability — using tools such as PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, and TensorRT. 

  • Design and architect the product backend and plugin ecosystem that lets internal applications and external integrations consume Firefly Foundry's model services. 

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership: guide engineers through architecture, design, implementation, and best practices, and mentor a growing organization of ML engineers. 

  • Research and evaluate emerging inference and MLOps technologies — serving runtimes, quantization, GPU scheduling — to improve engineering velocity and system performance. 

  • Lead design reviews and set technical standards, ensuring high reliability and maintainability across systems. 

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with Product Managers, TPMs, and engineering leaders to define and deliver on the roadmap. 

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement across the organization. 

What you bring 

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent industry experience. 

  • 8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, including production-scale deployment and serving — not training or research experimentation. 

  • 3+ years leading the technical direction of large-scale, GPU-intensive GenAI inference systems — serving, architecture, and optimization. 

  • Deep experience with inference frameworks and tools such as PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, TensorRT, Nvidia Dynamo, and Python. 

  • Strong understanding of generative model architectures — diffusion models, transformers, GANs, LLMs — sufficient to make architecture and optimization calls and reason about output quality, in partnership with Applied Science. 

  • Proven experience architecting multi-model pipelines and serving them behind APIs at enterprise scale. 

  • Experience designing product backend systems and plugin architectures consumed by internal applications and external integrations. 

  • Proven success leading cross-functional teams through complex, high-stakes technical initiatives, with a track record of driving alignment in matrixed organizations. 

  • Excellent communication and technical leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with model serving, orchestration, and GPU resource management in large-scale environments. 

  • Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, distributed systems, and MLOps platforms. 

  • Experience with RAG architectures and multi-turn, agentic conversational systems. 

  • Experience with quantization, distillation, or other model-optimization techniques for inference. 

Education 

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and leading production-scale ML systems.

This hybrid role mixes hands-on analytical tasks with strategic leadership as you build and expand a team during rapid growth. You will also collaborate with participants across the organization to influence strategy, roadmap, and investment decisions throughout the customer lifecycle. If you are passionate about AI and creativity, data-driven decision-making, systems, and design thinking, and thrive in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply. Join our team to shape the future of digital creativity with Adobe's generative AI. This opportunity lets you reach millions of creatives and help them change how they work.  

 

What you’ll do: 

  • Play a hands-on analytical role during your first few months. Then, transition to managing, mentoring, and leading a team of data analysts and scientists. You will ensure high-quality work, clear growth paths for team members, and balanced resourcing across workstreams. 

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our customers, products, and business performance to inform data-driven decisions 

  • Function as a trusted advisor for counterparts on Product, Marketing, GTM, PLG, and Engineering teams to guide the roadmap by providing data-driven insights and proposals 

  • Partner with senior and executive leadership to shape Firefly's analytics and experimentation strategy 

  • Anticipate risks and roadblocks before they surface, and proactively define and prioritize the opportunities most worth pursuing to grow the business 

  • Define important measurements and lead monitoring of these to assess product performance and track product health 

  • Partner with multi-functional partners and the analytics product manager to develop and complete a roadmap of analytics initiatives. These initiatives will drive the most business value for the suite of Firefly products the team manages. 

  • Perform advanced deep dives, build predictive models and dashboards to mine insights 

  • Combine data, experimentation, and insights based on detailed examination to deliver actionable recommendations that address opportunities for product improvements  

  • Improve reporting and data tools to empower data-driven decision-making in the workstreams you support 

 

What you’ll need to succeed: 

Required: 

  • BS, MS, or PhD in an analytical field: statistics, applied mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, physics etc. or equivalent practical experience 

  • Over 4 years of experience leading analytics & data science groups, including mentoring senior individual contributors 

  • 5+ years of proficiency in Python and SQL 

  • Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages on cloud (Databricks, Spark-SQL, Airflow) 

  • Strong fundamentals in statistics as well as shown skills in data visualizations 

  • Experience with A/B testing and sampling methods 

  • Good communication and relationship building skills 

Preferred / nice-to-have: 

  • A track record spanning over 3 years in contemporary data science processes in cloud environments (Git, Jupyter, Python, AWS, Azure)  

  • Ability to support multiple ongoing projects in a fast-paced environment 

  • Solid background in data warehousing, data modeling, data access, and data storage techniques 

  • Experience crafting dashboards in Tableau or PowerBI 

  • Expert in one or more data science tools such as Pandas, NumPy etc 

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or a similar web analytics tool 

  • Experience building data processing machine learning models in a product environment 

  • Familiarity with ML for propensity estimation and causal inference with observational data or experimental designs

Our Company 

Empowering everyone to create is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. 

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours. 

 

The Opportunity  

The Adobe Sales Academy is a multi-phase world-class accelerated sales program designed to take top sales talent from a Business Development Rep (BDR) to an Enterprise Field Account Executive (AE). With multiple locations in North America, this program is crafted to see you grow, develop and succeed. At Adobe, we want to create the next generation of sales professionals, and that starts with you!  

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.   

What You’ll Do  

BDR Interns are responsible for nurturing inbound leads through the early stages of their buyer journey, and through outbound prospecting efforts identify qualified opportunities for the Field Account Executive. This includes target market penetration, calling on CXOs, senior-level executives, following up on marketing-generated leads, providing webinar and event follow-up, and more.  

  • Generate and nurture viable high-quality inbound leads. You will be responsible for aspects of the Adobe product solutions including the Marketing, Creative and Document Clouds. 

  • Maintain proactive relationships with all partners associated with respective opportunities. 

  • Meet and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs and pipeline generating targets. 

  • Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet our core values and culture. 

What You Need to Succeed  

  • Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Business, or Marketing; or equivalent degree required with an expected graduation date of December 2027 – June 2028

Adobe is working in a period of swift change fueled by AI, shifting workforce expectations, evolving work patterns, and accelerated business expansion.
