The Workplace Business Partner (WBP) serves as the strategic link between Workplace Strategy & Site Operations (WSSO) and Adobe's business units, directing the development of workforce-informed location strategies that promote business growth, innovation, collaboration, and employee experience.

This position integrates business collaboration, location strategy, and workplace expertise to make sure workplace investments correspond with shifting business priorities and upcoming ways of working. The Workplace Business Partner is tasked with formulating strategic recommendations, promoting agreement among partners, and representing business priorities during workplace planning, governance, and implementation efforts. Execution is carried out in collaboration with teams throughout WSSO.

As Adobe develops within a technology-enhanced environment, this role predicts shifting business requirements and finds emerging workplace opportunities that foster organizational adaptability and long-term value creation.

What you'll do

The Workplace Business Partner holds responsibility for:

  • Developing business-aligned location strategies and future-state recommendations.
  • Transforming business priorities, workforce trends, and organizational changes into workplace and portfolio investment recommendations.
  • Driving collaborator alignment on strategic workplace and location decisions.
  • Establishing success criteria and targeted business results for workplace initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with senior business leaders, HR Business Partners, and key collaborators.
  • Act as the main strategic point of contact between WSSO and designated business organizations.
  • Understand business objectives, workforce strategies, organizational changes, and growth plans to assess implications for workplace, location, and portfolio decisions.
  • Represent business objectives within WSSO and support alignment between organizational needs and workplace priorities.

2. Work Location Approach

  • Conduct external market analysis and benchmarking to inform workforce distribution, evaluate location opportunities, and inform investment considerations.
  • Build strategic recommendations for a workforce-informed location strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop strategic recommendations, and executive presentations for leadership review and approval.

3. Strategic Program Leadership

  • Sponsor and guide workplace initiatives from strategy development through implementation partnering with GSO, GWE, and GWD to ensure business objectives are represented.

  • Identify risks, dependencies, and organizational impacts associated with workplace decisions.
  • Represent designated business units in prioritizing workplace investments among competing organizational demands.

4. Change Management & Collaborator Engagement

  • Lead collaborator engagement efforts related to work location strategy initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Site Operation teams to communicate recommendations, rationale, and encouraged outcomes to business leaders and partners.
  • Support adoption of workplace initiatives through effective communication and change management planning.

5. Key Partnerships

The Workplace Business Partner develops workforce and location strategies that correspond with business needs through close collaboration with:

  • Global Site Operations (GSO) – operational feasibility and site readiness
  • Global Workplace Delivery (GWD) or equivalent experience – real estate strategy and project execution
  • Global Workplace Experience (GWE) – employee experience strategy & workplace build
  • HR Business Partners (HRBP) – perspectives on workforce planning and organizational strategy

What you need to succeed

  • Over 8 years of experience in workplace strategy, corporate real estate, business relationship management, consulting, or long-term business development.
  • Experience formulating workplace, portfolio, or location approaches in a complex global organization.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders and collaborators.
  • Experience crafting arguments, well-founded proposals, and analyses of return on investment.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to synthesize data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and collaborator management skills.
  • Experience with workplace strategy, corporate real estate, workforce planning, and portfolio management is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of workplace trends, hybrid work models, organizational build, and new technologies impacting the future of work.
  • Ability to develop creative concepts and promoting new ideas
  • Working experience with abstract ideas and future-state planning
  • Experience leading the approach to complex, self-directed assignments

The Senior Delivery Manager will partner with the Senior Director, Digital Experiences and Insight and their leadership team to develop, run, and scale key initiatives, processes, and operations across a distributed team. What You’ll Do 

  • Own the end-to-end core Product Marketing strategy for Adobe Education Institutions, including market strategy, positioning, commercialization, product launches, customer insights, and GTM execution 

  • Focus on driving growth with the Creative & Business Professional audiences spanning Adobe’s full portfolio including Creative Cloud, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Firefly, Acrobat, Express, Student Spaces and much more.   

  • Lead market analysis and build cases to identify, prioritize and scale future growth segments, audiences, products and geographies

  • 12+ years in B2B Enterprise Product Marketing  

  • 6+ years of people management experience.

  • Deeply understands the B2B Enterprise GTM funnel and buying journey  

  • Expert at core Product Marketing craft including messaging, product strategy, GTM launch and sales enablement  

  • Can build strong relationships and execute a strategy across large matrixed organizations  

  • Has built and managed high performing B2B Product Marketing teams that have driven measurable results  

  • Has worked with distributed teams to grow a global business and scale new markets/segments 

  • Motivated to reach big goals and operate in a rapidly changing environment 

  • Comfortable using complex data to inform prioritization and resourcing 

  • Exceptional drive for results, strategic thinking and communication skills 

  • Strong work ethic, combining bias toward action with innovative thinking

description: We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer to lead foundational research in agentic AI and intelligent systems . This is a research-intensive role focused on advancing the underlying models, learning paradigms, and capabilities that enable AI agents to reason, plan, learn, remember, interact with tools, and operate effectively over complex, long-horizon tasks. This is not a prompt-engineering or agent orchestration role . We are looking for a scientist with strong fundamentals in machine learning and deep learning who can develop novel modeling and learning approaches , rather than primarily assembling existing LLMs, prompts, or agent frameworks. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in one or more areas of generative modeling, large language models, NLP, computer vision, multimodal learning, representation learning, reinforcement learning, or related areas , along with the ability to connect these foundations to emerging agentic systems. The role will involve identifying fundamental research problems in agentic intelligence, developing new algorithms and model architectures, designing rigorous experiments, and translating research advances into product. Key Responsibilities Conduct fundamental and applied research in agentic AI, foundation models, reasoning, planning, memory, tool use, multimodal intelligence, and long-horizon interaction. Develop novel model architectures, learning algorithms, training methodologies, and inference techniques to improve the capabilities of AI agents. Advance the underlying intelligence of agents through research in LLMs, generative models, NLP, computer vision, multimodal learning, representation learning, and reinforcement learning . Investigate problems such as reasoning, planning, memory, grounding, adaptation, self-improvement, tool use, and learning from interaction . Build and evaluate research prototypes and establish rigorous experimental methodologies to validate new ideas . Rigorous experimentation to take the final solution to product , submit IP and publish at top-tier conferences . Stay at the forefront of rapidly evolving research in foundation models and agentic AI, identifying opportunities where fundamental advances can create differentiated product capabilities. Leadership & Collaboration Lead technical design reviews, write engineering RFCs, and set quality standards for the team. Mentor junior and mid-level ML engineers through code reviews, 1:1s, and pair-programming sessions. Collaborate with product, research, and infrastructure teams to translate research ideas into shipped features. Required Qualifications 9 + years of hands-on ML engineering experience in industry or research. full_job_description_raw:
We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer to lead foundational research in agentic AI and intelligent systems. This is a research-intensive role focused on advancing the underlying models, learning paradigms, and capabilities that enable AI agents to reason, plan, learn, remember, interact with tools, and operate effectively over complex, long-horizon tasks. 

This is not a prompt-engineering or agent orchestration role. We are looking for a scientist with strong fundamentals in machine learning and deep learning who can develop novel modeling and learning approaches, rather than primarily assembling existing LLMs, prompts, or agent frameworks. 

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in one or more areas of generative modeling, large language models, NLP, computer vision, multimodal learning, representation learning, reinforcement learning, or related areas, along with the ability to connect these foundations to emerging agentic systems. 

The role will involve identifying fundamental research problems in agentic intelligence, developing new algorithms and model architectures, designing rigorous experiments, and translating research advances into product. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Conduct fundamental and applied research in agentic AI, foundation models, reasoning, planning, memory, tool use, multimodal intelligence, and long-horizon interaction.  

  • Develop novel model architectures, learning algorithms, training methodologies, and inference techniques to improve the capabilities of AI agents.  

  • Advance the underlying intelligence of agents through research in LLMs, generative models, NLP, computer vision, multimodal learning, representation learning, and reinforcement learning.  

  • Investigate problems such as reasoning, planning, memory, grounding, adaptation, self-improvement, tool use, and learning from interaction.  

  • Build and evaluate research prototypes and establish rigorous experimental methodologies to validate new ideas.  

  • Rigorous experimentation to take the final solution to product, submit IP and publish at top-tier conferences.  

  • Stay at the forefront of rapidly evolving research in foundation models and agentic AI, identifying opportunities where fundamental advances can create differentiated product capabilities. 

 

  

Leadership & Collaboration 

  • Lead technical design reviews, write engineering RFCs, and set quality standards for the team. 

  • Mentor junior and mid-level ML engineers through code reviews, 1:1s, and pair-programming sessions. 

  • Collaborate with product, research, and infrastructure teams to translate research ideas into shipped features. 

Required Qualifications 

  • 9+ years of hands-on ML engineering experience in industry or research. 

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, with significant industry or research experience.  

  • Strong fundamentals in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, and statistical modeling.  

  • Demonstrated research experience in one or more of:  

  • Large Language Models and NLP  

  • Generative modeling (diffusion, flow matching, autoregressive models, VAEs, etc.)  

  • Computer Vision  

  • Multimodal foundation models  

  • Representation learning  

  • Reinforcement learning / learning from interaction  

  • Reasoning and planning  

  • Demonstrated ability to formulate novel research problems, develop new approaches, and experimentally validate hypotheses.  

  • Strong publication record and/or demonstrated track record of delivering novel ML research with measurable impact.  

  • Strong programming and experimentation skills, particularly with modern deep learning frameworks 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with cross-functional stakeholders.

What You'll Do Own this product's growth strategy end to end: acquisition (including migrating an existing adjacent user base), activation, retention, and monetization, from private beta through the push to general availability. Build the growth measurement and experimentation foundation, partnering with a data science function to instrument the funnel, define metrics, and stand up an experimentation practice. Work with PMM to define and drive the monetization strategy, in partnership with that platform's product team. The Opportunity Adobe is building Firefly Foundry, the platform for customizing any media model at any depth. It spans image, video, audio, and multi-modal models, Adobe’s own and third-party alike, so all of it happens in one place. From keeping a marketing team on-brand without touching a model, to training a model that generates a studio’s characters at production quality, Firefly Foundry lets enterprises work at whatever depth the problem calls for. We are seeking a Director of Product Management to help lead the Firefly Foundry product organization. You will drive product strategy and roadmap for key areas of the platform and partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, forward-deployed teams, product marketing, and go-to-market. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a net-new, AI-first enterprise platform at global scale — defining how the world’s brands, studios, and developers customize, govern, and deploy generative media models, and how Firefly Foundry becomes an essential surface for enterprise AI media. What you’ll do Drive product strategy and roadmap for core areas of Firefly Foundry, spanning the platform’s levels of customization — from shared brand context and prompt intelligence to self-serve model tuning and managed franchise-model training. Identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize features, define success metrics, and own end-to-end delivery across a multi-model, multi-modal platform. Build a platform that lets customers start at any level of customization and go deeper as the work changes, so nothing they build at one level gets stranded when they move to the next. Translate complex model-customization capabilities — fine-tuning, evals, version history, prompt intelligence, and IP guardrails — into clear, self-serve product experiences for enterprise teams. Partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, and forward-deployed creative technologists, engineers, and research scientists to cut the time from an idea to a model running in production. Shape how Firefly Foundry is consumed: direct API access for customers’ own applications, pipelines, and agents, and native experiences inside Firefly Studio and the Creative Cloud apps teams already use. Own the trust layer as a first-class product surface — safety classifiers, jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses, copyright indemnity, data isolation, and the compliance and certifications customers inherit. Contribute to Foundry’s model-agnostic strategy and token economics, keeping the best available base model one contract-free switch away for every customer. Share product vision inside and outside Adobe, gathering feedback from enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams to guide direction. Mentor and support product managers on the team, setting a high bar for product craft, ownership, and execution. What you’ll need to succeed 8 or more years of product management experience, including leading complex, multi-surface or platform products. A strong understanding of generative media models (image, video, audio, and multi-modal) and model customization — fine-tuning, evaluation, and prompt engineering. Experience building enterprise or developer platforms — APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure products serving both technical and business users. Experience leading product in a matrixed organization and influencing across engineering, research, design, services, and go-to-market teams. Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, zero-to-one ideas and turn them into shipped, scaled products. Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with comfort working at the intersection of ML, infrastructure, governance, and UX. A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping. Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior leaders and cross-functional partners around a clear product narrative. Familiarity with enterprise trust concerns — IP protection, safety guardrails, compliance, and data governance — is a strong plus. Experience with a services-plus-product or forward-deployed engagement model, or with generative AI platforms, is a strong plus. Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. The Adobe Fonts and Type team is rapidly transforming how typography is discovered and experienced. We are passionate about the future of fonts and are looking for a Font Licensing and Cost Analyst to help us understand font usage, manage costs, and inform our library and licensing strategy. Here's what you'll do:

Adobe Fonts Cost Analysis
  • Monitor font usage in Adobe products and its impact on associated royalty costs
  • Support new product features by analyzing and developing font royalty payment models 

Font Library Catalog
  • Analyze user engagement with font groups and languages to inform font catalog strategy 
  • Track the inventory of Adobe Fonts compared to competitor font libraries to identify gaps and opportunities

Licensing & Enterprise Customer Support
  • Respond to inquiries on font licensing, misuse, and terms of use
  • Partner with sales teams to understand enterprise customer workflows and improve font solutions
  • Work with Adobe Care and track user feedback to address issues and anticipate trends that relate to enterprise font use 
  • Maintain customer-facing documentation related to enterprise font use and font resellers

Adobe Originals & Reseller Management
  • Develop pricing strategies that accurately reflect Adobe Originals (Adobe-owned fonts) value by analyzing competitor pricing and market trends 
  • Maintain relationships with Adobe Originals resellers and track font sales revenue
  • Manage enterprise customer font purchasing needs by coordinating between customers and resellers

Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Familiarity with enterprise software licensing
  • Strong understanding of pricing and revenue models 
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills 
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, finance, and support teams 
  • Meticulous with strong organizational and problem-solving skills

  • Experience in typography, fonts or the type industry
  • Advanced Excel or data visualization skills

The Sr. Product Manager for Sales & Post Sales Data & Analytics will drive prioritization, planning, and execution of enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions. The Opportunity Adobe Digital Insights (ADI) has been a leading authority on the global digital economy since 2013, building its analysis on trillions of visits, billions of online transactions, and the prompts behind billions of AI-generated assets crafted with Adobe Firefly. ADI works with creators, marketers, and business leaders, up to C-level leadership at Adobe’s largest customers, to help them understand how the digital economy is shifting and how their business is performing relative to industry peers using Adobe’s unique data. ADI’s mission is to inspire and delight all of Adobe’s audiences with leading, credible, differentiated, data-driven insights . We are transitioning to an agentic AI operating model, where LLM-powered agents are embedded across the end-to-end insights lifecycle, from raw data to business-ready insight products to audience-ready narrative. This role puts you in the middle of that work as a hands-on analyst turning Adobe’s data into the insights and stories our audiences rely on. Role Summary We are seeking a Data Scientist to support ADI’s digital economy work first and foremost. You will query and develop large datasets into trusted, repeatable insights. You will build the digital economy metrics and reports ADI is known for, and stepping in wherever the team needs analytical horsepower, from analysis of US dollar inflation to benchmarking critical web metrics. This is a hands-on analysis role for someone who loves finding the story in the data and getting it right. This is a full-stack role: you will work end to end from raw data through processing and analysis to the data products downstream users depend on. Along the way you will collaborate with engineering, analysts, architects, product managers, and leadership, becoming a go-to ADI subject-matter expert. What you'll Do Own your work across the whole stack — from raw data and processing, through analysis, to data products downstream users and dashboards depend on. Query, prioritize, and mine large structured and unstructured datasets (Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, CJA, and licensed sources) to produce accurate, defensible insights. Build and maintain the recurring analyses, metrics, and indices behind ADI’s digital economy reporting, turning clean inputs into trusted outputs. Flex to support any ADI topic as priorities shift across creativity trends, document efficiency, traffic based on data analysis, and product insights. Turn analysis into clear narratives and visualizations that non-technical audiences can understand and act on. Run ad-hoc deep dives and answer time-sensitive questions from collaborators across Adobe. Work AI-natively using ADI’s AI tools and agents to speed up exploration, analysis, and drafting, while keeping a careful human eye on quality and consistency. Partner with engineering to define data requirements and improve the pipelines and datasets you rely on. What you need to succeed A degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, mathematics, data science, or similar). 4–6 years turning data into insight in an analytical, data science, or research role. Strong data-analyst and insights skills querying with SQL and analyzing with Python to answer real business questions, not modeling for its own sake. AI-native: proficient using AI and agentic tools to accelerate exploration, analysis, and drafting, with a careful human eye on quality. Hands-on experience with Databricks (or a comparable large-scale data platform). Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving, forming hypotheses, testing them, and synthesizing clear recommendations. A knack for data storytelling: explaining complex findings simply, in both writing and visuals. Curiosity, care, and self-direction in a fast paced environment with shifting priorities; collaborative across teams and levels. Nice to Have: Background in economics, econometrics, forecasting, or time-series analysis. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Experience Cloud, or Customer Journey Analytics. Data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or D3). Experience working with survey data and methodology. Familiarity with R or other scripting languages. The Opportunity  

Join Adobe’s Benefits Center of Excellence team and play a meaningful role in creating exceptional employee experiences through our Leave of Absence, Disability, Life, and Time Off programs. You’ll help design, deliver, continuously improve and measure the impact of benefits that empower our people to thrive both at work and in life. Our benefits philosophy is to design and deliver inclusive, competitive, and value driven benefits programs that enable peace of mind and productivity, with strategic balance between experience, scale, and financial stewardship.   

We are looking for an innovative thought leader for this role, someone who will help transform our Leave of Absence program into a world-class experience and mentor other Benefit analysts on the team. Someone who can make Adobe’s Benefits philosophy come alive by leading benefits programs across US & Canada. This role will be based in the US at our San Francisco or San Jose Office.  

  

What You will do 
 We identify the following primary responsibilities for this role. However, the list is not exhaustive as priorities might vary. 

 

Lead Benefits Program Management  

  • Support leadership in the execution of strategic goals, multi-year benefit planning, deliver on program objectives, supply industry best practices, conduct market benchmarking, and help with operational initiatives.  

  • Develop strong partnerships with Payroll, Legal, Employee Relations, HR Business Partners, Risk, EX/TR Operations, EX Tech, Accommodations team, Finance, VMO and other stakeholders.  

  • Financial management and oversight of the benefit programs, including overseeing self-funded plans, and annual fringe budget planning. Direct the annual POs process and ensure vendor invoice payment. 

  • Plan and execute special projects throughout the year, such as request for proposal (RFP) processes, vendor implementations, plan design changes, and ad-hoc projects with internal business partners. 

 

Compliance & Operations 

  • Supervise all compliance activities and set up statutory plans, ensuring the programs are meeting all state, federal and provincial compliance, as well as adherence to company policies and applicable leave laws. 

  • Setting up new state plans, responding timely to implementation deadlines, employee communications and annual notice requirements and filings. 

  • Track and analyze absence data and metrics, as well as operational trends, workflow efficiencies, service delivery, and program effectiveness. 

  • Ensure all operational compliance through program audits, employee communications, documentation reviews, Adobe pay practices, monitoring regulatory requirements. Using an innovative mind to address systemic issues with swift corrective action. 

 

Day-To-Day Activities 

  • Drive resolution on complex leave and life cases, including intermittent leave, extension requests, return-to-work and ADA-related leave requests. 

  • Oversee third-party vendor management including performance, service delivery, addressing operational concerns, renewals, and all the day-to-day leave administration providing a world-class white glove experience. 

  • Provide and maintain impactful training materials for managers, HR business partners, employees and employee resource center regarding leave policy and practice. 

  • Assist answering questions from people managers, employees and HR business partners, relating to leaves in US&C.  

  • Support Workers Compensation process by partnering with Risk and Global Security teams. 

 

What you need to succeed 

  • 7+ years of directly applicable and progressive benefit program management experience in leave administration, benefits management, consulting, or case management experience. 

  • Strong knowledge of leave practice and regulations for FMLA and ADA leave processes, state leave laws, VDI self-funded plan, military provisions, general provincial laws and rights, accommodations, other federal regulations, and return-to-work practices. 

  • Experience administering complex benefit programs for large, multi-state employer, implementing innovative operational business processes and practices. 

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex leave cases, implementing business process excellence, providing stellar employee experience, utilizing HRIS/leave management systems, monitoring compliance, and providing operational effectiveness and sound decision-making. 

  • Knowledge of Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) regulations, ADA, HIPAA, and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing benefits. 

  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem solving, critical thinking and communication skills, as well as ability to exercise sound judgement, maintain confidentiality with sensitive employee information. 

  • Strong oral and written communication skills and attention to detail. 

  • Grounded in magical customer experiences, ability to see all aspects of the leave experience and continually evolve the program to maintain a high-quality end-to-end experience. 

  • Effective at multi-tasking while keeping calm and energetic. You can do hard things that deliver impactful results. 

  • Applying critical thinking to a highly complex program, partnering effectively with internal business partners and organizational leaders. 

  • Able to raise the bar on AI application in the leave space whether that is using AI agents, chat bots, or altering vendors' service delivery model. Having an AI-first mindset a plus. 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field. Required education may be substituted by additional years of experience. 

  • Certified Benefits Professional (CBP) or Certified Employee Benefit Specialist (CEBS) professional certification, a plus.

Principal Architect — Distributed Systems, Agentic AI, Security, Privacy and Governance

Summary 

At Adobe, we are building enterprise-grade Agentic-AI systems that automate large-scale data access and workflow execution for business processes. These systems not only embody foundational enterprise security and privacy considerations but also provide robust and safety-preserving capabilities in the emerging world of agent identity, delegated access control and human-in-the-loop execution models.  

This is a multi-fluency role: you need the distributed systems and Agentic-AI depth to architect how agents reason, plan, and act at scale, and the security-and-compliance mechanisms that manage safe and trustworthy execution. You will partner with engineering, product, legal/privacy, and security leadership to turn fast-moving agentic AI capabilities into a governed, enterprise-ready platform.  

Key Responsibilities 

Agentic AI Architecture 

  • Define and drive the end-to-end reference architecture for how AI agents are authenticated and authorized to access enterprise data, tools, and systems across Adobe's Customer Experience Platform — covering agent lifecycle management, interaction protocols, memory/context handling, and action-execution frameworks. 

  • Evaluate and select frameworks, protocols, and platforms (e.g., agentic orchestration frameworks, MCP-style tool systems, policy engines such as OPA/Cedar-class authorization) that best support secure, governed multi-agent systems at Adobe's scale. 

Security, Compliance & Privacy by Design 

  • Own the security architecture for agent-to-system and agent-to-agent interactions: identity and workload authentication, least-privilege authorization, secrets and credential mediation, network egress controls, runtime isolation, and telemetry/audit evidence sufficient to satisfy internal audit and external regulators. 

  • Embed privacy-by-design and compliance requirements (data governance, consent, data residency, retention) directly into the agent architecture rather than bolting them on after the fact; partner with Legal/Privacy to keep architecture decisions ahead of regulatory expectations for autonomous AI systems. 

Cross-Organizational Leadership & Standards 

  • Lead architectural reviews and set standards for scalability, resiliency, observability, and cost efficiency — with security and compliance treated as first-class, non-negotiable design constraints rather than downstream signoffs. 

  • Contribute to or lead an Architecture Review Board function for agentic AI, ensuring new capabilities are evaluated consistently against Adobe's governance bar before they ship. 

Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Evangelism 

  • Serve as Adobe's senior technical authority and encouraging leader on secure agentic AI architecture. Mentor senior engineers and architects. Elevate security and privacy proficiency across the broader engineering organization.  

  • Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and threat models that are equally useful to implementation teams and to senior leadership. 

Executive & Customer Engagement 

  • Represent Adobe's agentic AI security and governance posture to executive leadership, enterprise customers, and — where relevant — regulators and standards bodies, with clear, bounded claims about maturity, open risks, and the evidence required before broader rollout. 

  • Provide thought leadership across the organization where agentic AI access governance is heading, and shape Adobe's roadmap accordingly. 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering and security architecture, with a strong focus on distributed systems, platform engineering, and enterprise-scale access control. Recent experience in Agentic AI Security

  • Deep understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns: agent orchestration, tool/function calling, reasoning and planning loops, and multi-agent coordination, along with the risks specific to each. 

  • Expert-level knowledge of identity and access management, authorization models, and credential/secrets management (e.g., OAuth/OIDC, SAML, workload identity, policy-as-code approaches such as OPA/Rego or Cedar-class engines). 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous initiatives involving multiple functions across security, product, legal/privacy, and infrastructure teams, and to influence org-wide standards without direct authority.  

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Practical experience with agent-lifecycle governance, including audit evidence generation and anomaly/incident response for autonomous systems. 

  • Familiarity with privacy and compliance frameworks relevant to AI systems (e.g., data residency, consent management, and sectoral regulatory expectations for automated decision-making). 

  • Experience building or governing developer platforms, cloud-native services, or streaming data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Spark) at enterprise scale. 

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Security, or related technical field. 

  • Experience standing up or contributing to an enterprise Architecture Review Board or equivalent governance function. 

Success Profile 

  • Strong systems thinker who can simplify genuinely hard problems — you make governance transparent without making it burdensome. 

  • Comfortable operating at both hands-on technical depth and strategic, executive-facing leadership. 

  • High ownership, high bias for execution, and a track record of turning a working draft into a production-grade, adopted standard.

As a Senior Security Automation Engineer, you'll design and build production-grade automation, orchestration, and agentic AI systems that reduce mean-time-to-respond and scale Adobe's security operations beyond human-speed triage. You'll partner with Detection Engineering to turn new detection rules into working response, engineer enterprise-scale APIs and orchestration services across the security stack, and deliver containment automation and identity/access response actions used in live incidents. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, develop, and maintain automation and orchestration systems spanning SOAR playbooks, custom services, and agentic AI workflows that automate enrichment, correlation, and containment across the security stack. Partner directly with Detection Engineering on every new detection rule that needs a response action. Architect and build enterprise-grade APIs, connectors, and orchestration services that give security operations teams machine-speed enrichment and correlation, reducing analyst triage time and improving signal quality at scale. Own containment and remediation automation for Incident Response, including identity-and access-related response actions used during live incidents. Create and maintain policy-enforcement automation, ensuring upstream access and control decisions execute reliably, without gaps. Integrate automation with ecosystem tooling, including identity providers, endpoint and EDR platforms, and ticketing systems, via REST APIs and custom connectors, and via SOAR platforms where they're the right tool for the job. Design and deploy agentic AI systems, including multi-step autonomous workflows with agent orchestration and context engineering, to extend detection and response beyond scripted playbook logic. Triage production automation issues as an operational priority, and track metrics for automation coverage, reliability, and time-to-remediate. Contribute to Detection-as-Code integration within Detection Engineering's existing standards, and document automation logic for team-wide ownership. Actively find ways to integrate AI into day-to-day work, including playbook development, script writing, enrichment logic, triage, incident summarization, testing, and documentation. Hands-on experience building and maintaining SOAR playbooks (Splunk SOAR, Tines, XSOAR, etc.), including custom actions, connectors, and playbook logic in Python. Advanced proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for production automation development. Demonstrated experience building or deploying agentic AI systems, such as agent orchestration, prompt or context engineering, or autonomous multi-step workflows, applied to security or operational automation. Practical understanding of incident response and security investigative workflows. Experience integrating systems with detection/SIEM tooling, identity/access systems, and ticketing/case management systems via REST APIs. description:
The Opportunity Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web. As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy. Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences. This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control. What You’ll Do Shape the Creative Pro product agenda Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web. Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive. Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures. Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years. Represent professional photographers inside Adobe Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography. Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows. Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations. full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity


Adobe Lightroom is the world’s leading photography ecosystem, empowering photographers to edit, manage, store, and share images across desktop, mobile, and web.

As professional photography is reshaped by AI, automation, new client expectations, and a rapidly evolving competitive landscape, we are looking for a Director of Product Management to help define what the modern professional photography workflow becomes next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with deep product leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency in professional photography. You will represent the needs of photographers currently engaged with Lightroom, helping teams understand where pros need more speed, quality, trust, creative control, and workflow efficiency. You will lead key parts of the Creative Pro offering plan within Lightroom’s overall strategy.

Working closely with product managers, designers, engineers, researchers, product marketers, and advanced technology teams, you will translate real-world professional workflows into product direction, roadmap priorities, and shipped experiences.

This role requires a rare combination of customer empathy, product taste, technical curiosity, strategic judgment, and senior-level influence. You will help shape how AI, agents, and new workflow innovations can make Lightroom dramatically more valuable to professional photographers while preserving craft, intent, and control.


What You’ll Do

Shape the Creative Pro product agenda

  • Lead key product strategy workstreams for the Creative Pro audience across Lightroom surfaces including desktop, mobile, and web.
  • Identify high-value opportunities across professional workflows, including ingest, culling, editing, retouching, masking, batch editing, collaboration, client review, delivery, and archive.
  • Translate photographers’ jobs to be done into clear product principles, requirements, priorities, and success measures.
  • Help define how Lightroom can offer greater benefits to working photographers over the next several years.

Represent professional photographers inside Adobe

  • Serve as a trusted voice for working photographers across genres, including wedding, portrait, event, commercial, wildlife, sports, landscape, travel, editorial, and studio photography.
  • Build relationships with professional photographers, educators, creators, camera partners, and industry experts to keep Lightroom grounded in real-world workflows.
  • Bring hands-on photography fluency into product reviews, prototypes, roadmap discussions, launch planning, and executive conversations.
  • Help teams distinguish between technically impressive ideas and experiences professionals will trust in production.

Imagine and ship new experiences

  • Partner with teams in advanced technology, design, and engineering to shape new capabilities into experiences photographers love and rely on.
  • Define how AI, agents, and automation should show up in Lightroom to save time, improve quality, reduce repetitive work, and expand creative possibility.
  • Balance innovation with quality, performance, reliability, transparency, and user
  • control.
  • Drive clarity and alignment across cross-functional teams, strategic forums, planning cycles, and executive discussions.

Ground decisions in insight

  • Stay close to the tools, services, communities, and workflows professional photographers use today.
  • Develop a strong point of view on where Lightroom should lead, where it should partner, and how we can exceed expectations of our most advanced customers.
  • Connect customer insight, product quality, adoption, retention, monetization, and competitive differentiation into precisely structured product recommendations.

​What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Proven experience as a senior product leader who has defined strategy and shipped high-impact  products, ideally for creative, media, professional, technical, or workflow-intensive customers.
  • Deep understanding of professional photography workflows, including speed, quality, consistency, client expectations, high-volume production, and creative control.
  • Strong product taste, with the ability to evaluate whether an experience meets the bar for professional use.
  • Experience turning ambiguous customer needs, emerging technology, and business goals into  well-defined product strategy, tradeoffs, and shipped outcomes.
  • Experience partnering deeply with research, design, engineering, and product marketing to deliver customer-facing products at scale.
  • Experience with AI, automation, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic experiences, holding a clear stance on trust, control, quality, and user value.
  • Executive-level storytelling and influence, especially in senior IC roles where impact depends on alignment rather than direct authority.
  • Strong analytical judgment, showing proficiency in combining usage data, customer research, market signals, competitive insight, and hands-on craft expertise.
  • Excellent collaboration skills, high ownership, and a demonstrated ability to build trust with photographers and internal partners alike.

Strong Plus

  • Over 10 years spent working professionally as a photographer specializing in one or more genres.
  • Experience teaching, mentoring, writing for, or building community with photographers.
  • Experience collaborating with camera manufacturers, lens makers, imaging hardware companies, or other photography ecosystem partners.
  • A photography portfolio, shipped product examples, writing, talks, or other work that demonstrates extensive knowledge of professional creative workflows.

The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) enables businesses to deliver the right experience at the right time to their customers. The Segmentation Service is one of the key AEP services, providing the ability to define customer segments and generate target audiences based on real-time customer profiles. Customer segment definitions are sophisticated queries over profile and event data capturing specific attributes or behaviors shared by a subset of users. With the need to perform trillions of audience segment evaluations per day, scalability and efficiency are paramount in segment evaluation. This is a great opportunity for engineers to solve extremely interesting challenges of scale and build core services that are used by all Adobe Digital Experience solutions. As part of building these services, you will work with an exceptionally talented and collaborative team, tackle complex query evaluation challenges, design & implement innovative algorithms and build highly performant services.

What you'll Do

· Collaborate with a team of engineers & product managers in building a high-performance segmentation engine. Own responsibility for design and implementation of key components

· Develop query compilation algorithms that transform and rewrite segment definition queries

· Develop query optimization and evaluation algorithms including multi-query optimization, incremental evaluation and streaming evaluation

· Work on cross functional themes involving advanced data pipelines using Apache Spark

· Build tools to monitor query performance and identify & debug potential semantic errors

· Deploy production services and iteratively improve them based on customer feedback

· Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines

· Participate in architecture, design & code reviews

What you need to succeed

· B.S. in Computer Science or a related field is required

· M.S. in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent practical experience is preferred

· Experience building a scalable query engine or equivalent practical experience is required. Experience in language design is a plus

· Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures

· Proficiency in Databases or compilers is preferred

· Strong programming skills with extensive experience in Java or Scala

· Proficiency in Apache Spark is preferred.

· Leadership skills to collaborate and drive cross-team efforts

· Excellent communication skills

· Adaptable to evolving priorities, accepting challenges outside one's comfort zone, learning new technologies, and delivering viable solutions within defined time boundaries.

title: Finance Lead

description:
The Opportunity Every day, millions of visitors move through Adobe's web properties — exploring, comparing, converting. Hidden in that flow is a story: why traffic surged, why a form underperformed, where a funnel quietly leaks revenue. Your job is to find that story and tell it such that it builds what leadership does next. Join our BACOM Web Insights team in Austin (hybrid) as Sr Web Analytics & Insights Manager. Using Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), ContentSquare, and Adobe CoWorker, you will convert raw behavioral data into insights for Weekly Business Reviews (WBR) and quarterly reporting. This role provides an opportunity to engage where data informs decisions! What You'll Do Own the narrative, not just the numbers. Build advanced analytical models and full-funnel analyses. These go beyond "what happened" to explain why it happened and what to do about it — the "so what" behind every metric. Build reporting that gets used. Develop and maintain CJA and ContentSquare dashboards that collaborators actually open, trust, and act on. Partner cross-functionally. Work directly with web PMs, marketing, and leadership to scope analytics needs and deliver solutions that fit how they actually make decisions. Act as the guardian of the data. Preserve accuracy and integrity across the full funnel — from acquisition through conversion — following governance standards that ensure every number is defensible. Bring the story forward. Present findings with a clear point of view: what changed, why it matters, and what we should do next — not a data readout, a recommendation. What You Need to Succeed Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Analytics, or a related field — or 7+ years of experience that is equivalent to a degree in practice. Practical experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), or ContentSquare. Proven track record in advanced analytics, data visualization, and reporting, with the ability to turn complex data into a clear, decision-ready story. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills — you can hold your own in a room with senior collaborators and make the data land. Comfortable working throughout the entire funnel range: from acquisition to conversion, rather than concentrating only on specific metrics. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, plus relevant certifications. Proficiency in SQL and Python for deeper, custom analysis beyond out-of-the-box reporting. The Opportunity

Every day, millions of visitors move through Adobe's web properties — exploring, comparing, converting. Hidden in that flow is a story: why traffic surged, why a form underperformed, where a funnel quietly leaks revenue. Your job is to find that story and tell it such that it builds what leadership does next.

Join our BACOM Web Insights team in Austin (hybrid) as Sr Web Analytics & Insights Manager. Using Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), ContentSquare, and Adobe CoWorker, you will convert raw behavioral data into insights for Weekly Business Reviews (WBR) and quarterly reporting. This role provides an opportunity to engage where data informs decisions!

What You'll Do

  • Own the narrative, not just the numbers. Build advanced analytical models and full-funnel analyses. These go beyond "what happened" to explain why it happened and what to do about it — the "so what" behind every metric.
  • Build reporting that gets used. Develop and maintain CJA and ContentSquare dashboards that collaborators actually open, trust, and act on.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Work directly with web PMs, marketing, and leadership to scope analytics needs and deliver solutions that fit how they actually make decisions.
  • Act as the guardian of the data. Preserve accuracy and integrity across the full funnel — from acquisition through conversion — following governance standards that ensure every number is defensible.
  • Bring the story forward. Present findings with a clear point of view: what changed, why it matters, and what we should do next — not a data readout, a recommendation.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Analytics, or a related field — or 7+ years of experience that is equivalent to a degree in practice.
  • Practical experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), or ContentSquare.
  • Proven track record in advanced analytics, data visualization, and reporting, with the ability to turn complex data into a clear, decision-ready story.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills — you can hold your own in a room with senior collaborators and make the data land.
  • Comfortable working throughout the entire funnel range: from acquisition to conversion, rather than concentrating only on specific metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience in data analytics, plus relevant certifications.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for deeper, custom analysis beyond out-of-the-box reporting.

Our Company Changing the world via digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone, from emerging artists to global brands, everything they need to build and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, documents and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. We're on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next breakthrough could be yours. Position Overview We are seeking a talented and motivated Strategic Development Manager to join our Creativity and Productivity Enterprise Customer Strategy and Success team. This role is perfect for individuals who are passionate about emerging solutions involving creative design, content production, and Artificial Intelligence. As a post-sales product specialist, you will help drive customer success and growth of our AI consumption business within our largest Enterprise creative agencies and professional services organizations. You will own driving adoption of Creative Cloud's generative AI capabilities, while also engaging with customers on Firefly Boards, Firefly APIs, Custom Models, Creative Foundations & Foundry opportunities. You will be responsible for managing the technical aspects of product enablement and adoption across specific customers, working closely with the assigned Customer Success Manager. You will play a pivotal role in helping our customers understand and leverage Adobe's enterprise software solutions, particularly within the Advertising and Professional Services industries, with a focus on creative workflow transformation and AI-driven consumption growth. A consultative approach, being comfortable engaging in strategic planning, solution development, technical business enablement, and process management, presenting and demoing to customer groups of all sizes, all while driving adoption of our emerging solutions will be the key to your success in this role. Key Responsibilities Drive growth of GenAI adoption within Creative Cloud, including GenAI MAU, credit consumption, and net new revenue, across a portfolio of strategic creative agencies and professional services organizations. Lead enterprise demos, pilots, and proofs of concept for high-value use cases utilizing Firefly, AI Assistant, Custom Models, Video Production, Firefly Boards, and 3P integrations. Engage customers on Firefly Enterprise API and Custom Model opportunities, including asset creation at scale, edit production assets, and localization/translation use cases. Support customer engagement on Creative Foundations & Foundry, including world creation, review & approval workflows, and WIP asset storage in Frame. Partner with Customer Success Managers, Sales, and Product teams to develop customized end-to-end enterprise solutions for your customers. Engage executive and technical stakeholders to present strategic roadmaps, ROI, and adoption strategies tied to consumption and usage goals. Drive customer advocacy activities, including live events, webinars, and Adobe Days. Capture customer insights to feed back to and influence product and go-to-market strategy. Minimum Requirements Creative Expertise: Extensive design experience with Creative Cloud solutions, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Firefly, and/or other API solutions as a bonus. Customer-Facing Experience: At least five years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Technical Sales, and/or in a Product Management / Product Evangelism role. Technical Competence: Validated experience working in enterprise software and ability to grasp, adopt and teach new solutions quickly. Presentation Skills: Strong ability to deliver engaging and persuasive software demonstrations both in-person and virtually, to audiences of all titles and sizes. Compelling on-camera presence for virtual engagement with customers. AI Fluency: Foundational understanding of how artificial intelligence works, including its historical evolution and where the technology is headed, with the ability to translate that knowledge into credible customer conversations. Consultative Approach: Ability to employ an advisory approach to comprehend business gaps and propose appropriate solutions. Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying intricate technical concepts clearly and concisely. Travel Availability: Travel as required for the role, potentially making frequent trips. 10% - 30% travel. Self-Starter: Ability to work independently, lead commitments, and deliver on deadlines successfully. Desired Skills and Qualifications Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of roles and inner-workings of creative agencies and/or in-house creative teams, through use of emerging technologies. Help build out evals — partner with the team on defining what "good" looks like for each tool and skill, building test sets, and turning fuzzy quality issues into measurable, trackable signal. We're seeking a hands-on, analytical professional to lead Adobe's U.S. withholding tax function and drive the systems and processes behind it. Reporting to the Director of U.S. International Tax and based in San Jose, this role pairs technical execution with a strong operations and technology mandate: building, improving, and scaling the platforms and workflows that keep Adobe's tax function accurate and efficient. You will coordinate Pillar Two compliance and assist with related provision work. You will manage U.S. transfer pricing allocations and support the broader U.S. international tax compliance and provision cycle. You will also contribute to M&A integration and other cross-functional initiatives. You're a self-starter who takes initiative, owns problems end to end, and drives workstreams forward with minimal oversight, defining the approach and aligning partners rather than waiting for direction. As tax laws, business operations, and the global operating environment continue to evolve rapidly, we need a Manager who is eager to learn, adapt quickly, and expand their impact across the organization, helping Adobe navigate complex tax matters effectively. If you thrive on operationalizing complex tax positions, love building systems and automating processes (including AI), and want to make a tangible impact at a global tech leader, this is your opportunity. What you'll do: Own U.S. Withholding Tax (1042) End-to-End Own the entire workflow for U.S. tax withholding on outbound vendor payments. This includes technical determinations, W-8/W-9 documentation, deposits, reconciliations, and Form 1042/1042-S reporting and filings. You will also handle IRS audit defense. Manage and maintain Adobe's Qualified Intermediary (QI) framework and its ongoing compliance, including leading the periodic QI assessment and validation and directing external advisors through the process. Manage the back-office platforms related to Adobe’s withholding tax processes and their day-to-day operations, directing operational support for the workflow. Lead the tax technical analysis of novel and complex payment streams (for example, AI dataset and training-related payments), engage and align external advisors on the position taken, and translate conclusions into scalable, defensible system logic. Serve as the subject-matter expert on withholding tax matters for Adobe throughout the business. Build and Scale Tax Systems, Automation, and Operations Partner with IT, Procurement, Supplier Onboarding, and business optimization teams to compose, build, and maintain withholding tax and associated tax systems. Drive continuous process improvement and automation to scale workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce manual effort. Manage U.S. Transfer Pricing Charge-Outs and Cross Charges Manage the U.S. headquarter services charge-out, including cost pool and markup calculations, coordination with functional controllers, and preparation of the supporting transfer pricing report and documentation as well as managing the associated SOX controls. Support other intercompany transfer pricing cross charges and their operational implementation. Manage Pillar Two Compliance and Support Provision Manage the end-to-end Pillar Two (GloBE) compliance process using the Orbitax platform, including data collection, calculations, and required filings. Support the Pillar Two provision workstream, including the ASC 740 impacts of top-up tax and related disclosures, in partnership with the tax provision team. Serve as system and platform owner for Orbitax, including data uploads, maintenance, and keeping the tool and process current. Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and business teams on other strategic and cross-functional projects. The Opportunity: International Tax Manager, Tax Operations
At Adobe, we empower the world's most creative minds through digital experiences that shape the future! Our Global Tax team plays a critical role in enabling that innovation, delivering high-quality tax solutions that support growth across 50+ countries.
We're seeking a hands-on, analytical professional to lead Adobe's U.S. withholding tax function and drive the systems and processes behind it. Reporting to the Director of U.S. International Tax and based in San Jose, this role pairs technical execution with a strong operations and technology mandate: building, improving, and scaling the platforms and workflows that keep Adobe's tax function accurate and efficient. You will coordinate Pillar Two compliance and assist with related provision work. You will manage U.S. transfer pricing allocations and support the broader U.S. international tax compliance and provision cycle. You will also contribute to M&A integration and other cross-functional initiatives. You're a self-starter who takes initiative, owns problems end to end, and drives workstreams forward with minimal oversight, defining the approach and aligning partners rather than waiting for direction.
As tax laws, business operations, and the global operating environment continue to evolve rapidly, we need a Manager who is eager to learn, adapt quickly, and expand their impact across the organization, helping Adobe navigate complex tax matters effectively.
If you thrive on operationalizing complex tax positions, love building systems and automating processes (including AI), and want to make a tangible impact at a global tech leader, this is your opportunity.
What you'll do:
Own U.S. Withholding Tax (1042) End-to-End
  • Own the entire workflow for U.S. tax withholding on outbound vendor payments. This includes technical determinations, W-8/W-9 documentation, deposits, reconciliations, and Form 1042/1042-S reporting and filings. You will also handle IRS audit defense.
  • Manage and maintain Adobe's Qualified Intermediary (QI) framework and its ongoing compliance, including leading the periodic QI assessment and validation and directing external advisors through the process.
  • Manage the back-office platforms related to Adobe’s withholding tax processes and their day-to-day operations, directing operational support for the workflow.
  • Lead the tax technical analysis of novel and complex payment streams (for example, AI dataset and training-related payments), engage and align external advisors on the position taken, and translate conclusions into scalable, defensible system logic.
  • Serve as the subject-matter expert on withholding tax matters for Adobe throughout the business.
Build and Scale Tax Systems, Automation, and Operations
  • Partner with IT, Procurement, Supplier Onboarding, and business optimization teams to compose, build, and maintain withholding tax and associated tax systems.
  • Drive continuous process improvement and automation to scale workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce manual effort.
Manage U.S. Transfer Pricing Charge-Outs and Cross Charges
  • Manage the U.S. headquarter services charge-out, including cost pool and markup calculations, coordination with functional controllers, and preparation of the supporting transfer pricing report and documentation as well as managing the associated SOX controls.
  • Support other intercompany transfer pricing cross charges and their operational implementation.
Manage Pillar Two Compliance and Support Provision
  • Manage the end-to-end Pillar Two (GloBE) compliance process using the Orbitax platform, including data collection, calculations, and required filings.
  • Support the Pillar Two provision workstream, including the ASC 740 impacts of top-up tax and related disclosures, in partnership with the tax provision team.
  • Serve as system and platform owner for Orbitax, including data uploads, maintenance, and keeping the tool and process current.
Support compliance efforts related to U.S. international taxation, Provision, and Audits
  • Prepare calculations related to U.S. cross-border taxation, including Subpart F, GILTI, FDII, and FTC, in support of the U.S. global tax reporting and provision process.
  • Assist in streamlining and automating parts of the end-to-end compliance and provision life cycle through improved data workflows and technology.
  • Assist with U.S. international components of tax audits and controversy (IDR responses and analysis).
Support M&A Integration and Cross-Functional Initiatives
  • Assist with post-acquisition tax integration, including onboarding acquired entities into withholding tax, transfer pricing, and regulatory adherence and provision processes and systems.
  • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, and business teams on other strategic and cross-functional projects.
What you need to succeed:
Required
  • CPA, MST, JD/LL.M. in Taxation, or equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of international tax experience (Big 4 and/or large multinational)
  • Working knowledge of withholding requirements under U.S. tax law for outbound payments (Chapter 3, Sections 1441 and 1442, W-8 documentation, and Form 1042/1042-S reporting), including treaty analysis
  • Knowledge of key U.S. international tax regimes (GILTI, Subpart F, FDII, BEAT, FTC) and broader U.S. corporate tax principles
  • Experience with, or strong ability to develop, tax technology and systems, including partnering with IT and Procurement to build and improve tax workflows and drive automation
  • Familiarity with transfer pricing concepts, including intercompany services charge-outs; exposure to the Section 482 services regulations a plus
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems (for example, SAP), OneSource, and/or tax compliance platforms
Preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Pillar Two (GloBE) compliance and/or provision, ideally using Orbitax or a comparable platform
  • Hands-on experience managing a Qualified Intermediary (QI) structure, including the periodic review and certification process
  • Exposure to M&A and post-acquisition integration matters
  • Passion for using technology (AI, automation) to transform tax processes
If you're looking for a role where you take ownership of Adobe's U.S. withholding tax operations, you will build scalable systems. You will also play a role in an outstanding tax function that supports Adobe's creative innovation. We'd love to hear from you!

description: The Opportunity The Lead Growth & AI Platform Engineer will play a pivotal role in transforming Adobe.com's Growth and Martech Engineering (GME) platform into an AI-first engineering ecosystem. description:
The Opportunity Firefly Foundry is Adobe's enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer's IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces. As customers bring ever-larger libraries of media and generate ever more of it, the ability to process, understand, and search that content — for people and, increasingly, for AI agents — is becoming one of the product's core forms of leverage. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment, marketing, and consumer retail, and is expanding rapidly into adjacent verticals. We are hiring a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to architect and lead the data processing, indexing, and search infrastructure behind Firefly Foundry's media intelligence — the systems that turn massive volumes of customer media (image, video, 3D, audio) and model-derived signals (embeddings, captions, entities, shot and scene structure, aesthetic, safety, and IP labels) into structured, low-latency, searchable intelligence, and that expose it as agentic search: retrieval designed to be driven by AI agents, not only by people. This is a systems and infrastructure role, not a model-training or research role — you won't be running training experiments. You own the platform on the other side of the model: the pipelines that enrich and index media at scale, the hybrid and multimodal retrieval stack that serves it, and the tool interfaces and grounding contracts that let agentic workflows retrieve, reason, and cite. As a Senior Staff engineer you set the multi-year technical direction for this platform, are the recognized technical authority for data and search across Firefly Foundry, and multiply the teams around you through design leadership and mentorship. Your work has direct, measurable impact on the recall, freshness, latency, cost, and scale of everything Firefly Foundry's intelligence and agents depend on. What you will do Design and build scalable data-processing pipelines that transform raw customer media and model-derived signals (embeddings, captions, entities, shot/scene structure, safety and IP labels) into structured, searchable intelligence — with the throughput, correctness, and cost profile enterprise scale demands. Contribute to the technical vision and architecture for Firefly Foundry's media-intelligence data platform and search stack — the systems that ingest, enrich, index, and serve retrieval over billions of media assets — and be the engineer the organization looks to for the hardest data and search decisions. Architect the indexing and search infrastructure — hybrid lexical + vector (ANN) retrieval, multimodal and cross-modal search, ranking and reranking, faceting and rich metadata filtering — tuned for both human and agent consumers. Make search a first-class capability for agents — tool/function-call retrieval interfaces, multi-hop query planning, iterative retrieval, and grounded results with citations and provenance that agentic workflows can trust. Own index lifecycle and freshness — incremental and streaming indexing, backfills and reprocessing, and schema and embedding-model versioning — so the index stays correct and current as models and content evolve. Engineer for enterprise from the ground up — per-tenant index isolation, data residency, and the access controls that let us honor customer IP contracts under audit. Define and enforce retrieval quality gates — offline and online evaluation (recall@k, nDCG, groundedness), regression detection, and drift monitoring — that block quality regressions from reaching production. Own the performance and cost envelope of the platform — query latency (p50/p99) and throughput SLAs, ANN index tuning, GPU-accelerated enrichment (embedding/captioning) at scale, and right-sizing storage, serving, and accelerator fleets. Build the platform underneath it all — rapid pipeline and index deployment, observability, monitoring, and alerting across data and search systems. Run these systems operationally at enterprise scale — on-call, incident response, and postmortems for availability, freshness, and latency regressions. Lead technically across teams — set standards, drive build/buy and design decisions, mentor senior engineers, and represent Firefly Foundry's data and search architecture to leadership and partner orgs. Who you will partner with Applied Science — on embedding, captioning, and understanding models and rankers; taking model output into reliable, high-recall retrieval and keeping retrieval quality faithful as models evolve. Agent & product teams — the primary consumers of agentic search; co-designing retrieval tool interfaces, grounding contracts, and the feedback loops that improve them. ML Engineering leadership & AI Platform — on shared infrastructure, storage and accelerator capacity, and search/serving primitives at platform scale. Firefly Foundry Studio — to turn creative production and media-management workflows into fast, dependable search experiences. What you bring 10+ years in machine learning, data, or infrastructure engineering, including deep ownership of large-scale data processing and/or search & retrieval systems in production — and a track record of leading systems and setting technical direction across teams. Deep expertise designing and operating search and retrieval infrastructure at scale — vector/ANN (e.g., HNSW, IVF, ScaNN, DiskANN), lexical search (Lucene / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch), hybrid retrieval, ranking and reranking, and query understanding. Strong data-engineering foundations — large-scale batch and streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Beam, Flink, Ray), data modeling, and the storage systems behind them (object stores, vector databases, columnar/OLAP). Experience building retrieval for LLM and agentic systems — RAG, multimodal and cross-modal search, grounding and provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Strong Python, plus a systems language (Go, Rust, or C++) a plus; hands-on familiarity with embedding models and the inference paths that produce them (PyTorch). A track record building the observability, monitoring, and alerting that data and search systems rely on to hit freshness, recall, and latency SLAs. Experience with multi-tenant systems and data isolation in an enterprise or regulated context. Fluency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and a major cloud (AWS or Azure). Comfort reasoning about retrieval quality and relevance across modalities (text, image, video, 3D, audio), in partnership with Applied Science. Proven technical leadership — mentoring senior engineers, driving cross-org design and build/buy decisions, and influencing roadmap and standards. Excellent communication and data-driven problem-solving in cross-functional settings, including with leadership.
