full_job_description_raw:
The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry is Adobe's enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI — deep-tuned image, video, and 3D models built on each customer's IP, paired with creative production workflows and a media-intelligence layer, and deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces. As customers bring ever-larger libraries of media and generate ever more of it, the ability to process, understand, and search that content — for people and, increasingly, for AI agents — is becoming one of the product's core forms of leverage. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment, marketing, and consumer retail, and is expanding rapidly into adjacent verticals.

We are hiring a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to architect and lead the data processing, indexing, and search infrastructure behind Firefly Foundry's media intelligence — the systems that turn massive volumes of customer media (image, video, 3D, audio) and model-derived signals (embeddings, captions, entities, shot and scene structure, aesthetic, safety, and IP labels) into structured, low-latency, searchable intelligence, and that expose it as agentic search: retrieval designed to be driven by AI agents, not only by people.

This is a systems and infrastructure role, not a model-training or research role — you won't be running training experiments. You own the platform on the other side of the model: the pipelines that enrich and index media at scale, the hybrid and multimodal retrieval stack that serves it, and the tool interfaces and grounding contracts that let agentic workflows retrieve, reason, and cite. As a Senior Staff engineer you set the multi-year technical direction for this platform, are the recognized technical authority for data and search across Firefly Foundry, and multiply the teams around you through design leadership and mentorship. Your work has direct, measurable impact on the recall, freshness, latency, cost, and scale of everything Firefly Foundry's intelligence and agents depend on.

What you will do

  • Design and build scalable data-processing pipelines that transform raw customer media and model-derived signals (embeddings, captions, entities, shot/scene structure, safety and IP labels) into structured, searchable intelligence — with the throughput, correctness, and cost profile enterprise scale demands.
  • Contribute to the technical vision and architecture for Firefly Foundry's media-intelligence data platform and search stack — the systems that ingest, enrich, index, and serve retrieval over billions of media assets — and be the engineer the organization looks to for the hardest data and search decisions.
  • Architect the indexing and search infrastructure — hybrid lexical + vector (ANN) retrieval, multimodal and cross-modal search, ranking and reranking, faceting and rich metadata filtering — tuned for both human and agent consumers.
  • Make search a first-class capability for agents — tool/function-call retrieval interfaces, multi-hop query planning, iterative retrieval, and grounded results with citations and provenance that agentic workflows can trust.
  • Own index lifecycle and freshness — incremental and streaming indexing, backfills and reprocessing, and schema and embedding-model versioning — so the index stays correct and current as models and content evolve.
  • Engineer for enterprise from the ground up — per-tenant index isolation, data residency, and the access controls that let us honor customer IP contracts under audit.
  • Define and enforce retrieval quality gates — offline and online evaluation (recall@k, nDCG, groundedness), regression detection, and drift monitoring — that block quality regressions from reaching production.
  • Own the performance and cost envelope of the platform — query latency (p50/p99) and throughput SLAs, ANN index tuning, GPU-accelerated enrichment (embedding/captioning) at scale, and right-sizing storage, serving, and accelerator fleets.
  • Build the platform underneath it all — rapid pipeline and index deployment, observability, monitoring, and alerting across data and search systems.
  • Run these systems operationally at enterprise scale — on-call, incident response, and postmortems for availability, freshness, and latency regressions.
  • Lead technically across teams — set standards, drive build/buy and design decisions, mentor senior engineers, and represent Firefly Foundry's data and search architecture to leadership and partner orgs.

Who you will partner with

  • Applied Science — on embedding, captioning, and understanding models and rankers; taking model output into reliable, high-recall retrieval and keeping retrieval quality faithful as models evolve.
  • Agent & product teams — the primary consumers of agentic search; co-designing retrieval tool interfaces, grounding contracts, and the feedback loops that improve them.
  • ML Engineering leadership & AI Platform — on shared infrastructure, storage and accelerator capacity, and search/serving primitives at platform scale.
  • Firefly Foundry Studio — to turn creative production and media-management workflows into fast, dependable search experiences.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in machine learning, data, or infrastructure engineering, including deep ownership of large-scale data processing and/or search & retrieval systems in production — and a track record of leading systems and setting technical direction across teams.
  • Deep expertise designing and operating search and retrieval infrastructure at scale — vector/ANN (e.g., HNSW, IVF, ScaNN, DiskANN), lexical search (Lucene / Elasticsearch / OpenSearch), hybrid retrieval, ranking and reranking, and query understanding.
  • Strong data-engineering foundations — large-scale batch and streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Beam, Flink, Ray), data modeling, and the storage systems behind them (object stores, vector databases, columnar/OLAP).
  • Experience building retrieval for LLM and agentic systems — RAG, multimodal and cross-modal search, grounding and provenance, and retrieval evaluation.
  • Strong Python, plus a systems language (Go, Rust, or C++) a plus; hands-on familiarity with embedding models and the inference paths that produce them (PyTorch).
  • A track record building the observability, monitoring, and alerting that data and search systems rely on to hit freshness, recall, and latency SLAs.
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems and data isolation in an enterprise or regulated context.
  • Fluency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and a major cloud (AWS or Azure).
  • Comfort reasoning about retrieval quality and relevance across modalities (text, image, video, 3D, audio), in partnership with Applied Science.
  • Proven technical leadership — mentoring senior engineers, driving cross-org design and build/buy decisions, and influencing roadmap and standards.
  • Excellent communication and data-driven problem-solving in cross-functional settings, including with leadership.

Education

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience building and operating large-scale data and search systems.

The Opportunity 

Adobe's mission is to change the world through personalized digital experiences. As Vice President, Product and Software Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring that security, trust, and resilience remain foundational to the trustworthy digital experiences Adobe delivers to millions of customers worldwide. 

Reporting to the Chief Security Officer, you will lead Adobe's global Product and Software Security organization, responsible for securing Adobe's products and technology ecosystem while enabling innovation at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Platforms, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Legal, and Security leaders to shape the future of secure software development and strengthen customer trust across Adobe's portfolio. 

As a member of the Security Leadership Team, you will help Adobe make risk-informed decisions that balance customer trust, business priorities, engineering velocity, and long-term security investments. This role requires an outstanding combination of technical credibility, executive leadership, critical thinking, and business judgment.  

What You'll Do 

Define and Implement Security Strategy  

  • Establish Adobe's vision and strategy for Product and Software Security, ensuring security is embedded by design across products, platforms, and development ecosystems. 

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Product, Engineering, Platform, and Security leaders, helping drive innovation, customer trust, and business growth. 

  • Anticipate emerging threats, technologies, and industry trends to keep Adobe at the forefront of product security. 

Drive Systemic Risk Reduction 

  • Lead Adobe's efforts to reduce risk through secure-by-default architectures, platforms, controls, and engineering practices. 

  • Champion scalable solutions that eliminate classes of risk at their source rather than relying solely on issue-by-issue remediation. 

  • Balance near-term risk reduction with long-term investments that strengthen Adobe's overall security posture. 

Shape Trust and Security in the AI Era 

  • Define Adobe's Product Security strategy for AI-powered products, services, and platforms. 

  • Ensure security, safety, and trust are embedded throughout the lifecycle of AI-enabled experiences. 

  • Leverage AI to improve security effectiveness while enabling responsible innovation at scale. 

Lead and Develop a World-Class Organization 

  • Lead a global organization spanning Product Security Engineering, Security Partnerships, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and regional product security teams. 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional leaders and technical talent while building strong succession pipelines. 

  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. 

Strengthen Customer Trust 

  • Partner across Adobe to ensure products are designed, built, tested, and operated with security embedded throughout the lifecycle. 

  • Represent Adobe's Product and Software Security strategy with customers, partners, industry peers, and executive collaborators.  

  • Champion transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in service of customer trust. 

What You'll Bring 

  • Proven success leading large-scale Product Security, Software Security, Application Security, or related organizations within complex global technology companies. 

  • Deep expertise in secure software development, cloud-native architectures, software supply chain security, and modern security engineering practices, including secure-by-default approaches. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior engineering, product, platform, and business leaders, translating complex technical risks into practical business decisions and strategic priorities. 

  • Strong executive presence, business judgment, and communication skills, with a track record of building hard-working organizations and developing outstanding leadership talent.  

  • Familiarity with the opportunities and security considerations associated with AI-powered products and services. 

Leadership Characteristics 

The successful candidate will: 

  • Create the Future by enabling secure innovation and helping Adobe capitalize on emerging technologies. 

  • Own the Outcome by driving meaningful improvements in security, trust, and organizational effectiveness. 

  • Set a higher standard through technical excellence, operational rigor, and talent development.  

  • Be Genuine by building trusted partnerships and leading with transparency and integrity.

description:
The Opportunity Every new model capability Firefly ships should show up everywhere a creator might want it, immediately — without each surface rebuilding the same prompt-to-output experience from scratch. That's the platform this role gets to build: a single, reusable generation experience any Firefly surface can adopt, configure, and extend as new capabilities arrive. This is as much a craft problem as a technical one. The experience has to feel simple and obvious, with real depth underneath for the surfaces that need it. We're looking for one of the strongest partners the design org has! This only works as a genuinely well-crafted shared experience teams want to adopt, not a spec handed down from engineering. What you'll Do Build the generation experience as a platform Own the requirements, architecture-level tradeoffs, and rollout plan for a shared prompting and generation experience that works across every Firefly surface. Balance what's core and universal versus what's configurable per surface. Partner deeply with engineering on the technical contract underneath: how it talks to Firefly's generation services, how new models become available without client-side rework, and how the whole thing stays fast and light wherever it's embedded. Be an exceptional partner to design Work hand-in-hand with the design team to shape what this experience actually looks and feels like, balancing a small, obvious set of controls for most people with real capability underneath for those who need more. Own how it scales across a wide range of surfaces, model types, and workflows, and navigate what that means as the product becomes more agentic and editing and generation converge — without every variation feeling like its own product. How would you draw that line? Own Activation: turning new capability into a shipped experience on day one Watch new capabilities as they emerge, from research, competitors, and the model landscape broadly. Decide the right use case, surface, and experience before anyone starts building. Shape and deliver the launch experience that puts new capability in front of creators immediately! Take direct ownership of the new experiences that don't fit the existing pattern yet. This role defines the next interaction pattern, not just maintains the current one. What you'll Need Strong product management experience with a track record of shipping platform-level or shared-component experiences that multiple teams adopt. Excellent design instincts and genuine fluency partnering with designers. This role co-leads experience decisions, not just gathers requirements. Technical depth sufficient to engage credibly on architecture tradeoffs. A strong point of view on a unified direction, and the patience to build real support across teams with their own preferences. An eye for genuinely new interaction patterns as capabilities emerge, not just maintenance of what already exists. The Opportunity 

Every new model capability Firefly ships should show up everywhere a creator might want it, immediately — without each surface rebuilding the same prompt-to-output experience from scratch. That's the platform this role gets to build: a single, reusable generation experience any Firefly surface can adopt, configure, and extend as new capabilities arrive.

This is as much a craft problem as a technical one. The experience has to feel simple and obvious, with real depth underneath for the surfaces that need it. We're looking for one of the strongest partners the design org has! This only works as a genuinely well-crafted shared experience teams want to adopt, not a spec handed down from engineering.

What you'll Do 

Build the generation experience as a platform

  • Own the requirements, architecture-level tradeoffs, and rollout plan for a shared prompting and generation experience that works across every Firefly surface.
  • Balance what's core and universal versus what's configurable per surface.
  • Partner deeply with engineering on the technical contract underneath: how it talks to Firefly's generation services, how new models become available without client-side rework, and how the whole thing stays fast and light wherever it's embedded.

Be an exceptional partner to design

  • Work hand-in-hand with the design team to shape what this experience actually looks and feels like, balancing a small, obvious set of controls for most people with real capability underneath for those who need more.
  • Own how it scales across a wide range of surfaces, model types, and workflows, and navigate what that means as the product becomes more agentic and editing and generation converge — without every variation feeling like its own product. How would you draw that line?

Own Activation: turning new capability into a shipped experience on day one

  • Watch new capabilities as they emerge, from research, competitors, and the model landscape broadly. Decide the right use case, surface, and experience before anyone starts building.
  • Shape and deliver the launch experience that puts new capability in front of creators immediately!
  • Take direct ownership of the new experiences that don't fit the existing pattern yet. This role defines the next interaction pattern, not just maintains the current one.

What you'll Need

  • Strong product management experience with a track record of shipping platform-level or shared-component experiences that multiple teams adopt.
  • Excellent design instincts and genuine fluency partnering with designers. This role co-leads experience decisions, not just gathers requirements.
  • Technical depth sufficient to engage credibly on architecture tradeoffs.
  • A strong point of view on a unified direction, and the patience to build real support across teams with their own preferences.
  • An eye for genuinely new interaction patterns as capabilities emerge, not just maintenance of what already exists.

description:
About the Role We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Applied Science Data Frameworks team responsible for building the foundational infrastructure that powers large-scale multimodal AI training and inference. This role is ideal for someone with strong distributed systems and data engineering fundamentals who is eager to work in an ML-adjacent environment, contributing to training data loaders, distributed inference frameworks, feature enrichment pipelines, and dataset management systems that enable ML teams to train foundation models at petabyte scale. You'll work on high-impact projects involving distributed data loading for PyTorch training workloads, batch inference pipelines for feature enrichment, semantic search infrastructure for dataset discovery, and production-grade ML data pipelines that support generative AI model development. Your systems will process billions of images, videos, and multimodal content across large-scale GPU clusters. If you're excited about building distributed data frameworks, optimizing data pipelines at scale, and growing your expertise in ML infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do Contribute to building and maintaining distributed training data loaders that handle multi-source data ingestion, temporal sampling, and real-time transformations for large-scale model training workflows. Help implement and maintain feature enrichment pipelines and dataset registry systems that support multimodal model training across images, video, documents, and text. Build and maintain batch inference pipelines for large-scale feature extraction, processing assets through distributed GPU clusters with queue management and fault tolerance. Develop data processing systems using frameworks like Apache Ray, Spark, DuckDB, or similar distributed computing tools for SQL-based data ingestion and Apache Arrow-based storage formats. Support semantic search capabilities and vector database infrastructure (e.g., OpenSearch, LanceDB) for dataset discovery and embedding-based retrieval. Contribute to CI/CD infrastructure for ML systems including self-hosted runner management, Docker image builds, automated testing pipelines, and deployment automation. Collaborate with ML research teams to translate training requirements into reliable, scalable data loading and preprocessing infrastructure. Write reusable framework components, SDKs, and documentation to help accelerate platform adoption across modeling teams. Optimize data pipeline performance across dimensions like startup latency, throughput, memory footprint, and GPU utilization. Contribute to observability and reliability standards for production data systems supporting 24/7 training workloads. What You Need to Succeed 5-6 years of professional experience building and operating distributed systems or data infrastructure in production environments. Solid understanding of distributed computing concepts and experience with framework like Apache Spark, Ray, Dask, or equivalent. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and data platforms such as Databricks or Spark. Proficiency in Python and strong software engineering fundamentals — system design, data structures, algorithms. Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow; hands-on ML experience is a plus but not required. Basic familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and deployment automation. Familiarity with batch inference architectures and large-scale data processing patterns is a plus. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MS is a plus. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering and research teams. About the Role

Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.

In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.

The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.

  • Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.

  • Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).

  • Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.

  • Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.

  • Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.

  • Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.

  • 8+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.

  • Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.

Adobe is looking for Machine Learning Engineer interns to work on some of the most impactful AI systems in the industry — from generative AI features and intelligent agents to search, recommendations, and production ML models used by hundreds of millions of people.

The work is applied, the teams are technical, and the projects are real.

  • Contribute to applied AI projects with real product impact, including generative AI features, agentic workflows, and intelligent systems used by Adobe customers at scale

Our Company   

Empowering everyone to create. 

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create and bring digital experiences to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow, and build remarkable experiences. 

We are looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process. 

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI. 

Our Team 

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.  

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency. 

The Opportunity  

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own creative work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. Adobe Creative is looking for a visionary Head of Design to define design excellence for Adobe and build the practice, systems and culture that bring it to life across everything we create. 

  

You will lead design across our creative, content and experiences, from high-velocity everyday work to major global campaigns, product launches and Adobe’s most visible moments. You will raise the quality of the work at every scale, creating greater coherence without making it repetitive or predictable. 

  

Working upstream, you will establish the principles, frameworks, and practices that help teams make stronger design decisions earlier. You will translate them into tools, templates, and AI-enabled workflows that help internal teams and external partners deliver exceptional work at scale. 

  

The Head of Brand owns Adobe’s identity architecture and core brand system. You own the design practice and creative expression across the work, ensuring the brand is interpreted and brought to life with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination. 

  

Design leadership at Adobe extends beyond traditional graphic design. It includes typography, image-making, art direction, motion, digital behavior, spatial experience, editorial thinking, emerging technology, and the creative use of AI. 

  

You are a maker first. You remain close to the tools, the teams, and the work. Your authority comes from your eyes, your judgment, and your ability to make the work better. 

 

 

What You’ll Do 

Set the Standard and Build the Practice 

  • Define and hold the design craft standard across Adobe Creative.  

  • Establish a clear point of view on world-class design in the age of AI.  

  • Build shared principles for typography, image-making, art direction, motion, interaction and emerging visual practices.  

  • Raise the design standard across everything we make, from high-velocity work to our most visible global moments.  

  • Ensure the work feels connected and recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic.  

  • Build frameworks, tools, and working practices that enable strong design decisions from the start.  

  • Partner with the Head of Brand to translate Adobe’s identity system into distinctive and adaptable creative expression.  

  • Partner with Production, Operations and Creative Technology to protect craft while supporting speed and scale.  

Lead Design Across the Work 

  • Lead design from early creative development through final execution.  

  • Set the art direction and design craft across Adobe’s creative, content and experiences.  

  • Shape Adobe’s most visible global campaigns, product launches, cultural moments and live experiences.  

  • Ensure strong ideas scale across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact.  

  • Partner with the Head of Campaigns to turn breakthrough ideas into compelling visual worlds.  

  • Partner with the Head of Copy to develop visual and verbal expression as one connected creative system.  

  • Direct agencies, design studios and specialist collaborators from a clear internal Adobe point of view.  

  • Hold externally produced work to the same standard as internal creative.  

Cultivate a world-Class community of Designers 

  • Lead and develop Creative Directors, Associate Creative Directors, Art Directors, and Designers.  

  • Build a strong leadership bench and clear pathways for makers to grow.  

  • Recruit exceptional designers with diverse perspectives, multidisciplinary skills, and a deep commitment to craft.  

  • Create a culture of direct feedback, high standards, experimentation, generosity, and continuous learning.  

  • Keep senior design leaders close to the work and protect meaningful time for making.  

  • Build flexible teams around the creative opportunity rather than fixed structures.  

  • Connect designers across the organization, so knowledge, tools, and creative learning are shared.  

Advance AI-Native Design 

  • Define Adobe Creative’s point of view on how AI changes design practice, craft and authorship.  

  • Build AI-native workflows that expand creative possibility and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.  

  • Establish principles for evaluating AI-assisted work through originality, intention, taste, craft and brand distinction.  

  • Define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and judgment remain essential.  

  • Partner with Product as a creative customer zero, testing emerging capabilities through real work and translating learning into useful feedback.  

  • Ensure teams understand responsible AI, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.  

Represent Design Across Adobe 

  • Represent design in executive and cross-functional forums.  

  • Translate creative direction and craft decisions into clear, actionable choices.  

  • Advocate for design to be involved earlier in strategic, product and creative development.  

  • Connect design excellence to audience impact, brand distinction and business value.  

  • Present work with clarity, confidence, and conviction. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • 15+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative leadership. 

  • A world-class portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across creative, content and experiences. 

  • Significant experience as a senior design leader, Executive Creative Director, Design Director or equivalent. 

  • Meaningful industry recognition through D&AD, Cannes Lions, The One Show, ADC, AIGA or equivalent. 

  • Experience leading design across both high-velocity output and major flagship work. 

  • A track record of building design practices, systems and teams, not only reviewing finished work. 

  • Exceptional taste and the ability to explain clearly why work succeeds or falls short. 

  • Deep expertise in typography, art direction and image-making, with strong fluency across motion, digital, spatial, editorial and emerging design practices. 

  • Experience translating brand systems into distinctive and evolving creative expression. 

  • Experience directing agencies, design studios, and specialist partners. 

  • Deep fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and generative AI workflows. 

  • A clear point of view on how AI changes design practice, authorship and creative scale. 

  • A commanding presenter who can communicate the value of design to senior executives. 

  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, technology, art, fashion, entertainment and creator communities. 

  • A track record of building multidisciplinary teams, developing future leaders and maintaining a high standard through speed, ambiguity and change. 


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. 


Let’s Adobe together

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.


At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

 

Expected Pay Range:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

Brand leadership at Adobe extends beyond static guidelines. It includes identity, typography, color, imagery, motion, digital behavior, spatial expression, portfolio architecture, governance and the role of AI in applying brands at scale.


The Head of Brand Design owns Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system, including the principles that govern visual and verbal identity. The Head of Design owns the design practice and visual expression across Adobe Creative's work; the Head of Copy owns the copywriting practice and creative expression of Adobe's verbal identity; and the Head of Campaigns owns the campaign platforms and central ideas that bring the brand to market. You partner closely with each to ensure the system enables distinctive creative expression without fragmenting the brand.


You are a maker first. You remain close to the tools, the teams and the work. Your authority comes from your taste, your judgment and the strength of the systems you build.


What You'll Do

Define Adobe's Brand for the New Era

  • Own Adobe's identity architecture and core brand system.
  • Establish a clear point of view on what a modern, adaptive global brand should be in the age of AI.
  • Define the principles, visual codes and behaviors that make Adobe unmistakably Adobe.
  • Own the governing principles of Adobe's verbal identity, naming architecture, nomenclature and tone of voice, partnering with the Head of Copy on creative application.
  • Ensure the brand remains coherent across products, audiences and experiences without becoming rigid or predictable.
  • Build a system capable of supporting both flagship creative expression and everyday execution.
  • Continually evolve the brand based on culture, technology and the changing ways people create.

Build the Brand System Upstream

  • Build the identity frameworks, tools and working practices that enable teams to make strong brand decisions from the start.
  • Translate brand strategy into practical systems across typography, color, imagery, motion, composition, behavior and verbal principles.
  • Create modular and adaptive tools that support speed, scale and creative flexibility.
  • Move Adobe beyond static guidelines toward structured, machine-readable brand logic.
  • Partner with Creative Technology, Product, Production and Operations to embed brand principles into tools and workflows.
  • Turn learning from real-world applications into improvements to the system.

Lead Brand Expression Across Adobe

  • Lead the development and evolution of Adobe's corporate, portfolio and product brand expression.
  • Shape Adobe's most visible identity systems and brand expressions across products, campaigns and real-world moments.
  • Partner with the Head of Design to ensure Adobe's identity system is interpreted with exceptional craft, intelligence and imagination across Adobe Creative's work.
  • Partner with the Head of Copy to translate Adobe's verbal identity, naming principles, nomenclature and tone of voice into distinctive creative expression across Adobe Creative's work.
  • Partner with the Head of Campaigns to ensure campaign platforms stretch and advance the brand without fragmenting it.
  • Partner with Content and Experiences leaders so Adobe's brand system supports publishing and real-world expression with clarity and flexibility.
  • Ensure the system performs across digital, physical, spatial, motion and emerging AI-enabled surfaces.
  • Hold externally produced brand-system work to the same standard as internal brand work.

Build a World-Class Brand Team

  • Build and lead Adobe's in-house team of Brand Design Directors, Art Directors, Brand Systems Designers and Brand Designers.
  • Build a strong leadership bench and clear pathways for makers to grow.
  • Recruit exceptional brand designers with diverse perspectives, strong craft and rigorous systems thinking.
  • Create a culture of high standards, experimentation, direct feedback and creative generosity.
  • Keep senior brand leaders close to the work and protect meaningful time for making.
  • Build flexible teams around identity, systems, expression and emerging brand needs.
  • Reduce dependence on external agencies for Adobe's core brand thinking and creative authorship.

Advance AI-Native Brand Systems

  • Define Adobe Creative's point of view on how AI changes identity, governance and brand application.
  • Build brand systems that can be understood and applied by people, templates and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish principles for evaluating AI-assisted brand output through distinctiveness, coherence, craft and human judgment.
  • Define where automation can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.
  • Partner with Product as a creative customer zero, testing how brand logic can be embedded into emerging tools and experiences.
  • Ensure teams understand responsible AI, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Represent Brand Across Adobe

  • Represent Adobe's brand system and identity in executive and cross-functional forums.
  • Translate identity and brand decisions into clear, actionable choices.
  • Advocate for brand to be involved earlier in product, portfolio and business decisions.
  • Connect brand distinction and coherence to recognition, trust, preference and long-term value.
  • Present work with clarity, confidence and conviction.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 15+ years of experience in brand design, visual identity or multidisciplinary brand leadership.
  • A world-class portfolio of identity systems for iconic global brands.
  • Significant experience as a Design Partner, Executive Creative Director, Global Brand Design Director or equivalent.
  • Meaningful industry recognition through D&AD, The One Show, ADC, Cannes Lions or equivalent.
  • Exceptional taste, visual judgment and systems thinking.
  • A track record of building identity systems that are both beautifully designed and operationally rigorous.
  • Experience navigating portfolio architecture, product brands and complex global organizations.
  • Experience building or significantly transforming an in-house brand capability.
  • Deep expertise in identity, typography, color, image-making and motion, with strong fluency across digital, spatial and emerging brand practices.
  • Experience developing modular, adaptive or machine-readable brand systems.
  • Experience directing brand agencies, design studios and specialist partners.
  • Deep fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and generative AI workflows.
  • A clear point of view on how AI changes brand creation, governance and application.
  • A commanding presenter who can communicate the value of brand to senior executives.
  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, technology, art, fashion, entertainment and creator communities.
  • A track record of building multidisciplinary teams, developing future brand leaders and maintaining a high standard through speed, ambiguity and change.

The platform enables interoperability of agents, capabilities, and workflows across the Adobe Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Document Clouds, and future product lines. It is transforming Adobe from a suite of best-in-class tools into a unified, AI-native ecosystem. This platform encompasses agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, skill and capability catalogs, and the planning and reasoning layers that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows at enterprise scale. We are seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to own the engineering vision and execution of building the Adobe Intelligence Platform. This is a pivotal role to invent, embed, and scale the latest in AI innovation into Adobe’s products. This role is highly visible and key to executing Adobe’s vision to transform the way creators and their teams work and create. What you will do Define and drive a holistic and full stack engineering strategy for the Adobe Intelligence Platform. Integrate platform components into web, desktop, and mobile surfaces, partnering with global teams to accelerate their timelines and unify the customer experience. Grow the organization, including hiring world-class talent, structuring teams, and developing the next generation of AI leaders within Adobe. Model and drive a new way of working, using the latest AI tooling to plan, review, and ship software. Own the technology strategy, pairing with senior architects, to define the roadmaps for agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, agentic harnesses, and skill catalogs. Set and run the operating rhythm with program and product partners: planning, prioritization, cross-team dependencies, and how the org measures its own progress. Partner with Research and Design to shape the future of applied AI by shortening the loop from cutting edge to production. Partner with Engineering, Program and Product leaders across the organization to understand their local needs and drive adoption of the AIP platform across Adobe. Align with Security, Privacy and Legal colleagues to ensure the platform has observability, security, and enterprise governance controls around safety and trust built into the end-to-end architecture. Define the adoption strategy and own the outcome for partnerships internally: ensure Adobe Intelligence Platform is serving the needs of application teams at all levels and across Adobe’s 3 cloud offering areas. What You’ll Need to Succeed 12+ years of engineering experience, including significant time leading engineering organizations through ambiguity and change. Direct experience with platform or infrastructure work: building the layer other engineering teams depend on. Working fluency in AI/ML systems: evals, context management, model gateways, and adjacent areas. Technical depth with agentic frameworks and the operational patterns to manage them at scale. The Opportunity 

Adobe Intelligence Platform is the foundational AI infrastructure that powers agentic experiences across the Adobe product portfolio. The platform enables interoperability of agents, capabilities, and workflows across the Adobe Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Document Clouds, and future product lines. It is transforming Adobe from a suite of best-in-class tools into a unified, AI-native ecosystem. 

This platform encompasses agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, skill and capability catalogs, and the planning and reasoning layers that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows at enterprise scale. 

We are seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to own the engineering vision and execution of building the Adobe Intelligence Platform. This is a pivotal role to invent, embed, and scale the latest in AI innovation into Adobe’s products. This role is highly visible and key to executing Adobe’s vision to transform the way creators and their teams work and create. 

What you will do

  • Define and drive a holistic and full stack engineering strategy for the Adobe Intelligence Platform. 

  • Integrate platform components into web, desktop, and mobile surfaces, partnering with global teams to accelerate their timelines and unify the customer experience. 

  • Grow the organization, including hiring world-class talent, structuring teams, and developing the next generation of AI leaders within Adobe. 

  • Model and drive a new way of working, using the latest AI tooling to plan, review, and ship software. 

  • Own the technology strategy, pairing with senior architects, to define the roadmaps for agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, agentic harnesses, and skill catalogs. 

  • Set and run the operating rhythm with program and product partners: planning, prioritization, cross-team dependencies, and how the org measures its own progress. 

  • Partner with Research and Design to shape the future of applied AI by shortening the loop from cutting edge to production. 

  • Partner with Engineering, Program and Product leaders across the organization to understand their local needs and drive adoption of the AIP platform across Adobe. 

  • Align with Security, Privacy and Legal colleagues to ensure the platform has observability, security, and enterprise governance controls around safety and trust built into the end-to-end architecture. 

  • Define the adoption strategy and own the outcome for partnerships internally: ensure Adobe Intelligence Platform is serving the needs of application teams at all levels and across Adobe’s 3 cloud offering areas. 

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

  • 12+ years of engineering experience, including significant time leading engineering organizations through ambiguity and change. 

  • Direct experience with platform or infrastructure work: building the layer other engineering teams depend on. 

  • Working fluency in AI/ML systems: evals, context management, model gateways, and adjacent areas. 

  • Technical depth with agentic frameworks and the operational patterns to manage them at scale. 

  • A track record of building or substantially reshaping an engineering org, including hiring, structuring teams, and developing leaders under them. 

  • Comfortable influencing progress with a platform in a shifting technical landscape. 

  • Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive adoption of a platform across global teams. 

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to inspire teams and express a compelling vision.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished Revenue Systems Analyst responsible for the end-to-end design and implementation of revenue-related systems and infrastructure. This individual will partner with multiple organizations within Adobe, including Revenue Assurance and Accounting Operations, Technology Services, FP&A, BU Product Teams, Legal, Order Management, and others to ensure accuracy and consistency of external and internal financial accounting and reporting data within the framework of a myriad of strategic business projects. The candidate has a passion for problem solving and can work in high-visibility situations to assess, build, implement, and communicate the best solution to a broad and varied audience.

What you'll Do

  • Support and backfill the Revenue Accounting and Operations organization’s daily tasks
  • Assist with monitoring and troubleshooting key health metrics for our revenue accounting systems (SAP S/4 HANA)
  • Coordinate with various teams across the Revenue Accounting and Assurance organization to understand accounting guidance and system behavior
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams on GTM initiatives by evaluating risks and impact to our revenue systems, and supporting initiative launches
  • Create and test revenue relevant data models

What you need to succeed

  • BA/BS in Finance or Accounting
  • Minimum 3-5 years of related experience required (Software industry and/or CPA firm experience preferred)
  • Broad knowledge of technical application of ASC606 and all other current authoritative literature related to revenue recognition is required, with an emphasis on Software and SAAS principles
  • Experience and understanding of the Quote to Cash cycle
  • Proven record of guiding a project from requirements setting to Production Acceptance Testing (PAT); knowledge of agile methods is preferred
  • Proven ability to drive large-scale planning processes that involve multiple business partners
  • High attention to detail
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to lead, set objectives, and seek to results
  • Proven record of delivery and ability to assess and prioritize competing demands
  • Hands on experience with SAP Order to Cash
  • Interest in design, project management, and collaboration

description: The Opportunity Adobe is looking for a React.js Developer to help build the next generation of Creative Cloud applications. You’ll work on products used by millions of people and solve interesting engineering challenges across user experience, performance, and scale. If you enjoy building great products, experimenting with new technologies, and solving difficult problems, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do Build and deliver high-quality features using React.js and JavaScript/TypeScript . Own features from design and development through testing and release. Write clean, secure, maintainable, and well-tested code. Solve challenging engineering and architecture problems. Improve the performance and scalability of existing features. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to create great user experiences. Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development tools to improve how we build software. Our company Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. The opportunity We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to help define, build, and scale Adobe's cloud security capabilities across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership. The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and evolving one or more cloud security domains, identifying and prioritizing risks, developing long-term roadmaps, driving cross-functional initiatives, influencing partner teams, and delivering measurable security outcomes across Adobe. This is not a heads-down implementation role. While hands-on technical work, automation, prototyping, and software development will be part of the job, success in this role will depend equally on the ability to build partnerships, drive alignment, lead initiatives, and execute effectively within a large and complex enterprise environment. The ideal candidate can assess complex cloud environments, identify systemic risks, create practical solutions, influence technical direction, and successfully drive security improvements from concept through adoption. What you'll Do Own and Evolve Cloud Security Capabilities Serve as the long-term owner of one or more cloud security domains, such as cloud infrastructure security, cloud logging, identity and access management, cloud threat detection, security automation, or other strategic cloud security functions. Define and drive multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with Adobe's business and security objectives . Identify systemic risks and prioritize investments based on business impact, risk reduction, engineering effort, and operational realities. Drive Cloud Security Strategy and Architecture Assess and improve cloud security architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments. Evaluate identity and access management, data protection controls, logging strategy, and secure cloud configurations. Develop pragmatic security strategies that balance security requirements with business needs, scalability, developer experience, and operational constraints. Our company  

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.  

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!  

The opportunity  

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to help define, build, and scale Adobe's cloud security capabilities across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments.  

This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership. The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and evolving one or more cloud security domains, identifying and prioritizing risks, developing long-term roadmaps, driving cross-functional initiatives, influencing partner teams, and delivering measurable security outcomes across Adobe.  

This is not a heads-down implementation role. While hands-on technical work, automation, prototyping, and software development will be part of the job, success in this role will depend equally on the ability to build partnerships, drive alignment, lead initiatives, and execute effectively within a large and complex enterprise environment.  

The ideal candidate can assess complex cloud environments, identify systemic risks, create practical solutions, influence technical direction, and successfully drive security improvements from concept through adoption.  

What you'll Do

  

Own and Evolve Cloud Security Capabilities  

  • Serve as the long-term owner of one or more cloud security domains, such as cloud infrastructure security, cloud logging, identity and access management, cloud threat detection, security automation, or other strategic cloud security functions.  

  • Define and drive multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with Adobe's business and security objectives.  

  • Identify systemic risks and prioritize investments based on business impact, risk reduction, engineering effort, and operational realities.  

Drive Cloud Security Strategy and Architecture  

  • Assess and improve cloud security architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and private cloud environments.  

  • Evaluate identity and access management, data protection controls, logging strategy, and secure cloud configurations.  

  • Develop pragmatic security strategies that balance security requirements with business needs, scalability, developer experience, and operational constraints.  

  • Influence technical direction and architectural decisions across multiple engineering organizations.  

Lead Cross-Functional Security Initiatives  

  • Translate ambiguous security challenges into actionable roadmaps, projects, and prioritized workstreams.  

  • Drive complex initiatives from concept through delivery while coordinating stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, platform, and security teams.  

  • Build trusted relationships across Adobe and influence outcomes without direct authority.  

  • Represent Security Engineering as a collaborative partner and trusted advisor.  

Improve Cloud Detection, Visibility, and Response  

  • Lead efforts to improve cloud-native threat detection and security monitoring capabilities.  

  • Meaningfully contribute to Adobe's cloud logging strategy, including visibility, detection coverage, operational effectiveness, and cost management.  

  • Partner with detection engineering, incident response, and platform teams to improve security outcomes across Adobe's cloud environments.  

Build and Scale Security Automation  

  • Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and automation to improve security visibility, detection, compliance, and operational efficiency.  

  • Build tools and workflows that continuously identify cloud security risks and misconfigurations.  

  • Advance Adobe's infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code capabilities to improve scalability and consistency.  

  • Improve automation throughout security operations, deployment pipelines, testing, and security tooling.  

Mentor and Lead Through Influence  

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across Security Engineering.  

  • Mentor engineers and help raise the technical effectiveness of the broader organization.  

  • Promote security best practices and help drive a culture of continuous improvement.  

  • Act as a force multiplier by improving processes, programs, and teams beyond your immediate area of ownership.  

What you need to succeed  

Technical Expertise  

  • Significant experience securing cloud environments in Azure, AWS, GCP, or a combination of major cloud providers.  

  • Deep understanding of cloud security architecture, identity and access management, logging, threat detection, governance, and cloud-native security services.  

  • Experience securing modern cloud workloads, including Kubernetes platforms, containerized applications, CI/CD pipelines, and serverless technologies.  

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and CloudFormation.  

  • Experience building automation using languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or similar technologies.  

  • Strong understanding of software development, cloud infrastructure, and security engineering principles.  

  • Knowledge of security tooling, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems.  

Program Ownership and Execution  

  • Demonstrated success owning and driving complex security or engineering initiatives from strategy through execution.  

  • Experience developing roadmaps, establishing priorities, and balancing competing business and security objectives.  

  • Ability to break large, ambiguous problems into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.  

  • Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in complex environments.  

Leadership and Collaboration  

  • Proven ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.  

  • Experience building trusted relationships across engineering, platform, operations, and security teams.  

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.  

  • Ability to operate effectively in a large, complex, and highly collaborative environment.  

Personal Attributes  

  • Ownership mentality with strong accountability for outcomes.  

  • Strategic thinker who can balance short-term execution with long-term vision.  

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and making decisions with incomplete information.  

  • Curious, adaptable, and continuously learning.

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production. 
 
Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

We're looking for a Senior Creative Producer who will manage large scale campaigns across a pod, overseeing multiple workstreams and coordinate with a wide team of internal collaborators.  

The ideal candidate has experience managing complex creative campaigns and high volume work. They are energized by improving the production workflow itself, not just the individual outputs.   

You will partner closely with the Director of Production and Executive Producer on capacity planning, vendor governance, and workflow architecture across Adobe's portfolio, translating Adobe Creative production standards into practice for your team. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Work inside a fast-paced team, leading all aspects of the creation of assets that will launch at a global scale.  

  • Own creative campaign lifecycle from end to end: project intake, creating timelines, creative reviews and approvals, and cross-functional coordination across every stage of creative development.  

  • Support the creative team by prioritizing tasks, tracking feedback, and mitigating roadblocks to keep the team moving.  

  • Act as the bridge between internal teams and agencies, communicating details clearly throughout the production process so everyone stays aligned from briefing to delivery.  

  • Maintain a view of all active and incoming projects in your group. Collaborate with your EP and Director of Production to identify risks, dependencies, and resourcing gaps proactively.   

  • Bring an AI-first lens to production processes to streamline process and enable faster iteration. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • You have strong project management skills with deep, hands-on production experience of creative assets.  

  • 7+ years of experience as a producer or program manager driving creative deliverables, ideally in a fast-paced brand, agency, studio, or product-led creative environment.  

  • Hands-on experience delivering a high volume of assets across a range of content formats and channels: video, 3D, digital, and print.  

  • Skilled at managing multiple projects, schedules, budgets, and competing priorities across high-profile workstreams.  

  • Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail. Ability to identify critical paths and dependencies to drive projects forward and ensure quality execution.  

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Comfortable interfacing with executive collaborators and working with teams across various functions.

description:
The Opportunity At Adobe, securing the future of creativity is our mission. Our customers rely on our products every day to transform ideas into reality, and Adobe's security organization has built world-class security capabilities to protect that trust. The challenge is ensuring that expertise continuously develops the products and platforms our customers depend on. We seek a Staff Product Security Engineer to act as a Security Partner for our most valuable products. In this position, you will develop deep product and business insight. You will analyze signals from the security ecosystem and focus them into a few clear priorities. You will convert security capabilities into practical guidance that product and engineering teams can follow. You will operate with significant autonomy, own the security narrative for your portfolio end to end, and grow your influence across the Security organization and the product teams you partner with. This is an outstanding chance to create a meaningful impact! What you'll Do Serve as the single point of contact for a portfolio of Adobe's most complex and highest-value products, owning evaluation and communication of the product's security posture. Build and maintain deep context on each product's architecture, roadmap, and business drivers. Partner with your Technical Security Portfolio Manager (TSPM) to track assets, ownership, and open findings. Stay focused on the highest-leverage decisions! Lead security design reviews and threat modeling for major releases, platform-level development, and new products or services, identifying, analyzing, and prioritizing security gaps across architecture, trust boundaries, data flows, and threat actor behavior. Synthesize security signals, including threat models, vulnerability findings, and customer-identified concerns, into a curated set of top security priorities per product. Direct the security activities needed for a successful release. These include threat modeling, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, and paved-road onboarding. Integrate security into the existing release readiness process instead of treating it as a final gate. Identify systemic risk patterns across your portfolio, build mitigations, paved roads, and reusable security frameworks that address whole classes of risk at scale. Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers on your team. Share knowledge beyond your portfolio through tech talks, blogs, white papers, and conferences. Contribute to the Security organization's roadmap through research and proof-of-concepts, and share expertise on emerging threats in AI/ML and agentic systems. What you need to succeed 10+ years in Application or Product Security and a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field. A demonstrable history of building end-to-end security solutions that were adopted across multiple engineering teams, and of translating product context into prioritized, actionable security guidance. Proven ability to threat model complex, distributed, and AI/ML systems, and to make and defend risk-based decisions under uncertainty. Solid knowledge of application architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and secure SDLC practices. Broad knowledge of vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS) and authentication mechanisms (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, zero-trust). A background in security code review across multiple languages and stacks. Hands-on experience with standard security tooling (Burp Suite, Kali Linux) and the ability to build or customize tools when needed. A track record of external technical communication, alongside clear and confident communication with senior leadership and non-technical audiences. A collaborative approach to working across globally distributed teams and a genuine interest in helping developers ship features securely. The Opportunity

The Corporate Development Integration (CDI) team in Adobe’s Corporate Development organization consist of a multifaceted core group of professionals responsible for pre-merger operational diligence, integration strategy and post-merger integration planning and execution. We will collaborate with Adobe’s senior executives and business unit leaders throughout the phases of the acquisition life-cycle to ensure a smooth transition of the acquired company into Adobe’s ecosystem.

We’re looking for an experienced individual who excels in partnering cross-functionally and influencing in a multifaceted, fast-paced environment. This individual is operationally focused and commercially experienced, with the skill to simultaneously drive integration efforts while ensuring acquisition targets meet/exceed deal value drivers.

The Challenge

  • Provide support to the acquisitions team within corporate development prior to close
  • Serve as active participant in diligence of target company to lead the evaluation of key issues, to assess integration challenges and to develop post-close plans
  • Partner with executives and function leaders to craft integration strategies that closely align with acquisition rationale and operating model!
  • Drive timely and objective decision-making with sound advice and good judgment to sustain the pace of integration and maintain alignment with the deal rationale
  • Document detailed integration planning with activities, timelines, resources, and costs required to achieve deal specific value drivers
  • Develop and measure specific financial measures and leading indicators throughout the integration/transition period to measure success of the integration
  • Present regular integration updates and ensure Adobe senior leadership is aware of critical issues/risks and drive them to resolution with constant and consistent objectivity
  • Build, empower, and encourage cross-functional teams that partner with leaders to successfully plan and complete integration roadmap
  • Own integration governance and manage decisions and progress reports for Integration team

What is needed to succeed

  • Undergraduate / Graduate degree, preferably MBA, or equivalent working experience
  • 5+ years M&A Integration experience in the industry or in consulting
  • Strong business acuity with experience in a SaaS environment; prior understanding of digital/consumer internet, digital marketing or digital advertising highly desired
  • Knowledge of end-to-end corporate development activities
  • Experience in pre and post-acquisition integration activities in technology companies
  • Exceptional program management skills with demonstrated capability in sophisticated and ambiguous environments
  • High level of operational focus, strong analytical skill, rigor and attention to details
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Expert in M&A tools, data rooms, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint

description:
The Challenge As the Senior Manager of the Cyber Threat Research & Intelligence team, you will guide Adobe's efforts to predict, identify, and respond to the changing threat environment. Your position is key to delivering high-quality intelligence at tactical, operational, and strategic levels. This intelligence helps Adobe's security teams and executive leaders make informed, proactive decisions. You will develop and enhance a leading threat research and intelligence program that transforms raw threat data into actionable insights. This program supports defenses based on adversary behavior and keeps Adobe ahead of advanced threat actors. This is an opportunity to lead with purpose, build Adobe's intelligence strategy, and make a measurable impact on how the organization understands and responds to important threats. What You Will Do Develop and take responsibility for the strategic vision of Adobe's Cyber Threat Research & Intelligence program, covering tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence pillars. Lead a senior team of threat intelligence researchers, balancing deep technical research with timely intelligence production and collaborator engagement. Coordinate the full intelligence lifecycle — from collection and processing to analysis, production, and dissemination — ensuring intelligence outputs are relevant, accurate, timely, and actionable. Build and manage Adobe's threat actor tracking program, maintaining profiles on advanced persistent threat (APT) groups, cyber criminal organizations, and hacktivists relevant to Adobe's industry and attack surface. Produce and deliver intelligence products at multiple levels: tactical reports (IOCs, TTPs, YARA/Sigma rules), operational assessments (campaign analysis, actor attribution), and strategic briefings (threat landscape, industry trends, geopolitical risk). Partner closely with Cyber Threat Hunt, CSIRT, Detection Engineering, and Red Team to ensure intelligence directly informs defensive operations, detection development, and incident response. Drive Adobe's engagement with external intelligence communities, ISACs, government partners, and commercial threat intelligence providers to improve collection coverage and sharing. Build a high-performing team through coaching, career development, and technical mentorship, while encouraging a collaborative and inclusive environment that promotes intellectual rigor and continuous learning! Regularly brief senior leadership and key collaborators on the threat landscape, emerging risks, and intelligence program outcomes. What You Need to Succeed 8+ years in cybersecurity, with experience leading threat intelligence or threat research functions. Deep expertise across the intelligence lifecycle, including collection management, all-source analysis, and structured analytic techniques (ACH, Kill Chain, Diamond Model, MITRE ATT&CK). Established background in developing and presenting tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence reports to technical and executive viewers. Strong understanding of threat actor ecosystems — including nation-state groups, eCrime actors, and insider threats — and the tradecraft used to track and attribute them. Experience operationalizing threat intelligence through SIEM, SOAR, and TIP integrations, and converting intelligence into detection logic and defensive controls. Familiarity with a broad range of collection sources including OSINT, dark web monitoring, malware analysis outputs, and commercial intelligence feeds. Demonstrated success in building partnerships across security, engineering, legal, and business teams, and with external government and industry partners. Ability to distill complex threat analysis into clear, compelling narratives that drive executive decision-making and security investment. Experience building or maturing cybersecurity programs, including intelligence requirements processes, metrics frameworks, and team operating models.
