description: The Senior Manager, GSS India- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model. This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross-functional coordination. Day-to-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams. Key Responsibilities 1. ISOC Leadership & Governance • Provide end-to-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls. • Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC. • Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support. • Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting. • Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in partnership with GSS Technology and Systems. 2. JAPAC Regional Support • Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage, handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols. • Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in-country stakeholders to align ISOC support with regional priorities and global GSS standards. • Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across supported markets. • Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country-specific requirements. 3. Incident Management Team Readiness & Coordination • Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria, and supporting documentation. • Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and lessons-learned reviews. • Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates. • Support After-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure. • Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC. 4. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience • Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1-AER), enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans. • Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities, and testing or assurance activities. • Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated response and recovery model. • Maintain current, controlled, and audit-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking. • Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership. 5. Cross-Functional Partnership • Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems & Technology, and Environmental Health & Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology. • Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness reviews. • Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts. • Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen accountability. 6. Governance, Reporting & Improvement • Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional leadership. • Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio. • Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and investment needs. • Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to ISOC and resilience. Key Working Relationships • Internal: Director, India Safety & Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems & Technology Lead; Environmental Health & Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts. • Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders. • Cross-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members. • External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and specialist response capabilities. Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred. • Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management, business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline. • Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment. • Experience coordinating cross-functional incident response, exercises, After-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs. • Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC. • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities. • Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added advantge Core Capabilities • Operational leadership and disciplined execution • Incident command support and decision-making under pressure • Business continuity and operational resilience • Intelligence-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis • Executive communication and stakeholder influence • Cross-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority • Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership • High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care Measures of Success • ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence. • Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC. • IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure. • Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems & Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership. • Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in-scope GSS functions and sites. • Clear, timely, decision-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities. • Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions. This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross-functional coordination. Day-to-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.



Key Responsibilities


1. ISOC Leadership & Governance
• Provide end-to-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
• Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
• Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
• Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
• Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.


2. JAPAC Regional Support
• Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage, handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
• Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in-country stakeholders to align ISOC support with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
• Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across
supported markets.
• Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country-specific
requirements.


3. Incident Management Team Readiness & Coordination
• Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria, and supporting documentation.
• Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and lessons-learned reviews.
• Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
• Support After-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
• Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management
Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
4. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
• Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1-AER), enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
• Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities, and testing or assurance activities.
• Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated response and recovery model.
• Maintain current, controlled, and audit-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
• Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.


5. Cross-Functional Partnership
• Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems & Technology, and Environmental Health & Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
• Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness reviews.
• Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
• Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen accountability.


6. Governance, Reporting & Improvement
• Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional leadership.
• Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
• Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and
investment needs.
• Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to ISOC and resilience.


Key Working Relationships


• Internal: Director, India Safety & Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems & Technology Lead;
Environmental Health & Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
• Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
• Cross-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe
Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
• External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and
specialist response capabilities.



Qualifications & Experience


• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.
• Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management, business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline.
• Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment.
• Experience coordinating cross-functional incident response, exercises, After-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs.
• Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities.
• Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added
advantge



Core Capabilities


• Operational leadership and disciplined execution
• Incident command support and decision-making under pressure
• Business continuity and operational resilience
• Intelligence-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis
• Executive communication and stakeholder influence
• Cross-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority
• Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership
• High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care
Measures of Success
• ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence.
• Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC.
• IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure.
• Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems & Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership.
• Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in-scope GSS functions and sites.
• Clear, timely, decision-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities.
• Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions.

The Opportunity 

Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) is a key part of Adobe’s strategy to help enterprises deliver personalized and connected customer experiences at scale. 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a strong engineering team within Adobe Campaign, with a primary focus on driving the product's security strategy and initiatives while providing broader technical and people leadership. 

The Challenge 

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead technical execution, people development, and strategic engineering initiatives. Your role will focus on: 

  • Security Leadership: Own and drive key security initiatives for Adobe Campaign, working closely with Security and engineering teams to identify risks, prioritize remediation, and continuously strengthen the product's security posture. 

  • Technical Leadership: Drive architecture and technical decisions for complex, scalable, and reliable systems. 

  • People Leadership: Mentor and develop engineers, support career growth, and build a high-performing engineering team. 

  • Engineering Excellence: Drive high standards across software quality, reliability, performance, operational excellence, and engineering practices. 

  • Product Leadership: Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and other stakeholders to translate business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. 

Roles & Responsibilities 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers. 

  • Own and drive the security charter for Adobe Campaign, including security improvements, vulnerability remediation, and collaboration with internal security organizations. 

  • Provide technical direction and oversight across the team's engineering initiatives. 

  • Drive scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions through strong engineering practices and technical decision-making. 

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define priorities, manage execution, and deliver high-quality outcomes. 

  • Identify and address technical, operational, and architectural challenges. 

  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, systems, and team practices. 

  • Participate in hiring and career development of engineers. 

  • Work effectively with geographically distributed teams in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

Required Skills & Expertise 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience managing engineering teams. 

  • Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, design patterns, and frameworks. 

  • Strong computer science fundamentals and system design experience. 

  • Application security & vulnerability management for enterprise SaaS: Experience with threat modelling, secure code review, source/sink/escaper taint analysis, and remediation of OWASP Top 10 and related vulnerability classes, including injection, broken authentication/authorization, CSRF, SSRF, XXE, XSS, and multi-stage pre-auth RCE chains across native C++, server-side JavaScript, web, and SOAP/REST surfaces. 

  • AI engineering leadership: Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, and AI-assisted software development practices, with the ability to leverage AI to improve developer productivity, code quality, and security review throughput. 

  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure and modern engineering tools and practices. 

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Java, Python, or similar languages. 

  • Experience building scalable and reliable enterprise software. 

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience driving security initiatives for enterprise software products. 

  • Familiarity with security scanning, CVE remediation, threat modeling, authentication/authorization, or security compliance. 

  • Experience working with large-scale enterprise SaaS products.

The Senior Customer Journeys Technical Consultant leads complex marketing technology implementations across B2C customers, with a strong focus on Adobe Journey Optimizer. description: Position Overview We are looking for a Database Platform Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep operational expertise in AWS-managed data services to own the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of our growing polyglot data estate. In this role, you will manage a diverse database environment—spanning PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), and graph systems (Neo4j)—while partnering directly with application and AI/ML teams on database design and platform selection. If you are passionate about database reliability engineering, automation, and expanding into AI-adjacent patterns like vector search (pgvector) and RAG architecture, this role offers room to scale both technically and strategically. Responsibilities Fleet Reliability & HA/DR: Manage high availability, Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR), disaster recovery, and zero-downtime upgrades across RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Neo4j. Performance & Capacity: Lead query tuning, index optimization, sharding strategies, parameter configuration, and proactive capacity planning. Automation & IaC: Provision and manage data platforms using Terraform , Ansible , and Docker/Kubernetes integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Observability & Incident Response: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting via Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch ; participate in an on-call rotation for advanced troubleshooting. Data Architecture & AI Enablement: Advise development teams on schema design and database selection; implement and optimize vector search capabilities ( pgvector , OpenSearch vector engine) for AI/ML workloads. Security & Compliance: Enforce network isolation (VPC), encryption at rest/transit (KMS), and fine-grained access management (IAM). Key Qualifications Database Experience: 4 to 7 years administering production PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS/Aurora), alongside hands-on operational experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Neo4j . DBRE Fundamentals: Deep knowledge of backup strategies, failover mechanics, performance tuning, and cross-platform data modelling. DevOps Tooling: Proficient with Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD tools, and scripting ( Python / Bash ). Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with vector search, Redis/ElastiCache, DynamoDB, or LLM/RAG application architectures. Position Overview

We are looking for a Database Platform Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep operational expertise in AWS-managed data services to own the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of our growing polyglot data estate.

In this role, you will manage a diverse database environment—spanning PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), and graph systems (Neo4j)—while partnering directly with application and AI/ML teams on database design and platform selection. If you are passionate about database reliability engineering, automation, and expanding into AI-adjacent patterns like vector search (pgvector) and RAG architecture, this role offers room to scale both technically and strategically.

 

Responsibilities

  • Fleet Reliability & HA/DR: Manage high availability, Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR), disaster recovery, and zero-downtime upgrades across RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Neo4j.
  • Performance & Capacity: Lead query tuning, index optimization, sharding strategies, parameter configuration, and proactive capacity planning.
  • Automation & IaC: Provision and manage data platforms using Terraform, Ansible, and Docker/Kubernetes integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Observability & Incident Response: Build monitoring, logging, and alerting via Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch; participate in an on-call rotation for advanced troubleshooting.
  • Data Architecture & AI Enablement: Advise development teams on schema design and database selection; implement and optimize vector search capabilities (pgvector, OpenSearch vector engine) for AI/ML workloads.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce network isolation (VPC), encryption at rest/transit (KMS), and fine-grained access management (IAM).

 

Key Qualifications

  • Database Experience: 4 to 7 years administering production PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS/Aurora), alongside hands-on operational experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Neo4j.
  • DBRE Fundamentals: Deep knowledge of backup strategies, failover mechanics, performance tuning, and cross-platform data modelling.
  • DevOps Tooling: Proficient with Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD tools, and scripting (Python / Bash).
  • Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with vector search, Redis/ElastiCache, DynamoDB, or LLM/RAG application architectures.
  • Certifications (Preferred): AWS Certified Database – Specialty, CKA, or platform-specific certifications (PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Neo4j).

What you’ll do 

  • Lead the response to significant consumer trust incidents involving fraud, abuse, scams, account compromise, and other emerging threats, coordinating teams across Adobe to assess impact, establish priorities, and drive resolution.

You will build the conversational intelligence layer of our advisor efficiency platform. It includes timely orchestration, intent reasoning, and LLM-powered assist systems that help advisors during complex customer interactions across chat, phone, and ecommerce. You will own the full conversation stack, from utterance to action. Key Responsibilities Agentic Conversation Design: Architect and build the conversational layer of our prompt-based agentic platform — including intent detection, dialogue orchestration, and multi-step reasoning flows aligned to advisor workflows. Process Mapping: Work with operations and product teams to deeply understand advisor business processes, then translate that understanding into conversation system design. Evaluation & Quality: Define conversation quality metrics, build evaluation datasets from real interaction logs, and operate a continuous improvement loop for deployed systems. Probabilistic Fallback Design: Design graceful degradation patterns — ensuring the system handles low-confidence states, ambiguous intents, and out-of-scope inputs without advisor disruption. Cross-platform Delivery: Integrate conversational AI features throughout chat, phone, and ecommerce advisor surfaces — maintaining coherent behavior across channels. Probabilistic reasoning: you architect systems where intent is inferred, confidence is tracked, and ambiguity is handled gracefully rather than failing hard. Data-driven iteration: you measure conversation quality with data, not intuition — defining metrics, curating evaluation sets, and iterating based on evidence. Required Qualifications 3–5 years in conversational AI, NLP engineering, or LLM-based product development. Experience building dialogue systems with real business process alignment, not just scripted flows. The Opportunity


As a Business Process Analyst, you'll collaborate with multi-functional teams. You will optimize workflows and drive efficiencies that impact our enterprise Digital Media quote to contract operations.


What you'll Do


  • Partner with Deal Desk, Pricing Strategy, Product Business Units, and teams from multiple functions to provide the processes, tools, documentation, and information Deal Desk needs to support Adobe's Enterprise business.
  • Support the launch of new Go-To-Market offers, pricing programs, policies, and business changes by assessing Deal Desk impacts and coordinating operational readiness.
  • Build and maintain Deal Desk process documentation, approval mentorship, playbooks, user guides, and training materials.
  • Coordinate Deal Desk enablement, including training, communications, collaboration, and self-service resources.
  • Serve as a point of contact for Deal Desk process and system questions related to quote-to-contract workflows.
  • Investigate and manage issues in Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and related systems, and coordinate with business and technical teams to resolve them.
  • Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities by gathering feedback from Deal Desk and analyzing operational needs.
  • Translate Deal Desk needs into clear business requirements and support projects involving multiple functions that improve processes, systems, and the Deal Desk experience.

What you need to succeed


  • 3+ years of experience in Deal Desk Operations, Sales Operations, Business Process Analysis, Commercial Operations, or a similar role supporting Enterprise sales operations.
  • Good understanding of quote-to-contract processes and the systems, policies, approvals, and workflows that support Deal Desk.
  • Experience translating business needs into clear processes, requirements, documentation, and scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes, resolve issues, and drive process improvements.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and a solid focus on accuracy when working with processes, pricing, approvals, systems, and documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex process and system changes clearly to operational teams.
  • Experience with Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics; experience with CRM, quoting, approval, or CPQ processes is a plus.
  • Experience in crafting process documentation, playbooks, training materials, communications, and knowledge resources for operational teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work effectively across teams, and adapt to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.

  • Python/Shell scripting to develop and maintain platform code.
  • Participate in code/infra reviews, cross-functional collaboration, and mentor junior engineers.

  • 6–8 years in software/platform engineering with strong DevOps / SRE / infrastructure focus and end-to-end production ownership.
  • Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience — Cluster API / kubeadm, Helm, networking/CNI (Calico), autoscaling, and Linux/Windows node/container workloads.

description:
The Opportunity Adobe’s Deal Desk organization is at an inflection point. We are building a globally unified function designed to be a strategic partner to the business, and this role will help define what comes next. Reporting directly to the global leader of Deal Desk, you will build and lead capabilities fundamental to how we operate. You will own our critical initiative portfolio, define how we apply AI across the function, and build the insights and reporting capabilities leaders use to run the business. You will have meaningful ownership and a voice in developing both the strategy and operating model of the organization. If you are energized by building what comes next rather than inheriting what already exists, this is a chance to create a lasting impact on how Deal Desk operates at Adobe! What You'll Do Own the Deal Desk critical initiative portfolio: Prioritize and sequence the initiatives that advance our goals, while creating clear visibility, ownership, and accountability. Set and implement our AI strategy: Identify where AI can meaningfully improve how we support deals and operate as a global function, drive adoption of the right solutions, and measure results. Build and lead our reporting and insights capability: Develop the dashboards and analytics that leaders depend on, including hands-on reporting and analysis as the capability grows. Turn strategy into execution: Help shape transformation efforts from the initial vision through the execution plan, operating model, and accountability needed to deliver. Build across boundaries: Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Product, Operations, and other teams to develop strategies and solutions that work end to end. Build and grow a distributed team: Hire thoughtfully, mentor openly, set clear expectations, and develop the team as the capability grows. In Your First Year Success in your first year will mean turning the vision into capabilities the organization can see, use, and rely on. You will: Build the reporting foundation. Stand up the reporting function and launch the visual tools and insights leaders use to understand performance and run the business. Move AI from strategy to everyday work. Define the AI roadmap, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and put the first solutions into daily use. Build a clear operating rhythm for critical initiatives. Bring the Deal Desk initiative portfolio onto a single cadence with clear priorities, ownership, progress, and accountability. Start building the team. Hire your first team members and establish how the team operates, partners, and delivers. What You Need to Succeed Degree or at least 8 years of experience deemed equivalent. Strong reporting and analytics experience, including building dashboards and writing queries with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SQL. Experience designing and scaling new processes or operating models, with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear priorities and move between strategy and hands-on execution. Experience applying AI, automation, or emerging technology to improve how work gets done. Experience building and developing teams, partnering across functions, and communicating complex ideas clearly with senior collaborators. Preferred qualifications: Advanced degree or equivalent experience, or specific skills in data analytics, AI, or business strategy. The Opportunity


Adobe’s Deal Desk organization is at an inflection point. We are building a globally unified function designed to be a strategic partner to the business, and this role will help define what comes next. Reporting directly to the global leader of Deal Desk, you will build and lead capabilities fundamental to how we operate. You will own our critical initiative portfolio, define how we apply AI across the function, and build the insights and reporting capabilities leaders use to run the business. You will have meaningful ownership and a voice in developing both the strategy and operating model of the organization. If you are energized by building what comes next rather than inheriting what already exists, this is a chance to create a lasting impact on how Deal Desk operates at Adobe!


What You'll Do


  • Own the Deal Desk critical initiative portfolio: Prioritize and sequence the initiatives that advance our goals, while creating clear visibility, ownership, and accountability.
  • Set and implement our AI strategy: Identify where AI can meaningfully improve how we support deals and operate as a global function, drive adoption of the right solutions, and measure results.
  • Build and lead our reporting and insights capability: Develop the dashboards and analytics that leaders depend on, including hands-on reporting and analysis as the capability grows.
  • Turn strategy into execution: Help shape transformation efforts from the initial vision through the execution plan, operating model, and accountability needed to deliver.
  • Build across boundaries: Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Product, Operations, and other teams to develop strategies and solutions that work end to end.
  • Build and grow a distributed team: Hire thoughtfully, mentor openly, set clear expectations, and develop the team as the capability grows.

In Your First Year


Success in your first year will mean turning the vision into capabilities the organization can see, use, and rely on. You will:


  • Build the reporting foundation. Stand up the reporting function and launch the visual tools and insights leaders use to understand performance and run the business.
  • Move AI from strategy to everyday work. Define the AI roadmap, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and put the first solutions into daily use.
  • Build a clear operating rhythm for critical initiatives. Bring the Deal Desk initiative portfolio onto a single cadence with clear priorities, ownership, progress, and accountability.
  • Start building the team. Hire your first team members and establish how the team operates, partners, and delivers.

What You Need to Succeed


  • Degree or at least 8 years of experience deemed equivalent.
  • Strong reporting and analytics experience, including building dashboards and writing queries with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SQL.
  • Experience designing and scaling new processes or operating models, with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear priorities and move between strategy and hands-on execution.
  • Experience applying AI, automation, or emerging technology to improve how work gets done.
  • Experience building and developing teams, partnering across functions, and communicating complex ideas clearly with senior collaborators.

Preferred qualifications: Advanced degree or equivalent experience, or specific skills in data analytics, AI, or business strategy.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

Adobe makes the tools the world uses to create. Our own design work should set the standard for what those tools make possible. You will work across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, motion and live experiences, moving confidently between early visual exploration, design development and polished final execution. 

  

Working alongside Design leaders, Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Strategists and Product partners, you will help turn ideas into distinctive visual expressions that feel recognizably Adobe without becoming repetitive or formulaic. 

  

You will combine exceptional design craft with curiosity for emerging technology. You will use Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled workflows to explore more widely, prototype more quickly and make stronger work without compromising taste, originality or human judgment. 

  

You are a maker first. You care deeply about typography, image-making, composition, and the details that make an idea feel fully resolved. 

 

 

What You’ll Do 

Design Across the Work 

  • Create high-quality design across campaigns, multi-platform design, product storytelling, and live experiences.  
  • Develop work from early concept and visual exploration through design development and final execution.  
  • Apply exceptional craft across typography, image-making, layout, composition and art direction.  
  • Work across high-velocity everyday output and highly crafted flagship work.  
  • Adapt strong ideas across channels and formats without losing their intelligence or visual impact. 
  • Create work that feels connected and recognizably Adobe while remaining fresh, distinctive and culturally relevant. 

 

Turn Ideas into Visual Worlds 

  • Partner with Creative Directors, Design Directors and Art Directors to develop visual territories and creative systems.  
  • Translate campaign and creative ideas into compelling art direction and design expression.  
  • Collaborate with Copywriters to develop visual and verbal ideas as one connected creative system.  
  • Create mood boards, prototypes, and design studies that help teams explore and align early.  
  • Know when to explore broadly and when to refine toward a clear, production-ready solution.  
  • Bring a strong visual point of view while remaining open to collaboration and critique. 

 

Build Scalable Creative Systems 

  • Create modular frameworks, templates and reusable design tools that support speed without losing craft.  
  • Help translate Adobe’s brand system into distinctive creative expression across real work.  
  • Test how design ideas perform across channels, formats and audience needs.  
  • Find opportunities to improve tools and workflows based on real creative applications.  
  • Balance systematic thinking with experimentation, surprise and flexibility.  
  • Document design thinking clearly so others can apply it effectively. 

 

Advance AI-Native Design 

  • Use Creative Cloud, Firefly and emerging generative tools throughout concepting, prototyping and production.  
  • Use AI-enabled workflows to expand visual exploration and accelerate iteration without lowering the standard.  
  • Apply human judgment, taste and craft to all AI-assisted work.  
  • Help define where AI can support scale and where human authorship and intervention remain essential.  
  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.  
  • Apply responsible AI practices, including provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials. 

 

Collaborate and Deliver 

  • Work closely with Creative Directors, Art Directors, Copywriters, Motion Designers, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.  
  • Present work clearly, explain design decisions, and respond constructively to feedback.  
  • Partner with Production to carry ideas into execution while protecting their creative intent.  
  • Collaborate with photographers, illustrators, artists, studios, and specialist partners when required. 
  • Maintain a high design standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.  
  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas and development of the wider team. 

 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

  • You consider yourself a maker. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing. 
  • 6+ years of experience in design, art direction, or multidisciplinary creative practice. 
  • A standout portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across multi-platform campaigns and product storytelling. 
  • Deep expertise in typography, layout, image-making, and visual composition. 
  • Strong fluency across digital, motion, and emerging design practices. 
  • Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to carry an idea from exploration through final execution. 
  • Experience working across both high-velocity creative
  • Experience applying brand systems in ways that feel distinctive and alive. 
  • Strong systems thinking and experience creating modular frameworks, templates or reusable creative tools. 
  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud, Firefly and AI-enabled visual workflows. 
  • A clear perspective on how generative AI changes visual exploration, authorship and production. 
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and collaborating with Copy, Motion, Strategy and Production. 
  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills. 
  • A genuine and current understanding of culture, design, art, technology and emerging visual practices. 
  • The ability to balance speed, experimentation, and craft. 
  • A maker attitude, curiosity and a commitment to continuously improving the work.
